definition.ar: تهديد لجودة وكمية المياه الجوفية من جراء الأنشطة المتعلقة باستخدام الأراضي. فبعض الأنشطة (مثل التخلص من النفايات) تؤدي إلى خطر التلوث بوجه خاص، فكلما كان النشاط قريبا من بئر أو حفرة زاد خطر تلوث الماء الذي يستخرج بالضخ. ويجب الأخذ في الاعتبار بنوعية التربة وجيولوجية المنطقة وسقوط المطر وكمية الماء المستخرج بالضخ من الأرض.
definition.en: Threat to the quality and quantity of groundwater by activities related to the use of land. As some activities (e.g. landfill) present a particular risk of pollution, the closer an activity is to a well or borehole, the greater the risk of the pumped water being polluted. The type of soil, the geology, the rainfall and the amount of water pumped out of the ground must all be taken into consideration.

definition.ar: عملية استخراج الماه الجوفية عمدا أو دون قصد من مصدر بمعدل يفوق تجدده بحيث يتراجع مستوى المياه الجوفية تراجعا مطردا، مما يهدد بنفاذ هذا الإمداد أو على الأقل بتراجع مستويات الضخ إلى أعماق غير اقتصادية.
definition.en: The process, deliberate or inadvertent, of extracting ground water from a source at a rate so in excess of the replenishment that the ground water level declines persistently, threatening exhaustion of the supply or at least a decline of pumping levels to uneconomic depths.
Movement of subsurface water in the saturated zone from areas of recharge to areas of discharge.
Depth in a well or aquifer at which groundwater occurs.

definition.ar: تلوث أي ماء يعثر عليه تحت سطح الأرض بسبب أي تسرب للملوثات مثل المركبات غير العضوية (الكلوريدات والنترات والمعادن الثقيلة، إلخ) والكيماويات العضوية المخلقة (مبيدات الآفات والمخصبات، إلخ) والممرضات (البكتيريا والطفيليات، إلخ).
definition.en: Contamination of any water found under the earth's surface by any leaching pollutants, such as inorganic compounds (chlorides, nitrates, heavy metals, etc.), synthetic organic chemicals (pesticides, fertilizers, etc.) and pathogens (bacteria, parasites, etc.).
Fitness of subsurface water for use based on its composition and properties.

a heuristic tool in phenology. GDD are a measure of heat accumulation used by horticulturists, gardeners, and farmers to predict plant and pest development rates such as the date that a flower will bloom or a crop reach maturity.
Growth Stage is defined as the phenological growth stage and is measured on the BBCH (Biologische Bundesanstalt, Bundessortenamt and Chemical industry) Scale.

definition.ar: شرم بحري ذو أبعاد مساحية كبيرة، أكثر تقعرا من الخليج الصغير وأكثر انغلاقا بصفة عامة.
definition.en: An inlet of the sea of large areal proportions, more indented than a bay and generally more enclosed.
A landform created by running water eroding sharply into soil, typically on a hillside.

definition.ar: نبات بذري من فئة عاريات البذور، فيه المبيض يكون محمولا عاريا على سطح أكياس الأبواغ االمرصوصة على هيئة أقماع.
definition.en: Any seed-bearing plant of the division Gymnospermae, in which the ovules are borne naked on the surface of the mega sporophylls, which are often arranged in cones.
Seed-bearing woody vascular plants, such as the conifers (pine, spruce, fir, etc.), whose seeds are not enclosed in an ovary or fruit, but are exposed.
The large-scale pattern of circulation around the entire ocean basin.

definition.ar: المكان الذي ينمو فيه النبات أو يعيش فيه الحيوان بصورة طبيعية، وقد يكون منطقة جغرافية يمتد فوقها أو محطة معينة يعثر فيها على عينة من النبات او الحيوان. 2) جانب فيزيائي من البيئة يستوطنه كائن أو تجمع من الكائنات. ويتميز الموطن بالتجانس النسبي للبيئة الفيزيائية وبالتفاعل الوثيق إلى حد معقول بين كل الأنواع الحيوية الموجودة فيه. ومن حيث المنطقة، يمكن للموطن أن يشمل الصحاري أو الغابات المدارية أو حقول البراري أو التندرا القطبية أو المحيط القطبي.
definition.en: 1) The locality in which a plant or animal naturally grows or lives. It can be either the geographical area over which it extends, or the particular station in which a specimen is found. 2) A physical portion of the environment that is inhabited by an organism or population of organisms. A habitat is characterized by a relative uniformity of the physical environment and fairly close interaction of all the biological species involved. In terms of region, a habitat may comprise a desert, a tropical forest, a prairie field, the Arctic Tundra or the Arctic Ocean.
Changes in the environments where plants and animals live. Includes natural changes as well as results of human actions, deliberate or accidental.

definition.ar: تدمير مواطن الحياة البرية بسبب زيادة الضغط على الأرض من جانب السكان الذين يتزايدون سريعا وبسبب التلوث والاستغلال المفرط. وقد اختفت أنواع أو أعداد بكاملها من النباتات والحيوانات مما أدى إلى فقد المصدر الجيني، وهو أمر ليس مؤسفا فحسب من الناحية الجمالية أو الفلسفية لكنه أيضا يهدد الإمدادات الغذائية للإنسان. ويأخذ فقد المواطن أشكالا عديدة، كالفقد المباشر للمساحات التي تستخدمها الأنواع البرية، والتدهور بسبب إزالة الغطاء النباتي والتآكل مثلا، مما يحرم الأنواع الأصلية من الغذاء والمأوى ومناطق التكاثر، وتفتيت الموطن حيث تصبح الأنواع الأصلية محصورة في بقاع صغيرة من الأرض التي لا يضايقها فيها أحد وتحيطها أراض أزيل منها الغطاء النباتي لتمهيدا للزراعة وغيرها من الأغراض.
definition.en: Destruction of wildlife habitats by increasing pressure for land by fast-growing human populations, pollution and over-exploitation. Whole species or populations of plants and animals have disappeared causing a loss of genetic resource that is not only regrettable from an aesthetic or philosophical point of view but also threatens man's food supply. Habitat loss takes several forms: outright loss of areas used by wild species; degradation, for example, from vegetation removal and erosion, which deprive native species of food, shelter, and breeding areas; and fragmentation, when native species are squeezed onto small patches of undisturbed land surrounded by areas cleared for agriculture and other purposes.
Disruption of once-continuous natural habitats by human activities such as agriculture, urbanization, resource extraction, and the construction of roads, railways, fences, and pipelines.
loss of suitable habitat for a given species such that the particular species no longer occurs in that area
Numerical values calculated for a given area representing the capacity of a habitat to support a given species, as the ratio of observed habitat conditions to optimum conditions.

Parts of the physical environment where plants and animals live. Use in combination with terms from organisms and organism groupings (non-taxonomic) to indicate the topic of a species or group of species habitat.
Metal element with symbol Hf and atomic number 72

definition.ar: الهطول في صورة مرات أو كتل غير منتظمة من الثلج، يتكون عادة بواسطة السحب الحاملة، وفي الأغلب من السحاب المزني الركامي.
definition.en: Precipitation in the form of balls or irregular lumps of ice, always produced by convective clouds, nearly always cumulonimbus.
The route/localized area of a hailstorm, occurring as hail falls while the storm path is moving. Sometimes also referred to as the hail swath.
Any storm that produces hailstones that fall to the ground; usually used when the amount or size of the hail is considered significant.

definition.ar: الزمن الذي تستغرقه نصف ذرات كمية معينة من مادة مشعة حتى يحدث لها تحلل إشعاعي.
definition.en: The time required for one-half the atoms of a given amount of radioactive material to undergo radioactive decay.

Halocarbons containing chlorine and bromine are among the mostpotent greenhouse gases in the atmosphere. They do not occur naturally butare produced industrially in large quantities. The best known members ofthis group of chemicals are the chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) [seedefinition], which are widely used as solvents, refrigerants, spray-canpropellants and foaming agents. Also significant are the halons,bromine-based compounds used as fire-extinguishing agents.

Halons are a group of brominated organic compounds used as fire retardants. Thetransport of these compounds to the stratosphere, followed by their photolysisto release Br (Bromine) atoms, gives this group a very high ozone depletionpotential. The production of these compounds is now banned according to theMontreal Protocol. Halogens are made up of the elements fluorine (F), chlorine (Cl), bromine (Br),iodine (I), and astatine (At). The first four members are present in traceamounts in the atmosphere as a result of both natural and anthropogenicactivity.
The zone of the ocean in which salinity increases rapidly with depth.

definition.ar: أحد المركبات التي تنتمي لمجموعة الهالوجينات المشتقة من المركبات المحتوية على الهيدروجين والكربون العضوي. وتتضمن هذه المجموعة المركبات الهالوجينية الأحادية (هاليدات الألكان والأريل) والمركبات متعددة الهالوجينات التي تحتوي على ذرات هالوجينية مماثلة أو مختلفة.
definition.en: One of a group of halogen derivatives of organic hydrogen and carbon containing compounds; the group includes monohalogen compounds (alkyl or aryl halides) and polyhalogen compounds that contain the same or different halogen atoms.

definition.ar: مركب عضوي مرتبط بأحد العناصر الهالوجينية الخمسة (الأستاتين والبروم والكلور والفلور واليود). وتسهم العديد من هذه المركبات في خفض تركيز الأوزون في الغلاف الجوي.
definition.en: An organic compound bonded with one of the five halogen elements (astatine, bromine, chlorine, fluorine, and iodine). Several of these compounds contribute to reductions in the concentration of ozone in the stratosphere.

Halon: a compound consisting of bromine, fluorine, and carbonHalons are used as fire extinguishing agents, both in built-in systems and in handheld portable fire extinguishers. Halon production in the U.S. ended on December 31, 1993, because they contribute to ozone depletion. They cause ozone depletion because they contain bromine. Bromine is many times more effective at destroying ozone than chlorine. At the time the current U.S. tax code was adopted, the ozone depletion potentials of halon 1301 and halon 1211 were observed to be 10 and 3, respectively. These values are used for tax calculations. Recent scientific studies, however, indicate that the ODPs are at least 12 and 6, respectively. Note: technically, all compounds containing carbon and fluorine and/or chlorine are halons, but in the context of the Clean Air Act, 'halon' means a fire extinguishing agent as described above. A table of class I substances (http://www.epa.gov/ozone/science/ods/classone.html) shows their ODPs, GWPs, and CAS numbers. Halons are numbered according to a standard scheme.
Use of portable equipment to measure spectral reflectance of materials in the field.

Use of engineered structures to armor or otherwise protect the shoreline against erosional agents such as waves and currents. Includes breakwaters, bulkheads, seawalls, groins, jetties, and revetments.

definition.ar: مواد ملقاة، كثيرا من تكون خطرة أو بكميات كبيرة، ليس هناك طريق واضح للتخلص منها.
definition.en: Discarded material, often hazardous or in large volume, for which there is no obvious disposal route.

definition.ar: مقاومة الأجسام الصلبة للانبعاج أو الخدش أو التحات أو القطع.
definition.en: Resistance of a solid to indentation, scratching, abrasion or cutting.

Forecasting, modeling, and/or observations of harmful algal blooms (colonies of algae that grow in dense concentrations and produce toxic or harmful effects on people, fish, shellfish, marine mammals, and/or birds).

definition.ar: كمية أ, مقدار المحصول المجموع في موسم ما.
definition.en: The amount or measure of the crop gathered in a season.
Metal element with symbol Hs and atomic number 108

definition.ar: عامل فيزيائي أو كيميائي قادر على إحداث ضرر للأشخاص أو العقارات أو الحيوانات أو النباتات أو غيرها من الموارد الطبيعية.
definition.en: A physical or chemical agent capable of causing harm to persons, property, animals, plants or other natural resources.

definition.ar: أي موقع أو منطقة بها عامل فيزيائي أو كيميائي قادر على إحداث الضرر بالممتلكات و الأشخاص أو الحيوانات أو النباتات أو غيرها من الموارد الطبيعية.
definition.en: Any site or region in which there is a physical or chemical agent capable of causing harm to property, persons, animals, plants or other natural resources.

definition.ar: خطر على صحة الإنسان أو المنشآت أو البيئة بسبب دخزل مواد ضارة إلى النظام الإيكولوجي.
definition.en: Risk or danger to human health, property or the environment posed by the introduction of a harmful substances into the ecosystem.
Awareness of the consequences of hazards and actions to be taken before, during, or after hazards occur or are encountered.

definition.ar: أي مخلفات أو مزيج من المخلفات التي يمكن أن تضر بصحة الإنسان أو الكائنات الحية أو البيئة. وتتطلب النفايات الخطرة عادة إجراءات خاصة للتعامل معها والتخلص منها تنظمها القوانين الوطنية والدولية.
definition.en: Any waste or combination of wastes with the potential to damage human health, living organisms or the environment. Hazardous wastes usually require special handling and disposal procedures which are regulated by national and international laws.
Potential dangers from both natural processes (e.g., earthquakes, floods, and climate change) and human impacts on the environment.

definition.ar: انخفاض الرؤية في الجو نتيجة لوجود بخار الماء المتكاثف والغبار، إلخ، في الغلاف الجوي.
definition.en: Reduced visibility in the air as a result of condensed water vapour, dust, etc., in the atmosphere.

Chlorodifluoromethane or difluoromonochloromethane is a hydrochlorofluorocarbon (HCFC). This colorless gas is better known as HCFC-22, or R-22, or CHClF It is commonly used as a propellant and refrigerant. These applications are being phased out in developed countries due to the compound's ozone depletion potential (ODP) and high global warming potential (GWP), although global use of R-22 continues to increase because of high demand in developing countries

definition.ar: رأس أو نتوء بارز لخط الساحل داخل البحر، به عادة جرف مميز.
definition.en: A cape or promontory jutting seawards from a coastline, usually with a significant sea cliff.

Headlands and bays are often found together on the same stretch of coastline. A bay is surrounded by land on three sides, whereas a headland is surrounded by water on three sides. Headlands are characterized by high, breaking waves, rocky shores, intense erosion, and steep sea cliffs.

Normal and abnormal conditions of plant and animal bodies. Covers both human and non-human health and disease topics. For human health and disease, use the narrower term 'environmental health (human)'.
any environmental factors (including physical, chemical, biological or socio-economic) that have harmful consequences for human health and the environment

definition.ar: مجمل التدابير والأجهزة المستخدمة للمحافظة على الناس من الضرر الذي يمكن أن يصيب حاسة إدراك الأصوات.
definition.en: The total of measures and devices implemented to preserve persons from harm to the faculty of perceiving sound.

definition.ar: السلوك الإدراكي العام والاستجابات المتخصصة التي تحدث فيما يتعلق بالمؤثرات الصوتية.
definition.en: The general perceptual behaviour and the specific responses made in relation to sound stimuli.

definition.ar: الجهاز المعني بإدراك الصوت عن طريق عضو كورتي الموجود في أذن الثدييات أو من خلال مستقبلات حسية مناظرة في الفقاريات الدنيا. وهو حساس عادة في الأذن البشرية لاهتزازات الصوت التي تتراوح بين 16 و27,000 دورة في الثانية لكنه أكثر استقبالا للاهتزازات التي تقع بين 2,000 و5,000 دورة في الثانية، ويتم توصيله مركزيا عن طريق فرع العصب السمعي الواقع في القوقعة، ويتم تنسيقه بصفة خاصة في الجسم الأوسط.
definition.en: The system that is concerned with the perception of sound, is mediated through the organ of Corti of the ear in mammals or through corresponding sensory receptors of the lagena in lower vertebrates, is normally sensitive in man to sound vibrations between 16 and 27.000 cycles per second but most receptive to those between 2.000 and 5.000 cycles per second, is conducted centrally by the cochlear branch of the auditory nerve, and is coordinated especially in the medial geniculate body.

Refers to a frequency and intensity of a heat wave and cold wave. A heat wave is a period of abnormally hot weather generally lasting more than two days. Heat waves can occur with or without high humidity. They have potential to cover a large area, exposing a high number of people to hazardous heat. A cold wave is a weather event involving a cooling of the air, or the invasion of very cold air, over a large area. It is marked by a drop of average temperature well below the averages of a region. Cold waves can have negative impacts on people, crops, properties, and services. They can be preceded or accompanied by significant winter weather events, such as blizzards or ice storms. And they can feel even colder during periods of high winds.
Energy transferred by a difference in temperature through the surface of the earth.

The measurement of the heat flux or heat loss from open ocean areas withinthe sea ice pack is important for the study of energy balance in the polarregions and local and regional climatology. Heat loss through the openwater is 100 times more than through thick ice.

The heat index (HI) or “apparent temperature” is an approximation of how hot it “feels” for a given combination of air temperature and relative humidity (RH). Generally, higher RH values at the same temperature feel warmer or more stressful because of less evaporative cooling when people perspire. The HI is the result of extensive biometeorological studies over a period of decades by various researchers, most notably Robert G. Steadman.

definition.ar: شكل من أشكال انتقال الطاقة باختلاف درجة الحرارة. ويساوي إجمالي الطاقة الحركية لذرات نظام ما أو جزيئاته.
definition.en: A form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature: it is equal to the total kinetic energy of the atoms or molecules of a system.
condition in which crop performance or survival is compromised by periods of exposure to high temperatures
definition.fr: conditions dans lesquelles la rentabilité ou la survie des cultures est compromise par des périodes d'exposition à des températures élevées

definition.en: (Also called hot wave, warm wave.) A period of abnormally and uncomfortably hot and usually humid weather. To be a heat wave such a period should last at least one day, but conventionally it lasts from several days to several weeks. In 1900, A. T. Burrows more rigidly defined a 'hot wave' as a spell of three or more days on each of which the maximum shade temperature reaches or exceeds 90°F. More realistically, the comfort criteria for any one region are dependent upon the normal conditions of that region. In the eastern United States, heat waves generally build up with southerly winds on the western flank of an anticyclone centered over the southeastern states, the air being warmed by passage over a land surface heated by the sun.

definition.ar: أرض ذات تربة حمضية ضعيفة، عادة ما تسود فيها نبتة الخلنج بأنواعها (كاليون أو إيريكا).
definition.en: An area with poor acid soil, typically dominated by ling (Calluna) or heaths (Erica).
Generally, a measure of the departure of the mean daily temperature from a given standard: one degree-day for each degree (°C or °F) of departure above (or below) the standard during one day.
The heat flux that is dissipated or absorbed by the ocean over a period of time.

definition.ar: معدن جاذبيته النوعية تبلغ 5.0 تقريبا أو أكثر.
definition.en: A metal whose specific gravity is approximately 5.0 or higher.

definition.ar: كمية الإجهاد الذي يتعرض له النظام الإيكولوجي بسبب التلوث بالمعادن الثقيلة المطلقة فيه.
definition.en: The amount of stress put on an ecosystem by heavy metal pollution released into it.
Those metals which have densities >5.0 Mg m-3. In soils these include the elements Cd, Co, Cr, Cu, Fe, Hg, Mn, Mo, Ni, Pb, and Zn.
Solar energetic particles consisting of nuclei of elements heavier than protonsand electrons.
Noble gas element with symbol He and atomic number 2

definition.ar: حيوان يقتات على العشب وغيره من النباتات.
definition.en: An animal that feeds on grass and other plants.
Animals that eat chiefly plants or their products, such as seeds, nectar, and fruit.
Herbivory is an ecological interaction between two species where onespecies eats part or all of a plant species.
Branch of zoology concerned with the study of reptiles and amphibians.

definition.ar: مركبات فيها البنية الحلقية مكونة من أكثر من نوع واحد من الذرات.
definition.en: Compound in which the ring structure is a combination of more than one kind of atom.

'NEE of CO2' with the atmosphere is a fundamental measure of the balance between carbon uptake by the vegetation 'GPP' and carbon losses through 'autotrophic' and 'heterotrophic respiration'. The sum of Ra and Rh defines the total ecosystem respiration rate.
A state of greatly reduced metabolic activity and lowered bodytemperature adopted by certain mammals as an adaptation to winterconditions.

High-throughput sequencing, also known as next-generation sequencing (NGS), is the comprehensive term used to describe modern technologies that sequence DNA and RNA in a rapid and cost-effective manner.

definition.ar: مستوى الماء عندما يبلغ المد أعلى منسوب له.
definition.en: The level of water when the tide is at its highest level.

A high water mark indicates the maximum height reached by water during a flood event, often identified after the flood by physical evidence left on the riverbank, and used to supplement data from a stream gauge when real-time monitoring wasn't available.
Refers to the highest daytime temperature reported for a given location during a given period.
Refers to highest low nighttime temperature attained at a specific location during a specified period.

definition.ar: نظم التفاعل بين المجتمعات الحيوية وما يحيط بها من جماد في المناطق ذات الارتفاعات العالية نسبيا، وتتسم عادة بانخفاض الضغط الجوي وحرارة الجو، وبانخفاض كمية الاكسجين المتوافر واشتداد العزلة.
definition.en: The interacting systems of the biological communities and their non-living surroundings in regions of relatively high elevation, typically characterized by decreased air pressure and temperature, reduced oxygen availability and increased isolation.

definition.ar: مرتفع طبيعي من سطج الأرض، يعلو بوضوح على ما يحيط به من أرض، وعادة ما يكون محدود الامتداد وذا حدود واضحة، مستديرا أكثر منه ذا قمة أو وعرا، وليس هناك تعريف محددا لارتفاعه المطلق.
definition.en: A natural elevation of the land surface, rising rather prominently above the surrounding land, usually of limited extent and having a well-defined outline, rounded rather than peaked or rugged, with no specific definition of absolute elevation.
Branch of anatomy concerned with the microscopic structure of plant and animal tissue.
Rare earth (lanthanide series) element with symbol Ho and atomic number 67
A host (e.g., a human) with all of its associated symbiotic organisms (e.g., a human’s microbiome).
The horizontal derivative of current speed with distance in water. This is analogous to the “HORIZONTAL WIND SHEAR” keyword.
A horizontal variation in current speed within a flow.
The component of wind motion rising parallel to the plane of the horizon.

definition.ar: حيوان كبير من ذوات الأربع يمتطيه الإنسان أو يستخدمه للحمل أو لجر المركبات.
definition.en: A large animal with four legs which people ride on or use for carrying things or pulling vehicles.
Marine arthropods, usually classed as Merostomata, which have a broad crescent (horseshoe-shaped) cephalothorax.
A raised fault block bounded by normal faults or graben.

definition.ar: مخلفات صلبة حيوية وغير حيوية تفرزها المستشفيات وتتخلص منها، ولا ينتوى استخدامها بأي شكل آخر.
definition.en: Solid waste, both biological and non-biological, produced by hospitals and discarded and not intended for further use.
The amount of precipitation collected and measured per hour at a weather observing site.
waste from accommodation used purely for living purposes and which is disposed of via the normal mixed domestic refuse collection
definition.fr: déchets provenant des habitations et éliminés par l'intermédiaire de la collecte mixte normale des déchets ménagers

definition.en: The entire physical structure of an human being.
Monitoring and managing potentially harmful factors in the environment for human safety.
The effects, intentional or unintentional, beneficial or harmful, direct or indirect, which human activities have upon the environment and living things.

definition.ar: تغير عنيف مفاجئ ومدمر في البيئة بسبب الإنسان.
definition.en: Violent, sudden and destructive change in the environment caused by man.
Generally, some measure of the water vapor content of air.
As used by C. W. Thornthwaite in his 1948 climatic classification, an index of the degree of water surplus over water need at any given station.
A measure or indicator of some aspect of humidity.
The ratio of the mass of a variable atmospheric constituent to the mass of dry air.

definition.ar: المادة العضوية المتحللة إلى حد ما في التربة. وإلى جانب كون الدبال مصدرا لمعظم الأملاح المعدنية التي يحتاج إليها النبات، فإنه يحسن من نسيج التربة ويحتفظ بالماء، مما يقلل من فقد العناصر الغذائية عن طريق التسرب.
definition.en: The more or less decomposed organic matter in the soil. Besides being the source of most of the mineral salts needed by plants, humus improves the texture of the soil and holds water, so reducing the loss of nutrients by leaching.

definition.ar: عاصفة مدارية بالغة الشدة. أي رياح تصل سرعتها إلى أكثر من 73 ميلا في الساعة (117 كيلومتر في الساعة) تعتبر في قوة الإعصار.
definition.en: A tropical cyclone of great intensity; any wind reaching a speed of more than 73 miles per hour (117 kilometers per hour) is said to have hurricane force.
Severe cyclones, or revolving storms, originating over the equatorial regions of the earth, accompanied by torrential rain, lightning, and winds with a speed greater than 74 miles per hour.

definition.ar: فعل أو عملية إنتاج هجين حيواني أو نباتي عن طريق المزاوجة بين فردين غير متشابهين جينيا. والهجين من نوعين مختلفين من الأحياء يكون عادة عقيما.
definition.en: The act or process of producing hybrids that is an animal or plant resulting from a cross between genetically unlike individuals. Hybrids between different species are usually sterile.
Pertaining to the process by which water molecules are incorporated into existing crystal structures.

A form of erosion caused by the force of moving water currents rushing into a crack in the rockface.It is strong enough to loosen sediment along the river bed and banks. The water compresses the air in the crack, pushing it right to the back.
A measure of the readiness with which a liquid, such as water, flows through a solid, such as soil, in response to a given potential gradient.
Branch of engineering which applies the physical properties of fluids, such as flow and pressure, to the design and use of machinery, pumps, pipelines, etc.
Injection of water and other fluids through a well into geologic formations in order to increase the permeability of the rock units and thus permit natural gas or oil to be produced from them.

definition.ar: مجموعة كبيرة جدا من المركبات الكيماوية التي تتألف من الكربون والهيدروجين فقط.
definition.en: A very large group of chemical compounds composed only of carbon and hydrogen.

Interactions among groundwater, hydrocarbons, and rock properties of subsurface geological formations, affecting the potential of those formations to form, trap, and permit the passage and extraction of hydrocarbons.
Organic compounds composed entirely of carbon and hydrogen atoms.

definition.ar: محلول غاز كلوريد الهيدروجين في الماء، وهو سائل سام نفاذ الرائحة يكون مزيجا دائم الغليان عندما يصل إلى تركيز 20% في الماء. يستخدم على نطاق واسع ككاشف وفي التخليق العضوي وفي تحميض آبار النفط واختزال المواد الخام ومعالجة الأغذية وتنظيف المعادن والتخليل. يعرف أيضا باسم mautiatic acid.
definition.en: A solution of hydrogen chloride gas in water; a poisonous, pungent liquid forming a constant-boiling mixture at 20% concentration in water; widely used as a reagent, in organic synthesis, in acidizing oil wells, ore reduction, food processing, and metal cleaning and pickling. Also known as muriatic acid.

HCFCs, with one or more hydrogen-carbon bonds are slated to replace CFCs in most of the current applications. HCFCs are more unstable and subject to hydroxyl radical and ozone attack early in their gas phase career in the atmosphere. Therefore, their atmospheric lifetime is projected to be shorter and their chance of reaching the stratosphere decreased. [Spectator; v 272; p 9-11; 1994][New Scientist; v 141; p 6-7; 1994.]

definition.ar: تربية النباتات بدون تربة، وإنما في الرمل أو في الفيرميكليت أو غير ذلك من المواد المتحببة، باستخدام محلول سائل من العناصر الغذائية لتغذية النبات.
definition.en: Growing plants without soil but in sand or vermiculite or other granular material, using a liquid solution of nutrients to feed them.
any process that removes sulphur compounds by converting them to hydrogen sulphide, which is then easily extrated and destroyed
Principles of fluid dynamics applied to water bodies.

definition.ar: مصدر الطاقة المجاني المتجدد الذي يوفره سقوط الماء الذي يدير التوربينات. والطاقة المائية هي أهم مصادر الطاقة القابلة للتجدد بسبب كفاءتها العليا في الحفاظ على الطاقة. وهناك نوعان من محطات الطاقة الكهربية الهيدروليكية: أ) محطات نهرية تستخدم انسياب الماء ب) ومحطات التخزين (ذات الخزانات) حيث يمكن تنظيم تدفق الماء بمساعدة الخزان. وفي الأغلب تستغل المحطات الفروق الكبيرة في الارتفاعات كما في الشلالات الجبلية. وتتميز محطات الطاقة ذات الخزانات عموما بوجود قناطر وسدود ترابية أو من الخرسانة. وعلى الرغم من أن الطاقة المائية يمكن أن توصف عموما بأنها مقبولة بيئيا، فهناك بعض المشاكل، أ) تغيير مستوى المياه الجوفية وامتلاء قاع النهر بالركام. ب) خطر انهيار السدود. ج) ارتفاع الطلب على مساحات الأرض من أجل الخزان د) تناقص قيمة المناطق الترفيهية حولها وأحيانا ارتفاعها جزئيا. ونظرا لأن محطات الطاقة المائية حول العالم محدودة فإن الطلب العالمي على الطاقة يرتقع مما يعني أن نصيب الطاقة المائية في النهاية سوف ينخفض.
definition.en: The free renewable source of energy provided by falling water that drives the turbines. Hydropower is the most important of the regenerable energy sources because of its highest efficiency at the energy conversion. There are two types of hydroelectric power plants: a) run-of-river power plants for the use of affluent water; b) storage power plants (power stations with reservoir) where the influx can be regulated with the help of a reservoir. Mostly greater differences in altitudes are being used, like mountain creeks. Power stations with reservoirs are generally marked by barrages with earth fill dam or concrete dams. Though hydropower generally can be called environmentally acceptable, there exist also some problems: a) change of groundwater level and fill up of the river bed with rubble. b) Risk of dam breaks. c) Great demand for land space for the reservoir. d) Diminution, but partly also increase of value of recreation areas. As the hydropowers of the world are limited, the world energy demand however is rising, finally the share of hydropower will decrease.

The HFCs are a class of replacements for CFCs. Because they do not contain chlorine or bromine, they do not deplete the ozone layer. All HFCs have an ozone depletion potential of 0. Some HFCs have high GWPs (Global Warming Potentials). HFCs are numbered according to a standard scheme. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) provides more detailed information about HFCs on their web site.

definition.ar: غاز عديم اللون قابل للاشتعال وهو أخف العناصر وأكثرها شيوعا في الكون. يظهر أساسا في الماء وفي معظم المركبات الكيميائية ويستخدم في إنتاج النوشادر وغيره من الكيماويات، وفي هدرجة الدهون والزيوت، وفي اللحام.
definition.en: A flammable colourless gas that is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe. It occurs mainly in water and in most organic compounds and is used in the production of ammonia and other chemicals, in the hydrogenation of fats and oils, and in welding.

A toxic, colorless, strongly acidic gas (HCl) that dissolves readily in water to form hydrochloric acid. In the troposphere, hydrochloric acid can be produced from the reaction of nitric acid or sulfuric acid with sea-salt particles (NaCl). It is also involved in the formation of ammonium chloride aerosol. HCl is also the most abundant form of chlorine in an inorganic compound found in the stratosphere. Produced there predominantly from the reaction of Cl atoms with methane and molecular hydrogen, it acts as a temporary, relatively unreactive reservoir species for chlorine.
Hydrogen (H) is the lightest and most abundant chemical element. It is onlyfound in trace quantities in the atmosphere.

Hydrogen cyanide (HCN) was discovered by the Swedish chemist Carl Wilhelm Scheele in 1782, who prepared it from the pigment Prussian blue (hence its other name of prussic acid). There are many naturally occurring substances yielding cyanide in certain seeds, such as the pit of the wild cherry. It usually occurs in combination with plant sugars. The tuberous edible plant of the spurge family called cassava (also known as manioc, mandioc, or yuca) was used by primitive peoples to produce HCN for poison darts and arrows. HCN is produced by other plants, bacteria and fungi. Emissions from CN radicals are occasionally observed from lightning disturbed air. Hydrogen cyanide is produced by biomass burning since nitrogen in plant material is mostly present as amino acids and upon combustionthis nitrogen is emitted as a variety of compounds including NH3, NO, NO2, N2O,organic nitriles and nitrates. It is interesting to note that the atmospheric measurements of HCN reported by Zander et al. (1988) gave a mixing ratio for HCN in the Southern Hemisphere which was approximately 5% higher than that for the Northern Hemisphere. This may be due to biomass burning. There are many anthropogenic sources of compounds containing CN which can be released into the atmosphere. Cyanides are used in a variety of chemical processes including fumigation, case hardening of iron and steel, electroplating and in the concentration of ores. Hydrogen cyanide is used to prepare polyacrylonitrile fibres (known by the generic name of acrylic) synthetic rubber, plastics, and in gas masers to produce a wavelength of 3.34 mm. Hydrogen cyanide is a combustion product which is a human hazard during domestic and industrial fires and from tobacco smoking. Some catalytic converters in bad repair can produce large amounts of Hydrogen cyanide. Hydrogen cyanide is produced in large quantities for laboratory and commercial use by three principle methods: Treatment of sodium cyanide with sulphuric acid, catalytic oxidation of a methane-ammonia mixture, and decomposition of formamide (HCONH2).

Deuterium Oxide is a stable, non-radioactive isotopic form of water, containing 2 atoms of deuterium (D) and one atom of oxygen (2D2O), with DNA-labeling activity. Upon ingestion of deuterium oxide, 2H is incorporated into the deoxyribose moiety of DNA of newly divided cells. Rapidly dividing cells, as in the case of B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (B-CLL), can be labeled with deuterium oxide and measured using gas chromatography and/or mass spectrometry.
Hydrogen Fluoride (HF) is an important fluorine-containing compound formed fromthe breakdown of chlorofluorocarbons. Also a product of volcanic eruption.

Hydrogen gas is colorless, odorless, tasteless, flammable, and nontoxic. Hydrogen gas exists as a gas at ambient temperatures and atmospheric pressures. Hydrogen gas is the lightest gas known with a density approximately 0.07 that of air. The concentration of hydrogen gas in the atmosphere volume is 5.0 x 10-5%. Hydrogen is principally shipped and used in gaseous form for refineries, petrochemical companies for hydrotreating, catalytic reforming and hydrocracking. Hydrogen is also used in heat treating, metal production, welding, lasers, plastics, food production, and semiconductors.
The vertical and geographic distribution of hydrogen gas within the solid Earth.
A variant of a hydrogen atom with a different number of neutrons in its nucleus.
Used in long-term monitoring of ozone chemistry.Collected by the Global Greenhouse Gas Reference Network (GGGRN)
Used in long-term monitoring of ozone chemistryCollected by the Global Greenhouse Gas Reference Network (GGGRN)
The simple systematic name for water, H2O.
Hydrogen peroxide is a chemical compound with the formula H2O 2. In its pure form, it is a very pale blue[5] liquid, slightly more viscous than water.

definition.ar: غاز سام قابل للاشتعال له رائحة مميزة تشبه رائحة البيض الفاسد، يمكن الشعور به في الجو عند تخفيف قدره 0.002 ملج/لتر. يستخدم ككاشف في التحليل الكيميائي. شديد الخطورة، يمكن أن يصيب الإنسان بالانهيار أو الإغماء أو الموت بسبب فشل الجهاز التنفسي في غضون ثوان معدودة من استنشاقه مرة أو اثنتين. في حالة التركيز الخفيف يسبب تهيج الملتحمة والاأشية المخاطية. وقد يظهر الصداع والدوار والغثيان والإعياء على الإنسان بعد التعرض له.
definition.en: Flammable, poisonous gas with characteristic odour of rotten eggs, perceptible in air in a dilution of 0.002 mg/l. It is used as a reagent in chemical analysis; extremely hazardous; collapse, coma and death from respiratory failure may come within a few seconds after one or two inspirations; low concentrations produce irritation of conjunctiva and mucous membranes. Headache, dizziness, nausea, lassitude may appear after exposure.
Sediments composed of material precipitated chemically from seawater.
Study of subsurface waters and geologic aspects of surface waters.

definition.ar: حوض التصريف الخاص بمجرى مائي. 2) منطقة تشغلها بحيرة وحوض التصريف الخاص بها.
definition.en: 1) The drainage basin of a stream. 2) An area occupied by a lake and its drainage basin.

definition.ar: تشكيل أو ترتيب مسارات المجاري المائية الطبيعية في منطقة ما في صورة مخطط. وترتبط بالملامح المحلية الجيولوجية والجيومورفولوجية وبالتاريخ. تعد مرادفا لنمط الصرف.
definition.en: The configuration or arrangement in plan view of the natural stream courses in an area. It is related to local geologic and geomorphologic features and history. Synonym: drainage pattern.
Mapping water depth and the shape of the seafloor.

definition.ar: وصف التدفق من وإلى وحدة هيدرولوجية والتخزين فيها، وهذه الوحدة قد تكون حوض صرف أو مستجمعا جوفي أو منطقة من التربة أو بحيرة أو مستودعا. وكذلك العلاقة بين التبخر والهطول والسيل السطحي والتغير في مخزون المياه.
definition.en: An accounting of the inflow to, outflow from, and storage in a hydrologic unit such as a drainage basin, aquifer, soil zone, lake or reservoir; the relationship between evaporation, precipitation, runoff, and the change in water storage.

definition.ar: حركة الماء بين المحيطات وسطح الارض والغلاف الجوي عن طريق التبخر والهطول ونشاط الكائنات الحية، باعتبارها إحدى الدورات الحيوية الجيولوجية الكيميائية الكبرى. ففي كل يوم يتبخر الماء من البحار ويحمل في الهواء من البحار إلى ما فوق الأرض التي تتلقاه في صورة هطول، وأخيرا يعود من الأرض إلى البحر عبر الأنهار وبذلك تكتمل الدورة.
definition.en: The movement of water between the oceans, ground surface and atmosphere by evaporation, precipitation and the activity of living organisms, as one of the mayor biogeochemical cycles. Each day water evaporates from the oceans and is carried in the air from the sea over the land, which receives it as precipitation, and finally returns from the land to the sea through rivers, thus completing the cycle.

definition.ar: تغير عنيف مفاجئ ومدمر إما في جودة مياه الأرض أو في توزيع أو حركة المياه فوق سطح الأرض أو تحته أو في الغلاف الجوي.
definition.en: Violent, sudden and destructive change either in the quality of the earth's water or in the distribution or movement of water on land, below the surface or in the atmosphere.

definition.ar: السلوك المميز للماء المتعلق بحوض التصريف وإجمالي كميته. ويتحدد بقياس كمية سقوط المطر وكمية المخزون والتدفق السطحي والباطني وكمية النتح التبخري.
definition.en: The characteristic behaviour and the total quantity of water involved in a drainage basin, determined by measuring such quantities as rainfall, surface and subsurface storage and flow, and evapotranspiration.
Spatial and temporal variations of the components in a water budget.
Branch of earth science that deals with water as it occurs in the atmosphere, on the surface of the ground, and underground.

definition.ar: تحلل أو تغير مادة كيميائية بواسطة الماء. 2) في المحاليل المائية للمواد الموصلة للكهرباء يشير المصطلح إلى تفاعل الشوارد الموجبة مع الماء لتكوين قاعدة ضعيفة أو تفاعل الشوارد السالبة لتكوين حمض ضعيف.
definition.en: 1) Decomposition or alteration of a chemical substance by water. 2) In aqueous solutions of electrolytes, the reactions of cations with water to produce a weak base or of anions to produce a weak acid.
Particles in the atmosphere composed of water, e.g. ice, raindrops, snow, etc.
The hieracrchical (branch-like) pattern that is found within river and stream systems.
A given amount of time in which a river/stream system is active; i.e., water is passing through the system(s).

Consists of oxygenated compounds that are organic derivitives of hydrogenperoxide. These compounds are formed in the oxidation of hydrocarbons inrelatively clean air, where oxides of nitrogen are not abundant.

definition.ar: مياه الأرض، تمييزا لها عن الغلاف الصخري والغلاف الحيوي والغلاف الجوي. وتشمل مياه المحيطات ومياه الأنهار والبحيرات وغيرها من الأجسام المائية السطحية الموجودة بالقارات في صورة سائلة، وكذلك الجليد والثلج والأنهار الجليدية، والماء السائل والثلج وبخار الماء في المناطق المشبعة وغير المشبعة تحت سطح الأرض. كذلك تشمل حسب البعض، وإن كان البعض الآخر يستبعدها، الماء الموجود في الغلاف الجوي والذي يتكون من بخار الماء والسحب وجميع أشكال الهطول وهي لا تزال بعد في الغلاف الجوي.
definition.en: The waters of the Earth, as distinguished from the rocks (lithosphere), living things (biosphere), and the air (atmosphere). Includes the waters of the ocean; rivers, lakes, and other bodies of surface water in liquid form on the continents; snow, ice, and glaciers; and liquid water, ice, and water vapour in both the unsaturated and saturated zones below the land surface. Included by some, but excluded by others, is water in the atmosphere , which includes water vapour, clouds, and all forms of precipitation while still in the atmosphere.
The pressure in a fluid in hydrostatic equilibrium - that is , thedownward pressure at a point due solely to the weight of fluid in a columnof unit cross-sectional area.
Pertaining to hot-water vents formed on the ocean floor when seawater circulates through hot volcanic rock.
Pertaining to the fractures in the oceanic crust where superheated wateris ejected into the ocean, providing a source of minerals, and unusuallife forms.

Hydroxyl (OH) - an atom consisting of one hydrogen atom and one oxygen atom which does not normally exist in a stable form; this radical readily reacts with methane and carbon monoxide. The source of the hydroxyl radical in the atmosphere occurs primarily through the 1) photolysis of hydrogen peroxide, heat, and light and 2) the attack on water of an excited oxygen radical (created by the photolysis of ozone). [JAPCA; v39; 704; 1989] [Journal of Chemical Society; v85; 577; 1989.]

definition.ar: حشرات تشمل النحل والزنابير والنمل والذباب المنشاري، لها زوجان من الأجنحة الغشائية وعضو حامل للبيض متخصص في اللدغ أو النشر أو الطعن.
definition.en: Insects including bees, wasps, ants, and sawflies, having two pair of membranous wings and an ovipositor specialized for stinging, sawing or piercing.
High spectral resolution imagery by dividing light into many narrow, contiguous spectral bands across the electromagnetic (EM) spectrum, typically between visible and infrared wavelengths.
Multispectral imaging technique that records many bands of imagery at very narrow bandwidths.

Hypochlorous acid (HOCL) is a weak, unstable acid. Hypochlorous acid is also a minor component of the gas-phase inorganic chlorinebudget in the stratosphere. It is formed there largely from reaction of hydroperoxyl radicals (HO2) with chlorine monoxide (ClO) radicals, and from thehydrolysis of chlorine nitrate on stratospheric aerosols. It is subject to quite rapid photolysis in the sunlit atmosphere.

'Hypochlorous acid is also a minor component of the gas-phase inorganic chlorine budget in the stratosphere. It is formed there largely from reaction of hydroperoxyl radicals (HO2) with chlorine monoxide (ClO) radicals, and from the hydrolysis of chlorine nitrate on stratospheric aerosols. It is subject to quite rapid photolysis in the sunlit atmosphere.'

Hypoxia in aquatic systems refers to waters where thedissolved oxygen concentration is below 2 mg/L. Most organisms avoid, orbecome physiologically stressed, in waters with oxygen below thisconcentration. Also known as a dead zone, hypoxia can also kill marineorganisms which cannot escape the low-oxygen water, affecting commercialharvests and the health of impacted ecosystems.3. Rationale: Numerous researchers are studying hypoxia, the hypoxiczone, and its effect on fisheries. It is becoming a highly visible hottopic in the Gulf of Mexico and other regions as the onset of hypoxia islargely due to increased nutrient run off from agriculture practices in theMississippi River watershed. I think there needs to be a unifying keywordto link these datasets together for users to discover hypoxia related dataacross multiple organizations and programs.

In ocean and freshwater environments, hypoxic conditions occur when dissolved oxygen concentration is depleted to a certain low level below which aquatic organisms, especially immobile species such as oysters and mussels, endure severe stress or die.​​ Hypoxic conditions can occur naturally but are often the consequence of excessive nutrient input from human activities.
elevation and depth measurements of features of the Earth’s surface made with respect to sea level
The dense substance formed by the freezing of water to the solid state; it commonly occurs in the form of hexagonal crystals.
definition.ar: المادة الكثيفة التي تتكون من تجمد الماء ليصبح في الحالة الصلبة، يظهر عموما في صورة بللورات سداسية الشكل.

definition.en: dome-shaped glacier with radial flow, usually covering a highland area.
definition.fr: glacier en forme de dôme à écoulement radial, couvrant généralement une région montagneuse

definition.en: Trapped gases in ice-core bubbles are highly reliable records of atmospheric composition in reconstructing past climates.

An ice core is a section of ice drilled from a glacier or ice sheet. Ice deposits contain samples of the atmosphere at the time the ice formed; they also record seasonal fluctuations of temperature and dust. That's why ice cores are extremely valuable sources of paleoclimate data on the Earth's climate in the distant past. Researchers drill sections of ice cores hundreds of meters long and then match sections at different depths with particular eras in the Earth's past. These sections can then be analyzed for clues about atmospheric gases and temperatures from hundreds of thousands of years ago.

In geology, a proglacial lake is a lake formed either by the damming action of a moraine or ice dam during the retreat of a melting glacier, or by meltwater trapped against an ice sheet due to isostatic depression of the crust around the ice.
Ice that has been squeezed together, and in places, forced upwards and downwards. Some subdivisions of deformed ice are rafted ice, ridged ice, and hummocked ice.
Pertaining to the measurement and geographic extent of ice thickness on the continental land masses.
A measurement of the ice thickness below the waterline and often serves as a close proxy for total ice thickness.
The ice edge is the demarcation at any given time between open water andthe sea (can also refer to river and lake ice) whether fast or drifting.
Pertaining to the geographical extent of ice on continental land masses.
Floe refers to any relatively flat piece of ice 20 m or more across. Floes are subdivided according to horizontal extent: small, medium, big, vast, giant.

(Also called ice-crystal fog, frozen fog, frost fog, frost flakes, air hoar, rime fog, pogonip.) A type of fog, composed of suspended particles of ice, partly ice crystals 20 to 100 μm in diameter, but chiefly, especially when dense, droxtals 12–20 μm in diameter.It occurs at very low temperatures, and usually in clear, calm weather in high latitudes. The sun is usually visible and may cause halo phenomena. Ice fog is rare at temperatures warmer than -30°C, and increases in frequency with decreasing temperature until it is almost always present at air temperatures of -45°C in the vicinity of a source of water vapor. Such sources are the open water of fast-flowing streams or of the sea, herds of animals, volcanoes, and especially products of combustion for heating or propulsion. At temperatures warmer than -30°C, these sources can cause steam fog of liquid water droplets, which may turn into ice fog when cooled.

Sea ice is described by the area it covers, its thickness, its age, and its movement with the winds and ocean currents. Concentration is a unitless term that describes the relative amount of area covered by ice, compared to some reference area. Thus, concentration describes how much of a 25.0 kilometer by 25.0 kilometer (15.5 mile by 15.5 mile) box is covered by sea ice. Ice concentration typically is reported as a percentage (0 to 100 percent ice), a fraction from 0 to 1, or sometimes in tenths (0/10 to 10/10). Our Sea Ice Index products show ice concentration as a percentage. A value of 0 means there is no ice, while a value of 100 means the region is completely covered by ice.

Melt of the ice can occur at various stages: puddle, thaw holes, dried ice, rotten ice, flodded ice, and frozen puddle. Developing sea ice (or growth) takes on the following stages: New Ice, Youg Ice, First-Year Ice, Old Ice. Lake Ice development goes through the following stages: New Lake Ice, Thin Lake Ice, Medium Lake Ice, Thick Lake Ice, and Very Thick Lake Ice.
range of interdependent processes, including ocean circulation, temperature, weather, and the earth’s albedo that contribute to reducing the sea or land ice
definition.fr: ensemble de processus interdépendants, notamment la circulation océanique, la température, les conditions météorologiques et l'albédo de la Terre, qui contribuent à la réduction de la banquise ou des glaces terrestres

definition.en: Dense packs of icebergs and sea ice found in proglacial fjords
Dense packs of icebergs and sea ice found in proglacial fjords
Defined as the horizontal displacement of ice over an area.
Any particle that serves as a nucleus leading to the formation of ice crystals without regard to the particular physical processes involved in the nucleation.

definition.ar: مساحات كبيرة من الجليد الطافي، تظهر عادة في البحار القطبية، وتتألف من قطع منفصلة بعد أن تجمعت معا.
definition.en: Large areas of floating ice, usually occurring in polar seas, consisting of separate pieces that have become massed together.
A type of precipitation consisting of transparent or translucent pellets of ice, 5 mm or less in diameter.

The small-scale variation in the relief of the terrain surface (in thiscase the surface of the ice). Remote sensing instruments, such as radarand microwave sensors, have been able to detect the degree of roughness ofsea, lake, and river ice.
permanent layer of ice covering an extensive tract of land, especially a polar region
definition.fr: couche de glace permanante couvrant une très vaste étendue de terres, en particulier une région polaire

definition.en: speed of ice loss and most important indicator of ice sheet change
definition.fr: vitesse de la fonte des glaces et plus important indicateur de l'évolution des calottes glaciaires

definition.en: Scientists have adopted three general approaches to ice sheet mass balance measurement: comparing outflow and melt to snowfall accumulation (the mass budget method), observing changes in glacier elevation (volume change or geodetic method), and detecting changes in the Earth’s gravity field over the ice sheet (gravimetric method).

A continuous sheet of land ice that covers a very large area and moves outward in many directions. This type of ice mass is so thick as to mask the land surface contours, in contrast to the smaller and thinner highland ice. The continental glacier of Greenland is sometimes called the Inland Ice. This term is often used to describe the great ice masses that characterized the ice ages.
Portions of glaciers/ice sheets that are floating over the ocean.
Storms in which falling snow or rain freezes on contact with surfaces on the ground.

Ice Stupa is a form of glacier grafting technique that creates artificial glaciers, used for storing winter water (which otherwise would go unused) in the form of conical shaped ice heaps. During summer, when water is scarce, the Ice Stupa melts to increase water supply for crops.

Refers to the radiating skin temperature at the top of an ice layer (including snow cover or melt ponds). It is a critical indicator of energy exchange between the atmosphere and the ice. While ice melts at 0°C (32°F), its surface temperature can drop well below freezing depending on the surrounding environment.
Measurements of the temperature of the sea ice and surrounding seasurface temperature. These measurements are usually obtained from remotesensing satellites.
Ice Types is a general term applied to sea, river, and lake ice todescribe attributes such as age, stage of development or growth, orsurface feature.
Pertaining to the rate at which ice formations (glaciers, ice sheets, etc.)are moving.
Total cloud ice in the atmospheric column

definition.ar: كتلة جليدية ضخمة انفصلت عن الأرض لتطفو في البحر أو لتصير محتبسة في المياه الضحلة.
definition.en: A large mass of detached land ice floating in the sea or stranded in shallow water.
A piece of ice that has broken off from the end of a glacier that terminates inwater. Only about 10 percent of its mass is above the surface of the water.
Fossilized remains of the traces of animal activity from different geologic time periods including burrows, tracks, trails, borings, and other features found in sedimentary structures.
Branch of zoology concerned with the study of fish.
Interferometric comparison of radar reflectance imagery of the same area at different times to determine changes in the land surface, typically from a space-borne sensor.
An analysis and determination of the age of igneous rocks
Rock created by the solidification of molten magma.
The study and analysis of the various physical and optical properties of igneous rocks.
The vertical and geogrpahic distribution of igneous rock within the solid earth.
Rocks formed from melted rock that has cooled and solidified.
Pattern analysis of the shapes and textures of images to identify features and derive information about them.

definition.ar: استقبال مادة كالملوثات في البيئة من أي مصدر.
definition.en: The reception of material, such as pollutants, by the environment and from any source.

definition.ar: ضرر مترتب على التلوث الذي يأتي من مصدر محدد للانبعاثات.
definition.en: Damage caused by pollution from a distinct source of emission.

definition.ar: إجمالي كمية الانبعاثات التي تدخل إلى بيئة معينة.
definition.en: The total amount of immissions introduced in a given environment.

definition.ar: نظام في الجسم يساعد الكائن على مقاومة المرض، من خلال نشاط خلايا الدم المتخصصة أو الأجسام المضادة التي تولدها استجابة للتعرض الطبيعي أو التطعيم.
definition.en: A body system that helps an organism to resist disease, through the activities of specialised blood cells or antibodies produced by them in response to natural exposure or inoculation.
Branch of biology which studies the body's production of lymphocytes, antibodies, and macrophages in response to foreign substances or pathogenic organisms.
Impact of extraterrestrial objects such as asteroids, comets, and meteorites on Earth.

definition.ar: عناصر التحرك التي تسبب ضررا للبيئة المحيطة.
definition.en: Elements of an action which cause damage to the surrounding environment.

The importance value is the sum of relative density, relative dominance,and relative frequency for a species in the community. The larger theimportance value, the more dominant a species is in the particularcommunity.

Retrospective modification of the structure, format, packaging, or documentation of an existing scientific data resource to improve the likelihood of effective use of the data by individuals or organizations who did not create the data.

Impulse response is defined as the output of a linear time-invariant system when the input signal is a discrete impulse, represented mathematically as the coefficients of a finite impulse response filter.

definition.ar: ضوضاء تتسم بخلخلات عابرة قصير الأمد تتوزع أساسا توزيعا منتظما على الحزمة الموجية الفعالة لنظام الإرسال.
definition.en: Noise characterized by transient short-duration disturbances distributed essentially uniformly over the useful passband of a transmission system.
The component of air motion (wind) in the vertical within clouds that is strongly connected to cloud dynamics and microphysics.
The angle between the radar beam center and the normal to the local topography.

definition.ar: تلوث ناجم عن انسكاب النفط أو الإطلاق العارض لمواد مشعة أو استقبال مواد كيميائية مشتقة من الأنشطة الصناعية في كيانات مائية أو في الغلاف الجوي.
definition.en: Pollution caused by oil spills, by the accidental release of radioactive substances, by the immission in water bodies or in the atmosphere of chemical substances deriving from industrial activities.

definition.ar: حرق المخلفات الصلبة أو السائلة أو الغازية القابلة للاشتعال في ظروف خاضعة للتحكم لتوليد غازات. والبقايا الصلبة المحتوية على قدر قليل من المواد القابلة للاشتعال، أو قد لا تحتوي على أي منها، بهدف تقليص حجم مواد المخلفات الأصلية.
definition.en: The controlled burning of solid, liquid, or gaseous combustible wastes to produce gases and solid residues containing little or no combustible material in order to reduce the bulk of the original waste materials.

definition.ar: أي مادة صلبة أو شبه صلبة تخلفت عن معالجة داخل جهاز مصمم لتقليل حجم المخلفات بحرقها.
definition.en: Any material, solid or semisolid, left after processing in a device designed to reduce waste volume by combustion.

In general, solar radiation received at the earth's surface. The amount of direct solar radiation incident upon a unit horizontal surface at a specific level on or above the surface of the earth. Incoming solar radiation is solar radition that has not been scattered or absorbed.

Refers to amount (increased or decreased) of cloud fraction, which is the measurement used to determine how much of the Earth is covered by clouds. The measurement is important because clouds play a large role in regulating the amount of energy that reaches the Earth from the sun as well as the amount of energy that the Earth reflects and emits back into space.

A scientific tool used to identify and classify water pollution problems. An Index of Biotic Integrity (IBI) associates anthropogenic influences on a water body with biological activity in the water body, and is formulated using data developed from biosurveys.

definition.ar: جسم مائي يقع بين قارة أفريقيا والقارة القطبية الجنوبية وقارة آسيا وقارة أستراليا ويشتمل على خليج البنغال شرقا والبحر العربي (مع البحر الأحمر وخليج عدن والخليج العربي) غربا ويحتوي على العديد من الجزر وسلاسل الجزر مثل أندامان ونيكوبار وسيشيل.
definition.en: A body of water between the continents of Africa, Antarctica, Asia and Australia including the Bay of Bengal in the east and the Arabian Sea (with the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden and the Persian Gulf) in the west, and containing several islands and island chains, such as the Andaman, Nicobar and Seychelles.

A species whose presence, absence, or relative well-being in a given environment is a sign of the overall health of its ecosystem. By monitoring the condition and behavior of an indicator species, scientists can determine how changes in the environment are likely to affect other species that are more difficult to study.
Forests which are native to a given area.
Indigenous Species or native species is a term applied to a species thatoccurs naturally in an area, and therefore, one that has not beenintroduced by humans accidentally or intentionally.
Indigenous Vegetation or native vegetation is applied to a species thatoccurs naturally in an area, and therefore, one that has not beenintroduced by humans accidentally or intentionally.
emissions that are a consequence of the activities of the reporting entity, but occur at sources owned or controlled by another entity
Metalloid element with symbol In and atomic number 49

definition.ar: عملية تستخدم نظاما طبيعيا أو جهازا ميكانيكيا لجمع أو معالجة أو طرد أو استرداد المخلفات المائية من مسكن معين دون استخدام شبكات الصرف الصحي العامة أو منشأة مركزية للمعالجة.
definition.en: The process of using a natural system or mechanical device to collect, treat and discharge or reclaim wastewater from an individual dwelling without the use of community-wide sewers or a centralised treatment facility.

definition.ar: ملوثات كيماوية أو فيزيائية أو حيوية موجودة في الهواء داخل المباني وغيرها من الأماكن المغلقة التي يقطنها الإنسان. وينشأ هذا التلوث عن تدخين التبغ وعن استخدام مبيدات الآفات وعوامل التنظيف والغازات المطلقة من مواد البناء ومن السجاد والمنتجات المنزلية، إلخ.
definition.en: Chemical, physical or biological contaminants in the air inside buildings and other enclosed spaces occupied by humans. This pollution can arise from tobacco smoke, pesticides, cleaning agents, gases released from building materials, rugs, household products, etc.

air pollution that contains a range of health-damaging pollutants, such as small particles and carbon monoxide (CO), and levels of particulate pollutants that can many times be higher than accepted guideline values for indoor spaces
definition.fr: pollution de l'air qui contient de nombreux polluants nocifs pour la santé, tels que des particules fines et du monoxyde de carbone (CO), et des niveaux de particules polluantes qui peuvent être beaucoup plus élevés que les valeurs de référence communément acceptées pour les espaces intérieurs

definition.en: Seismic activity such as earthquakes and tremors of low magnitude resulting from human activity that altered crustal stresses and strains on local faults and fractures.

definition.ar: أي محصول يعطي مواد تدخل في العمليات الصناعية مثل فول الصويا والقطن (التيل والبذور) والكتان والتبغ.
definition.en: Any crop that provides materials for industrial processes and products such as soybeans, cotton (lint and seed), flax, and tobacco.

definition.ar: التخلص من أي مخلفات ناجمة عن عمليات التصنيع أو المعالجة التي تقوم بها الوكالة أو الجهة التي أفرزتها.
definition.en: The disposal of any waste generated by a manufacturing or processing process by the agency or body which produced it.

definition.ar: مواد يتم التخلص منها عموما عقب العمليات الصناعية أو المشتقة من عمليات التصنيع.
definition.en: Materials generally discarded from industrial operations or derived from manufacturing processes.

definition.ar: ملوثات محمولة غازيا يتم طردها في الغلاف الجوي من مداخن المصانع.
definition.en: Gas-borne pollutants discharged into the atmosphere from smokestacks of industrial plants.

definition.ar: أي إطلاق يشبه الدخان أو البخار يأتي من أي مواد، وخاصة المواد ذات الطبيعة أو الرائحة ضارة، والذي ينجم عن العمليات التجارية أو عمليات التصنيع.
definition.en: Any smokelike or vaporous exhalation from matters or substances, especially of an odorous or harmful nature, which result from trading, commercial or manufacturing processes.

definition.ar: ضوضاء تتولد عن الأنشطة الصناعية بالمصانع.
definition.en: Noise produced by industrial plants activities.

definition.ar: نباتات تستخدم في الصناعة كالقطن والكتان والقنب والفول السوداني، إلخ.
definition.en: Plants employed in industry, e.g. cotton, flax, hemp, peanuts, etc.

definition.ar: التلوث الناجم عن العمليات الصناعية والتصنيع.
definition.en: Pollution as a result of industrial processes and manufacturing.

definition.ar: تدابير أو تقنيات تطبق لتقليل خطر الإصابة أو الفقد أو الخطر على الأشخاص أو الممتلكات أو البيئة في أي منشأة أو مكان يتعلق بتصنيع أو إنتاج السلع أو الخدمات ومعالجتها.
definition.en: Measures or techniques implemented to reduce the risk of injury, loss and danger to persons, property or the environment in any facility or place involving the manufacturing, producing and processing of goods or merchandise.

definition.ar: طمي ناجم عن عمليات الإنتاج الصناعي أو التحويلي.
definition.en: Sludge produced as a result of industrial production processes or manufacturing.

definition.ar: مواد من المخلفات المتبقية من العمليات الصناعية أو المشتقة من عمليات التصنيع التحويلي، قد تكون صلبة أو على هيئة طمي (مواد صلبة رطبة) أو مخلفات سائلة، وقد تعتبر خطرة أو غير خطرة.
definition.en: Waste materials discarded from industrial operations, or derived from manufacturing processes; may be solid, sludge (wet solids) or liquid wastes and may or may not be considered hazardous.

definition.ar: مخلفات غازية عن عمليات التصنيع التحويلي وغيرها من العمليات الصناعية التي قد تتم معالجتها وإطلاقها أو معالجتها وإعادة استخدامها أو إطلاقها بدون معالجة.
definition.en: Waste gases resulting from manufacturing and other industrial processes which may be treated and released, treated and reused or released without treatment.

definition.ar: مخلفات مائية ناجمة عن العمليات الصناعية أو التصنيع التحويلي، قد يتم التخلص منها بصورة منفصلة أو من خلال شبكات الصرف الصحي أو المشترك.
definition.en: Waste water that results from industrial processes and manufacturing. It may either be disposed of separately or become part of the sanitary or combined sewage.
treatment of water discharged after being used in, or produced by, industrial processes and which is of no further immediate value to these processes

Use of water for industrial purposes such as fabrication, processing, washing, and cooling, and including such industries as steel, chemical and allied products, paper and allied products, mining, and petroleum refining.

definition.ar: نفايات لم تتعرض لأي تحويل فيزيائي أو كيميائي أو حيوي يذكر عند التخلص منها في موقع للطمر..
definition.en: Wastes that do not undergo any significant physical, chemical, or biological transformations when deposited in a landfill.

definition.ar: غزو طفيلي تتعرض له المحاصيل. في الفقاريات، نجد الكثير من آفات المحاصيل خصوصا في رتبة القوارض، كما نجدها بين الطيور. أما في اللافقاريات، فهناك أنواع معينة من معديات الأرجل وعدد كبير من الديدان الاسطوانية في طائفة السلكيات التي تؤذي المحاصيل. وأكثر أنواع آفات المحاصيل تنوعا وعددا هي المفصليات وتضم الحشرات والعناكب وبعض أنواع الديدان الألفية والقشريات. وتتراوح الأمراض التي تنقلها بين الأمراض الفيروسية والبكتيرية وأمراض التغذية إلى الأمراض الفطرية والبيئية والأمراض غير المحددة. وتقدر منظمة الأغذية والزراعة أن الخسائر السنوية العالمية الناجمة عن آفات المحاصيل وأمراضها تبلغ نحو 20-25% مما يمكن أن يكون عليه الإجمالي العالمي من إنتاج المحاصيل الغذائية.
definition.en: Invasion of crop by parasites. Among vertebrate animals, many crop pests are mammals, especially in the order of rodents and birds. Among invertebrates, certain species of gastropods and a large number of roundworms from the class of nematodes harm crops. The most varied and numerous species of crop pests are arthropods-insects, arachnids and some species of millipedes and crustaceans. Diseases vary from viral, bacterial, and nutritional to fungal, environmental and non-specific. The FAO has estimated that annual worldwide losses done by plant pests and diseases amount to approximately 20-25% of the potential worldwide yield of food crops.

definition.ar: أغذية تلوثت وتدهورت بفعل نوع ما من الآفات.
definition.en: Food that has been contaminated and deteriorated by some kind of pest.

definition.ar: تحرك الماء من سطح التربة ليغوص في الأرض.
definition.en: Movement of water through the soil surface into the ground.
Amount of water that infiltrates the subsurface soil and rocks.
Amount of water that infiltrates the subsurface soil and rocks in a single period.
The rate at which rain/snow/water seeps into the subsurface soil and rock.

definition.ar: ماء غير ماء الصرف الذي يصل إلى نظام الصرف الصحي (بما في ذلك وصلات خدمة المجارير) من عدة مصادر كمسارب أسطح المباني والأقبية والساحات والمناطق العامة، والماء المنصرف من الينابيع ومناطق المستنقعات وأغطية البالوعات ونقاط التقاطع بين نظم صرف مياة العواصف والصرف الصحي وأحواض تجميع المياه وأبراج التبريد ومياه العواصف والسيل السطحي ومياه غسيل الشوارع أو الصرف، وإن كان لا يقتصر على هذه المصادر فقط. ويلاحظ أن التدفق لا يشمل مياه الرشح ويختلف عنها. 2) فعل التدفق نفسه، أو تدفق النفايات السائلة إلى الأنهار.
definition.en: 1) Water other than wastewater that enters a sewer system (including sewer service connections) from sources such as, but not limited to, roof leaders, cellars drains, yard drains, area drains, drains from springs and swampy areas, manhole covers, cross connections between storm sewers and sanitary sewers, catch basins, cooling towers, storm waters, surface runoff, street wash waters, or drainage. Inflow does not include, and is distinguished from, infiltration. 2) Action of flowing in; an inflow of effluent into a river.
Design of conceptual, logical, and physical information system components (both data and software) to support effective maintenance, integration, or use of the data.
Sciences dealing with the compilation, processing, classification, display, transmission, storage, and retrieval of recorded knowledge.
Design, deployment, and maintenance of computing systems that support creation, maintenance, and use of scientific information.
Use for the design and development of information systems. Do not use for general cases in which information systems are part of the activity.

Methods for ensuring that information systems are used for their intended purpose by those entitled to use them and that the information they contain retains its integrity and, where appropriate, confidentiality.
Information-related concerns on which people focus their work in support of scientific investigations and research.
The amount of infrared radiation transferred across a given unit of surface area in a given unit of time.
A reproduction of an object by imaging the infrared radiation coming from the object or reflected by the object.

Method of remote sensing in which optical sensors produce visible representations of infrared rays or radiated heat from the observed objects and the temperature variations are represented by different colors in the image.
In radiometery, a measure of the intrinsic radiant intensity emitted by a radiator in a given direction. Radiance is measured in watts per square meter and steradian. Units: W·sr^−1·m^−2

definition.ar: إشعاع مغناطيسي إلكتروني تتراوح أطواله الموجية ما بين 0.75 و0.8 ميكرومتر إلى 1000 ميكرومتر.
definition.en: Electron magnetic radiation whose wavelengths lie in the range from 0.75 or 0.8 micrometer to 1000 micrometers.
The portion of the electromagnetic spectrum lying between the extreme of the visible wavelengths and the shortest microwaves (approximately 0.70 to 100 micrometers, respectively).

definition.ar: اهتزاز الهواء بذبذبات منخفضة للغاية بحيث لا تدركها الأذن البشرية كصوت، وتكون أقل من 15 هرتز تقريبا.
definition.en: Vibrations of the air at frequencies too low to be perceived as sound by the human ear, below about 15 hertz.

The measurement and mapping of underwater terrain of inland water bodies such as lakes, rivers, reservoirs, and streams. Typically conducted through bathymetric surveys that record water-depth and bed topography beneath the water surface.

definition.ar: مناطق لصيد الأسماك في البحيرات أو الجداول المائية، إلخ.
definition.en: Fishing grounds located in lakes, streams, etc.
Stocks of fish available to be taken in lakes, streams, ponds, rivers, and other inland bodies of water.

definition.ar: بحيرة أو نهر أو غير ذلك من الأجسام المائية التي تقع بأكملها داخل حدود دولة ما.
definition.en: A lake, river, or other body of water wholly within the boundaries of a state.

A narrow body of water between islands or leading inland from a larger body of water, often leading to an enclosed body of water, such as a sound, bay, lagoon or marsh. In sea coasts an inlet usually refers to the actual connection between a bay and the ocean and is often called an 'entrance' or a recession in the shore of a sea, lake or river.

The solid interior part of the earth's core, presumed to be composed principally of iron with an alloy of about 10 percent oxygen, sulfur, or nickel, or perhaps some combination of these three elements. The inner core is about 1221 kilometers thick.

Carbon species that are not hydrocarbons or hydrocarbon derivatives.Variables such as dissolved inorganic carbon (DIC) or particulateinorganic carbon (PIC) are included as detailed variables under inorganiccarbon.
Dissolved or particulate substances that are not hydrocarbons or hydrocarbon derivatives.

definition.ar: ملوث من أصل معدني وليس ذا تركيب كربوني أساسا.
definition.en: A pollutant of mineral origin and not of basically carbon structure.

definition.ar: مركبات كيميائية لا تحتوي على الكربون كعنصر أساسي فيها (باستثناء الكربونات وأملاح السيانيد والسيانات) أي كل مادة غير ما في الحيوان والنبات.
definition.en: Chemical compounds that do not contain carbon as the principal element (excepting carbonates, cyanides, and cyanates), that is, matter other than plant or animal.

definition.ar: طائفة من المفصليات تتميز عادة بجسمها المقسم إلى فصوص، وبطبقة خارجية تكسوها من الكيتين، وزوج من الأعين المركبة وزوج من قرون الاستشعار وثلاثة أزواج من الأعضاء الفمية وزوجين من الأجنحة.
definition.en: A class of the Arthropoda typically having a segmented body with an external, chitinous covering, a pair of compound eyes, a pair of antennae, three pairs of mouthparts, and two pairs of wings.

definition.ar: أي ثدييات مشيمية من رتبة آكلات الحشرات، تتميز عادة بصغر حجمها وأسنانها البسيطة وتتغذى على اللافقاريات. وتتضمن هذه المجموعة الزبابات والخلد والقنافذ.
definition.en: Any placental mammal of the order Insectivora, being typically small, with simple teeth, and feeding on invertebrates. The group includes shrews, moles, and hedgehogs.

Small arthropod animals of the class Insecta with bodies in 3 segments (head, thorax, and abdomen). They have 3 pairs of legs, 2 antennae, and usually one or two pairs of wings. Includes flies, mosquitoes, beetles, butterflies, bees, crickets, and dragonflies.

definition.ar: مادة غير قادرة على تكوين محلول خصوصا في الماء.
definition.en: Substance incapable of forming a solution, especially in water.
Includes the design and development of software for a particular instrument.

definition.ar: مناطق مخصصة للحفاظ على أنواع معينة من الحيوانات والنباتات أو الاثنين معا، وحمايتها. وتختلف المحمية الطبيعية المتكاملة عن المتنزهات الوطنية التي تعد إلى حد كبير مكان عاما للترفيه، حيث تقام المحمية الطبيعية المتكاملة حصريا لحماية الأنواع الحية في ذاتها دون غرض آخر. وقد صارت الأنواع المهددة بالانقراض توضع شيئا فشيئا في محميات طبيعية للحيلولة دون انقراضها. كما تعتبر المحميات الطبيعية مكانا للمزيد من الكائنات المختلفة للراحة والتكاثر أو قضاء فصل الشتاء.
definition.en: Areas allocated to preserve and protect certain animals and plants, or both. They differ from national parks, which are largely a place for public recreation, because they are provided exclusively to protect species for their own sake. Endangered species are increasingly being kept in nature reserves to prevent them from extinction. Nature reserves also serve as a place for more plentiful species to rest, breed or winter.

definition.ar: طريقة منهجية شاملة للسيطرة على الآفات باستخدام بيولوجية وسلوك الحشرة أو القارض للعثور على أقل طرق السيطرة سمية وبأدنى التكاليف.
definition.en: A systematic, comprehensive approach to pest control that uses the insect's or rodent's own biology and behaviour to find the least toxic control methods at the lowest cost.

definition.ar: نظام متخصص لتربية الحيوانات يتم فيه وضع الحيوانات بالداخل وإطعامها بمواد غذائية مركزة مع كثرة استخدام العقاقير للسيطرة على الأمراض التي تعد خطرا دائما يهدد الحيوانات في مثل هذه الظروف.
definition.en: Specialized system of breeding animals where the livestock are kept indoors and fed on concentrated foodstuffs, with frequent use of drugs to control diseases which are a constant threat under these conditions.

definition.ar: الزراعة التي يتم فيها تحقيق أقصى استغلال ممكن للأرض بزرع المحاصيل متقاربة من بعضها البعض أو زرع عدة محاصيل في السنة الواحدة أو باستخدام كميات كبيرة من المخصبات.
definition.en: Farming in which as much use is made of the land as possible by growing crops close together or by growing several crops in a year or by using large amounts of fertilizers.

definition.ar: تعزيز نشاط مبيدات الآفات عند استخدامها مع غيرها.
definition.en: The enhancement of activity of pesticides when they are used in combination with others.
Acoustic technique for determining depths or creating backscatter imagery in a wide swath of seafloor or lakebed centered below the instrument platform.

definition.ar: ضوضاء تحدث على فترات منتظمة أو غير منتظمة.
definition.en: Noise occurring at regular or irregular intervals.
Pertaining to channels that experience seasonal water flow and may not have flowing surface water during dry periods.

definition.ar: التحرر من الخطر أو خاصية درء الخطر أو الضرر عن الأشخاص أو العقارات أو البيئة المشتركة عبر الحدود الدولية في حالة واحدة أو أكثر. ومن ثم يعني أيضا الجهود المشتركة لدولة أو أكثر لتحقيق هذه الحالة والحفاظ عليها.
definition.en: Freedom from danger or the quality of averting risk of harm to persons, property or the environment shared across one or more national boundaries; consequently, the combined efforts of more than one nation to achieve or preserve that state.

definition.ar: النظم الإيكولوجية المتعارف على أهميتها على المستوى الدولي والتي تكون محمية في بعض الحالات بالمعاهدات الدولية.
definition.en: Ecosystems whose importance is recognised at international level and which are, in some cases, protected by international conventions.

definition.ar: المنطقة الواقعة بين اليابسة والبحر التي تتعرض بصفة دورية للهواء بفعل حركة المد والجزر البحري. لذلك تضطر الكائنات البحرية التي تعيش في منطقة المد إلى التكيف مع فترات التعرض للهواء والأمواج التي تخلقها الرياح، مما يجعل هذه المناطق أقسى المواطن البحرية من الناحية الفيزيائية. 2) المنطقة الساحلية بين أعلى وأدنى منسوب المد والجزر.
definition.en: 1) The area between land and sea which is regularly exposed to the air by the tidal movement of the sea. Marine organisms that inhabit the intertidal zones have to adapt to periods of exposure to air and to the waves created by wind, which makes it the most physically demanding of the marine habitats. 2) The shore zone between the highest and lowest tides.

definition.ar: حيوانات نقلت بفعل الإنسان إلى أراض أو مياه لم تكن تعيش فيها من قبل، على الأقل خلال العصور التاريخية. هذا النقل لأنواع الكائنات ينطوي على عنصر المخاطرة إن لم يكن الخطر الشديد لأن الأنواع المنقولة حديثا قد تصبح بمثابة طفيليات أو أمراض أو قد تحمل الطفيليات والأمراض، حسب علاقاتها وسماتها النوعية البينية، أو تفترس الكائنات الأصلية في المنطقة، أو تكشف عن تفاعلات سامة، أو قد تنافس بشدة الأنواع والمجتمعات الموجودة أو تؤثر عليها بصورة سلبية.
definition.en: Animals which have been translocated by human agency into lands or waters where they have not lived previously, at least during historic times. Such translocation of species always involves an element of risk if not of serious danger. Newly arrived species, depending on their interspecific relationships and characteristics, may act as or carry parasites or diseases, prey upon native organisms, display toxic reactions, or be highly competitive with or otherwise adversely affect native species and communities.
