definition.ar: نباتات نقلت بفعل الإنسان إلى أرض أو مياه لم تكن تعيش فيها من قبل، على الأقل خلال العصور التاريخية. هذا النقل ينطوي دائما على عنصر المخاطرة إن لم يكن الخطر الشديد لأن الأنواع المنقولة حديثا قد تكون شديدة التنافس مع الأنواع أو المجتمعات الأصلية أو قد تؤثر عليها بصورة سلبية، وبعضها قد يصبح إزعاجا لمجرد العبء الزئد الذي يضيفه. وقد تصبح هذه النباتات عرضة لتغيرات جينية سريعة في البيئة الجديدة. وكثير من الإدخالات الضارة تمت على يد أشخاص غير مؤهلين لتوقع التفاعل الإيكولوجي التالي الذي غالبا ما يكون معقدا. من ناحية أخرى، فإن الكثير من النباتات المدخلة إلى بيئات معدلة أو متدهورة قد تكون أفيد من الأنواع الأصلية في السيطرة على التآكل أو في القيام بوظائف إيجابية أخرى.
definition.en: Plants which have been translocated by human agency into lands or waters where they have not lived previously, at least during historic times. Such translocation of species always involves an element of risk if not of serious danger. Newly arrived species may be highly competitive with or otherwise adversely affect native species and communities. Some may become a nuisance through sheer overabundance. They may become liable to rapid genetic changes in their new environment. Many harmful introductions have been made by persons unqualified to anticipate the often complex ecological interaction which may ensue. On the other hand many plants introduced into modified or degraded environments may be more useful than native species in controlling erosion or in performing other positive functions.
Amount of seawater that moves into fresh water aquifer.
The speed at which seawater moves into the fresh water aquifer within certain time period.
Flooding, by the rise and spread of water, of a land surface that is not normally submerged.
Amount of water that covers an area during flooding.
Number of times a surface is covered with water in a single period.
The level of the water that covers an area during flooding.

Plant, animal, or microbe species that is non-native (or alien) to the ecosystem under consideration and whose introduction causes or is likely to cause economic or environmental harm, or harm to human health.

An iterative approach to estimate the form and characteristics of a physical system explained by observations or measurements. Frequently used to determine a subsurface geological structure from measurements of physical properties obtained at or near the earth's surface.

definition.ar: تبدل في الاتجاه المعتاد لعملية معينة كما يحدث عن تغير كثافة الماء عند درجة 4 مئوية.
definition.en: A reversal in the usual direction of a process, as in the change of density of water at 4° C.
The height of the layer in which air temperature increases withaltitude, representing an 'inversion' of the typical temperature decreasewith height in the troposphere.

definition.ar: طبقة الغلاف الجوي التي يحدث خلالها الانقلاب.
definition.en: The atmosphere layer through which an inversion occurs.

definition.ar: أي حيوان ليس له عمود فقري،وتشمل جميع أنواع الكائنات المصنفة على أنها ليست فقاريات.
definition.en: Any animal lacking a backbone, including all species not classified as vertebrates.
Branch of paleontology which deals with fossil animals without backbones.
Branch of biology dealing with animals having no backbones or spinal columns.
Animals having no backbone or spinal column, such as insects, mollusks, crustaceans, worms, and similar organisms.

definition.ar: عنصر هالوجيني لافلزي، تتميز رقائقه أو حبيباته السامة الأكالة داكنة اللون بأنها قابلة للتسامي المباشر. لا يذوب في الماء ولكنه قابل للذوبان في المذيبات الشائعة. يستخدم كمبيد للجراثيم أو كمطهر. كما يستخدم في صنع الأصباغ والألوان والعقاقير الطبية، وفي الحفر بأسلوب الليثوجراف، وكعامل مساعد وكاشف تحليلي.
definition.en: A nonmetallic halogen element; the poisonous, corrosive dark plates or granules are readily sublimed; insoluble in water, soluble in common solvents; used as germicide and antiseptic, in dyes, tinctures, and pharmaceuticals, in engraving lithography, and as a catalyst and analytical reagent.

definition.ar: الذرة المشحونة إلكترونيا أو مجموعة الذرات المتكونة بسبب فقد أو اكتساب إلكترون أو أكثر.
definition.en: An electrically charged atom or group of atoms formed by the loss or gain of one or more electrons.

The process in which a neutral atom or molecule is given a net electricalcharge. The atomic process in which ions are produced by removing one or moreelectrons from an atom, ion, or molecule, typically be collisions with atoms orelectrons (collisional ionization), or by interaction with electromagneticradiation (photo-ionization). Reference: the Cambridge Encyclopedia od the Sun, The Cambridge UniversityPress Cambridge, CB2, 2RU, UK, 2001.

definition.ar: عملية تبادل الأيونات بين محلول ومادة صلبة غير قابلة للذبان، عادة ما تكون نوعا من أنواع الراتينج.
definition.en: The process in which ions are exchanged between a solution and an insoluble solid, usually a resin.

An atom (or molecule) which has become charged as a result of gaining or losingone or more orbiting electrons. A completely ionized atom is one stripped ofall its electrons. Heavy ions are those ionized particles at high energy (MeVrange). Flux is the rate of flow through a reference surface, measured inparticles per unit area.

definition.ar: إشعاع قادر على إكساب الذرات طاقة تكفي لإزالة الإلكترونات منها. وفي هذه الحالة تصبح الذرات أكثر قابلية للتفاعل، بحيث يقوم الإشعاع المؤين بزيادة النشاط الكيميائي وبهذه الطريقة يولد آثارا حيوية منها الآثار المتعلقة بالتغيرات التي تحدث في الدنا. وتعتبر الأشعة السينية وأشعة جاما هي الموجات الكهرومغناطيسية الوحيدة التي تسبب التأين في المادة الحيوية.
definition.en: Radiation that is capable of energizing atoms sufficiently to remove electrons from them. In this state atoms become more reactive, so that ionizing radiation increases chemical activity and in this way produces biological effects, including effects that involve alterations induced in DNA. X-rays and gamma-rays are the only electromagnetic waves that cause ionization in biological material.

definition.ar: منطقة في الغلاف الجوي للأرض تمتد من ارتفاع 60 إلى 1000 كيلومتر تقريبا فوق سح الأرض وتتسم بارتفاع تركيز الإلكترونات الحرة المتولدة نتيجة دخول الإشعاع المؤين إلى الغلاف الجوي من الفضاء.
definition.en: A region of the earth's atmosphere, extending from about 60 to 1000 kilometers above the earth's surface, in which there is a high concentration of free electrons formed as a result of ionizing radiation entering the atmosphere from space.

Refers to dynamic processess of the Earth's ionosphere and solar magnetosphere triggered by solar events. The magnetosphere is the magnetic cavity surroundingthe earth, carved out of the passing solar wind by virtue of the geomagnetic field, which prevents, or at least impedes, the direct entry of the solar wind plasma into the cavity. The ionosphere is the region of the earth's upper atmosphere containing a small percentage of free electrons and ions produced byphotoionization of the constituents of the atmosphere by solar ultraviolet radiation at very short wavelengths (l.t.1000 angstroms). The ionosphere significantly influences radiowave propagation of frequencies less than about 30 MHz.

Pertaining to the measurement of various electrostatic ally charged compounds found in ice cores. Ions can be analyzed to infer human, biological, and volcanic activity, as well as ocean water conditions.
Metal element with symbol Ir and atomic number 77

definition.ar: معدن فلزي قابل للسحب والطرق والمغنطة ذو لون أبيض فضي يوجد أساسا في الهيماتيت والماجنيتيت. يستخدم على نطاق واسع في الأغراض الإنشائية والهندسية.
definition.en: A malleable ductile silvery-white ferromagnetic metallic element occurring principally in haematite and magnetite. It is widely used for structural and engineering purposes.

definition.ar: قطع نفايات أو مهملات مصنوع من الحديد المطاوع (خردة الحديدة المطاوع) يمكن إعادة استخدامها للدرفلة أو التشكيل.
definition.en: Waste pieces or disused articles of wrought iron (wrought-iron scrap) suitable for reworking for rolling or forging.

Incoming radiant energy incident upon a particular area. In the water, thiscan be measured as downwelling irradiance at various wavelengths. Suchmeasurements of downwelling irradiance are included as detailedvariables.

definition.ar: تزويد الأرض بالماء حتى يشتد عود المحاصيل والنباتات.
definition.en: 1) To supply land with water so that crops and plants will grow or grow stronger.

definition.ar: الزراعة المعتمدة على التوزيع والتطبيق الاصطناعي للماء على الأراضي القابلة للزراعة لبدء النمو النباتي والمحافظة عليه.
definition.en: Farming based on the artificial distribution and application of water to arable land to initiate and maintain plant growth.

definition.ar: كتلة أرضية خاصة الكتل الأضغر حجما من القارات، والمحاطة بالماء من جميع الجهات.
definition.en: A land mass, especially one smaller than a continent, entirely surrounded by water.
Pertaining to the chains of volcanic islands that form above subduction zoneson the overriding plate.

definition.ar: نظم إيكولوجية فريدة وهشة بسبب تطور الحياة النباتية والحيوانية فيها في إطار عزلة نسبية. كثير من الجزر النائية بها بعض من أندر الأنواع النباتية في العالم، وبعضها به أنواع من النباتات والحيوانات غير موجودة في أي مكان آخر تطورت بطريقة متخصصة في ظل الحماية من المنافسة الشرسة التي تواجهها الأنواع الأخرى على اليابسة الرئيسية.
definition.en: Unique but fragile and vulnerable ecosystems due to the fact that the evolution of their flora and fauna has taken place in relative isolation. Many remote islands have some of the most unique flora in the world; some have species of plants and animals that are not found anywhere else, which have evolved in a specialized way, sheltered from the fierce competition that species face on mainland.
Communities of living organisms on islands.
Tracts of land smaller than a continent, surrounded by the water of an ocean sea, lake, or stream.

definition.ar: مركبان أو أكثر لهما نفس الصيغة الجزيئية، مع اختلاف ترتيب الذرات في الجزيء. 2) مادة واحدة من مادتين كيماويتين أو أكثر لها نفس النسبة المئوية التركيبية الأولية والوزن الجزيئي مع اختلاف البنية ومن ثم الخواص، وهناك طرق عديدة لظهور مثل هذه الاختلافات البنيوية.
definition.en: 1) Two or more compounds having the same molecular formula, but a different arrangement of atoms within the molecule. 2) One of two or more chemical substances having the same elementary percentage composition and molecular weight but differing in structure, and therefore in properties; there are many ways in which such structural differences occur.

Isoprene is an unsaturated pentahydrocarbon, Isoprene is found in certain plants or obtained by distillation of caoutchouc or gutta-percha. In plants, it is elementary in the formation of isoprenoids, fat-soluble vitamins, carotenoids and related pigments. Isoprenes contribute to flavors and fragrances of essential oils and other plant-derived substances.
Condition of equilibrium or buoyancy of the earth's crust above the mantle.
The rise of land masses that were depressed by the huge weight of ice sheets during the last glacial period, through a process known as isostasy.
Gravity anomaly corrected for the effects of low-density rocks underlying mountains.

Occurs when a load is imposed on or removed from the lithosphere. The surface tends to rise or sink as the lithosphere rises or sinks in the asthenosphere. Loads may consist of large lakes, oceans, (on continental shelves during eustatic sea level), ice, sediment, thrust sheets, and volcanoes. The rising or sinking of the lithosphere will continue until isostatic equilibrium is reached.

Refers to the the gradual uplift following rapid erosional removal of material from a mountain range. The land rises as a result of the removal of the weight. Another example of isostatic uplift is post-glacial rebound following the melting of continental glaciers and ice sheets.

definition.ar: ذرة أو اثنتان أو أكثر لها نفس العدد الذري والتي تحتوي على أعداد مختلفة من النيوترونات.
definition.en: One or two or more atoms with the same atomic number that contain different numbers of neutrons.

The measure of Isotopes, atoms that contain different # of proton /neutrons. The number of protons (the atomic number) is the same for each isotope, e.g. carbon-12, carbon-13 and carbon-14 each have 6 protons, but the number of neutrons in each isotope differs.

The identification of isotopic signature, the distribution of certain stable isotopes and chemical elements within chemical compounds. This can be applied to a food web to make it possible to draw direct inferences regarding diet, trophic level, and subsistence. Isotope ratios are measured using mass spectrometry, which separates the different isotopes of an element on the basis of their mass-to-charge ratio.
Pertaining to the measurement of the various isotopes (one of two or more species of the same chemical element) found in geochemically significant compounds.
Also referred to as radiometric age, is an age of rocks expressed in years and calculated from the quantitative determination of radioactive elements and their decay products.
Experimental determination of the proportion of a given isotope (or isotopes) in a sample.
A narrow strip of land connecting two larger land areas usually with waterforms on either side.
K-index in units of degrees Celsius (°C) is a simple index using data from discrete pressure levels instead of a lifted parcel.
A glacial landform made by a stream flowing through glacial ice and depositing material upon entering a lake or pond at the end or terminus of the glacier, thus 'in front' of it, a proglacial lake.

A steep conical hill composed of glaciofluvial sediments. This feature develops when glacial crevasses and depressions in stagnant glacial ice are filled with sand and gravel deposits from sediment loaded meltwater.
The Kaplan SST Index represents SST anomalies over a 5x5 degree grid from the MOHSST5 version of the GOSTA.

(Also called Kármán vortex street, vortex trail, vortex train.) Two parallel rows of alternately placed vortices along the wake of an obstacle in a fluid of moderate Reynolds number.Fluid drag can be calculated from the motion of these vortices, which are stable only for a certain ratio of the width of the street to the distance between vortices along the street.

definition.ar: كلمة ألمانية مأخوذة من مصطلح من اللغة الصربية-الكرواتية يشير إلى نوع معين من التضاريس التي تنشأ عن تحلل الحجر الجيري وتتميز بغياب الصرف السطحي تقريبا، وبوجود سلسلة من الفجوات السطحية والانخفاضات والشقوق والبنى المنهارة وشبكة صرف جوفية واسعة. 2) نوع من التضاريس يتشكل في الحجر الجيري والجبس وغيرها من الصخور بواسطة التحلل ويتميز بوجود الحفر الغائرة والكهوف والصرف الجوفي. أصل الكلمة ألماني ويرجع إلى منطقة كرس اليوغوسلافية وهي هضبة من الحجر الجيري تقع في جبال الألب الدينارية في شمال غرب يوغوسلافيا وشمال شرق إيطاليا.
definition.en: 1) A German rendering of a Serbo-Croat term referring to the terrain created by limestone solution and characterized by a virtual absence of surface drainage, a series of surface hollows, depressions and fissures, collapse structures, and an extensive subterranean drainage network. 2) A type of topography that is formed on limestone, gypsum, and other rocks by dissolution, and that is characterized by sinkholes, caves, and underground drainage. Etymology: German, from the Yugoslavian territory Krs; type locality, a limestone plateau in the Dinaric Alps of northwestern Yugoslavia and northeastern Italy.
terrains with a complex geology and very special hydrological characteristics

Karst Hydrology refers to the extensive dissolution of rock has led to the development of subterranean channels through which groundwater flows in conduits (enclosed or semi-enclosed channels). These conduits can vary in size from slightly enlarged cracks to tunnels many meters in diameter and many kilometers in length.
A Karst landform is a feature created on the Earth's surface by the drainage of water into the ground or by its discharge at springs.

An ecosystem within a landscape defined as Karst topography characterized by caves, sinkholes, disappraring streams and underground drainage. Karst forms when groundwater dissolves pockets of limestone, dolomite, or gypsum in rock.
Landscapes characterized by (or the processes characterizing) the formation and collapse of caves and sinkholes because of carbonation weathering of limestone bedrock.
A valley-scale, mid-size, closed depression otherwise meeting the definition of a sinkhole but also enclosing more than one smaller sinkhole and sinking stream.

Most widely used in mountain meteorology to denote a downslope flow driven by cooling at the slope surface during periods of light larger-scale winds; the nocturnal component of the along-slope wind systems.
Pertaining areas of dense groupings of kelp species in cold and relatively shallow coastal waters.

A steep conical hill composed of glaciofluvial sediments. This feature develops when glacial crevasses and depressions in stagnant glacial ice are filled with sand and gravel deposits from sediment loaded meltwater.
Species whose abundance and ecological role has a dramatic effect on the other species in an ecosystem.

Design and development of information systems that represent and relate concepts needed to identify, specify, organize, categorize, or characterize scientific information effectively. Includes development of controlled vocabularies as well as hierarchical and networked concept schemes such as thesauri and ontologies.

A 3-hourly planetary index of geomagnetic activity calculated by the Institut fur Geophysik der Gottingen Universitat, F.R. Germany, from the K indexes observed at 13 stations primarily in the Northern Hemisphere. The Kp indexes, which date from 1932, are used to determine the ap indexes.
Statistical analysis technique which uses interpolation to best predict unknown data values from data observed at known locations.
Noble gas element with symbol Kr and atomic number 36
Procedures carried out in a laboratory under controlled conditions to test specific scientific hypotheses.
Laboratory method to study rocks using magnetometers to measure remanent magnetic fields induced in the samples.
Techniques to analyze and test samples in a place equipped and designed for the work.

definition.ar: مواد متخلفة عن أنشطة التحليل والبحوث التي تجرى في المعمل.
definition.en: Discarded materials produced by analytical and research activities in a laboratory.

Lakes that get filled by incoming sediment. Overtime, the water may drain from the lake, leaving the deposited sediments behind. This can be caused by natural drainage, evaporation or other geophysical processes.
Lacustrine Wetlands are lakes, or former lakes, that are naturally filledwith shallow water at certain times and more or less drained at othertimes.

definition.ar: جسم مائي معزول عن البحر المفتوح بالشعاب المرجانية أو الحواجز الرملية.
definition.en: A body of water cut off from the open sea by coral reefs or sand bars.

definition.ar: العملية التي يؤدي فيها ضوء الشمس وتأثير البكتيريا والأكسجين إلى التنقية الذاتية للمخلفات المائية. وعادة ما يحدث ذلك في البرك الضحلة أو في منظومة من هذه البرك.
definition.en: The process in which sunlight, bacterial action and oxygen cause self-purification in waste water, Usually taking place in a shallow pond, or system of such ponds.
A body of shallow sea water or brackish water separated from the sea by some form of barrier.

The Lagrangian feature refers to a function that characterizes the state of a physical system. The Lagrangian feature is referenced in the Global multi-scale Eulerian and Lagrangian oceanic 2 environmental variables for the period 2000-2009. Daily near-global maps of two Lagrangian synoptic quantities (namely the finite-time Lyapunov exponent (FTLE) and dilation 78 rate) are computed here. Both of these variables are derived from the deformation tensor derived from 3-day gridded trajectories 79 computed from 3-hourly archived model velocities from the Hybrid Coordinate Ocean Model (HYCOM, see below) or OSCAR 80 (see below) The HYCOM archive is missing data for several times in the target decade. When the gap is less than 18 hours, 81 integration is performed with the existing data, linearly interpolating across the gap. For longer gaps, linear interpolation is 82 insufficient, and the fields for the affected dates are not computed. Hence, over the computed period, Lagrangian products 83 could not be computed with HYCOM for the period May 21 – 25, 2000.
Downslope flow of ash and rock debris resulting from volcanic activity.

definition.ar: جسم مائي مغلق دون البحر، عادة ما يكون عذب الماء ولكن ليس بالضرورة في كل الأحوال.
definition.en: An enclosed body of water, usually but not necessarily fresh water, from which the sea is excluded.

definition.ar: منخفض على سطح الأرض تحتله أو كانت تحتله في الماضي بحيرة ويحتوي على ملامحها الساحلية. 2) المنطقة التي تحصل منها البحيرة على حصتها المائية.
definition.en: 1) The depression in the Earth's surface occupied or formerly occupied by a lake and containing its shore features. 2) The area from which a lake receives drainage.
Snowstorm occurring near or downwind from the shore of a lake resulting from the warming (destabilization) and moistening of relatively cold air during passage over a warm body of water.
Pertaining to the measurement, and analysis to ice formation on inlandbodies of salt or fresh water.
Reconstruction of past lake levels based on paleoclimate proxy records.

Lake level fluctuations can provide important evidence for paleoclimatic conditions, particulary in arid and semiarid areas. Lake levels are particularly sensitive to changes in hydrologic balance due to climatic fluctuations. Lakes may develop and expand if there is an abundance of precipitation and will recede and even dry up (due to evaporation) during prolonged droughts. Lake sediment cores are often drilled to provide stratigraphic clues to past climate conditions.

definition.ar: تغير مباشر أو غير مباشر بيد الإنسان يطال السلامة الحيوية أو الفيزيائية أو الكيميائية أو الإشعاعية لمياه البحيرة أو النظام الإيكولوجي للبحيرة.
definition.en: The direct or indirect human alteration of the biological, physical, chemical or radiological integrity of lake water, or a lake ecosystem.
A considerable inland body of standing water.
Acoustic energy received by a sonar system, providing a measure of the roughness of the lakebed.
Characteristics of the bottom of inland bodies of water.

An area of land where surface water from rain, melting snow, or ice converges to a single point at a lower elevation, usually the exit of the basin, where the waters join another waterbody, such as a river, lake, reservoir, estuary, wetland, sea, or ocean.

definition.ar: امتداد جغرافي معين من سطح الأرض يشتمل على جميع خصائصا بما في ذلك جيولوجيتها وترسيباتها السطحية وتضاريسها ونظمها الهيدرولوجية وتربتها والحياة النباتية والحيوانية فيها، إلى جانب ناتج النشاط البشري الحاضر والماضي، بقدر ما تؤثر هذه الخصائص تأثيرا كبيرا على استخدام الأرض في الحاضر والمستقبل.
definition.en: A specified geographical tract of the Earth's surface including all its attributes, comprising its geology, superficial deposits, topography, hydrology, soils, flora and fauna, together with the results of past and present human activity, to the extent that these attributes exert a significant influence on the present and future land utilization.
A coastal breeze blowing from land to sea, caused by the temperature difference when the sea surface is warmer than the adjacent land.

definition.ar: أقصى حد ممكن لاستغلال منطقة من الأرض أو التربة دون حدوث تدهور أو استنزاف لها.
definition.en: The maximum extent to which ground or soil area may be exploited without degradation or depletion.

definition.ar: إزالة الأشجار والكساء الأرضي العشبي، إلخ تمهيدا للحرث أو البناء، إلخ.
definition.en: Removal of trees, undergrowth, etc. in preparation for ploughing, building, etc.

definition.ar: غطاء الأرض هو الحالة الفيزيائية لسطح الأرض. ويجمع بين الغطاء النباتي والتربة والصخور والماء والإنشاءات التي أقامها الإنسان والتي تكون جميعا المنظر الطبيعي لسطح الأرض. وغطاء الأرض هو نقطة التماس بين القشرة الأرضية والغلاف الجوي، ويؤثر على تبادل الطاقة والمادة في النظام المناخي والدورات الكيميائية الجيولوجية الحيوية.
definition.en: Land cover is the physical state of the land surface. It is the combination of vegetation, soil, rock, water and human-made structures, which make up the earth's landscape. The land cover is the interface between the earth's crust and the atmosphere, influencing the exchange of energy and matter in the climatic system and biogeochemical cycles.
process which lowers the current and/or potential capability of soil to produce goods and services that can be limited, reversed and avoided through the appropriate management of land
definition.fr: diminution de la capacité actuelle et/ou future des sols à produire des produits et des services qui peut être limitée, inversée ou évitée grâce à une gestion des terres appropriée

definition.ar: تفريغ أي مخلفات أو إلقاؤها أو ضخها على سطح التربة أو غيرها من السطوح الأرضية أو داخلها.
definition.en: The discharge, deposit or injection of any waste onto or into the soil or other land surfaces.
The ratio of the heat absorbed (or released) by a system to the corresponding temperature rise (or fall).
The areal extent of ice, typically glacier ice, expressed as the mathematical fraction of a region covered with ice.
Refers to a land ice and ocean classification mask.
These keywords are used to identify the type of grid location.
These keywords are used to identify the type of grid location.

definition.ar: وجود ملوث أو أكثر في منطقة من الأرض أو مكوناتها أو في باطنها.
definition.en: The presence of one or more contaminants upon or within an area of land, or its constituents.
The rate of production, especially of food, by the utilization of solar energy by producer organisms.

Non-marine geological information pertinent to paleoclimatology consists of all continental sedimentary records including loess,volcanic deposits, glaciation, spelothems, tree ring, pollen, and other land-based records.
Areas containing available sources of wealth, including cultural heritage resources, recreation features, range developments, or any other feature similarly designated.
Pertaining to the process by which the land surface sinks over an aquifer as water is pumped out of it.
Refers to the surface area and features on the surface of the Earth.
A set of parameters including topography and the heat-island effect that describe the changing climate on the land surface and agriculture lands.
Features and attributes of earth's land surface.
The visible shade or hue of the Earth's exposed ground as seen from above. Dependent on what materials are present and how they reflect light.

Land-surface processes through which climate system is controlled,changed, or modulated. Land-surface feedbacks involve a perturbationin a climate quantity that causes a change in a second quantity, and thechange in the second quantity ultimately leads to an additional changein the first. Land-surface feedbacks often involve land-surface change orchange in terrestrial carbon stocks that in turn affect land-atmosphereinteraction.

Refers to how hot the “surface” of the Earth would feel to the touch in a particular location. From a satellite’s point of view, the “surface” is whatever it sees when it looks through the atmosphere to the ground. It could be snow and ice, the grass on a lawn, the roof of a building, or the leaves in the canopy of a forest. Thus, land surface temperature is not the same as the air temperature that is included in the daily weather report.

Determining property boundaries, land area, elevations, and locations of features on the surface of the land by calculations based on the instrumental measurements of angles and distances or by use of global positional satellites.

definition.ar: يتناول مصطلح استخدام الأرض الجوانب المكانية من كافة الأنشطة الإنسانية على الأرض والطريقة التي يتم بها تعديل سطح الأرض أو يمكن بها تعديله لخدمة احتياجات الإنسان.
definition.en: The term land use deals with the spatial aspects of all human activities on the land and with the way in which the land surface is adapted, or could be adapted, to serve human needs.
The vegetation, water, natural surface, and cultural features on the land surface.
Effect of changing land use patterns on ecological systems.
Categories defining the land in some way, such as by slope, land cover, and type
The observed physical cover and natural use of the land including the vegetation and human construction, which covers the earth's surface.
Changes to land surfaces from both natural and anthropogenic means, including deforestation, land slides, agriculture, mining, building constructions, pavement, etc.
Relates to the type of feature present on the surface of the earth. This can include such things as corn fields, lakes, maple trees, and concrete highways.
Maximum wind speed of a Tropical Cyclone at landfall.

definition.ar: يتولد غاز المطمورات في مواقع الطمر عن طريق التحلل اللاهوائي للبقايا المنزلية (المخلفات البلدية الصلبة). ويتألف من مزيج من الغازات وهو عديم اللون وذو رائحة كريهة بسبب آثار المركبات الكبريتية العضوية الموجودة فيه. وبصرف النظر عن كونه منفرا، فإنه شديد الخطورة لأن الميثان قابل للانفجار عندما يصل تركيزه في الهواء لكعدلات تتراوح بين 5% وهي الحد الأدنى للانفجار و15% وهو الحد الأقصى للانفجار. ويجب السيطرة على غاز المطمورات في كافة مواقع الطمر المستخدمة، سواء بالتهوية الموجبة أو السلبية أو كليهما وخاصة في حالة المواقع العميقة.
definition.en: Landfill gas is generated in landfill sites by the anaerobic decomposition of domestic refuse (municipal solid waste). It consists of a mixture of gases and is colourless with an offensive odour due to the traces of organosulphur compounds. Aside for its unpleasantness, it is highly dangerous as methane is explosive in concentrations in air between 5 per cent, the Lower Explosive Limit (LEL), and the Upper Explosive Limit (UEL) of 15 per cent. Landfill gas must be controlled at all operational landfill sites, whether actively or passively vented or both especially in the case of deep sites.

definition.ar: سائل يرشح خلال المخلفات الصلبة في مواقع الطمر ويؤدي إلى استخراج مواد ذائبة قابلة للذوبان أو مستعلقة في غضون هذه العملية.
definition.en: Liquid that has seeped through solid waste in a landfill and has extracted soluble dissolved or suspended materials in the process.

name.fr: Flux de déchets mis en décharge

definition.en: waste which is deposited in landfill, characterised according to the European Waste Catalogue, and which adds to the inventory of landfill already in place, covering commercial, industrial and household sources, and excluding fractions already recovered for re-use, recycling or incineration
definition.fr: déchets mis en décharge, caractérisés selon le catalogue européen des déchets, et qui s'ajoutent à l'inventaire des décharges déjà en place, couvrant les sources commerciales, industrielles et ménagères, à l'exclusion des fractions déjà récupérées à des fins de réutilisation, de recyclage ou d'incinération

definition.ar: أي شكل أو ملمح فيزيائي لسطح الأرض يمكن التعرف عليه، له شكل مميز وينتج عن أسباب طبيعية. ويشتمل على الأشكال الرئيسية مثل السهل والهضبة والجبل والأشكال الصغرى مثل التل والوادي والمنحدر والكثيب المتخلف عن النهر الجليدي والكثيب الرملي. والأشكال الأرضية في مجملها تكون تضاريس سطح الأرض.
definition.en: Any physical, recognizable form or feature of the Earth's surface, having a characteristic shape and produced by natural causes; it includes major forms such as plane, plateau and mountain, and minor forms such as hill, valley, slope, esker, and dune. Taken together the landforms make up the surface configuration of the Earth's.

definition.ar: سمات وأنماط وبنية منطقة جغرافية طبيعية، بما في ذلك تركيبها البيولوجي وبيئتها الفيزيائية وأنماطها الاجتماعية أو البشرية. منطقة تتجمع فيها النظم الإيكولوجية المتفاعلة وتتكرر بشكل متشابه.
definition.en: The traits, patterns, and structure of a specific geographic area, including its biological composition, its physical environment, and its anthropogenic or social patterns. An area where interacting ecosystems are grouped and repeated in similar form.

definition.ar: تؤدي عملية التعدين إلى تشويه سطح الأرض، وفي غياب الاستصلاح تؤدي إلى ندبات دائمة فيها. فعملية التعدين تفسد التربة السطحية بالغة الأهمية، وتؤدي لاختلال أنماط الصرف وتدمير القدرة الإنتاجية للأراضي الزراعية وأراضي الغابات كما تفسد قيمتها الجمالية والاجتماعية.
definition.en: The process of mining disfigures the surface of the land, and in the absence of reclamation leads to permanent scars. The process spoils the vital topsoil, disrupts drainage patterns, destroys the productive capacity of agricultural and forest land and impairs their aesthetic and social value.

definition.ar: المناظر الطبيعية قد تتغير بمرور الوقت نتيجة للأنشطة البشرية أو العمليات الطبيعية مثل الحرائق أو الكوارث الطبيعية. ويمكن توثيق التغيرات التي تحدث في بنية المنظر الطبيعي باستخدام بيانات مستمدة من الصور الجوية أو صور الأقمار الاصطناعية والتكنولوجيات الجديدة مثل الاستشعار عن بعد ونظم المعلومات الجغرافية.
definition.en: Landscapes might change through time as a result of human activities or natural processes such as fires or natural disasters. Changes in landscape structure can be documented by using data from aerial photographs or satellite images, and new technologies, such as remote sensing and geographic information systems.

definition.ar: في مجال التقييم البصري يمكن تقسيم المنظر الطبيعي إلى أربعة عناصر رئيسية: أ) الشكل وهو الكتلة أو الشكل المدرك لشيء ما يبدو وحدة واحدة ويجعل الناظر إليه يعي باختلافه عن غيره وبوجود علاقة بين كل ما والأجزاء المكونة له. ب) الخط وهو المسار أو الحد أو التقاطع الحقيقي أو التخيلي بين مستويين، كما في الصورة الظلية، الذي تتبعه العين عندما تدرك الاختلافات المفاجئة في الشكل أو اللون أو الملمس. ج) اللون وهو إدراك بصري يمكن العين من التمييز بين أشياء لولا اللون لظهرت متماثلة على أساس الطول الموجي للضوء الذي تعكسه. د) الملمس وهو الإحساس البصري بالمنظر الطبيعي.
definition.en: In visual assessment work, landscapes can be divided into four major elements. a) Form is the perceived mass or shape of an object that appears unified, and which provides a consciousness of its distinction and relation of a whole to the component parts. b) Line is the real or imagined path, border, boundary, or intersection of two planes, such as a silhouette, that the eye follows when perceiving abrupt differences in form, colour or texture. c) Colour is a visual perception that enables the eye to differenciate otherwise identical objects based on the wavelengths of reflected light. d) Texture is the visual feel of a landscape.

definition.ar: استخدام أجزاء من المناظر الطبيعية بطريقة تعدل من ملامحها تعديلا شديدا.
definition.en: Using parts of landscape in a way that heavily modifies its features.
The study of the distribution patterns of communities and ecosystems; the ecological processes that affect those patterns and changes in pattern and process over time.
The identification, assessment, design, and manipulation of features or values of a landscape.
A natural space classification of living communities and their environmental conditions.
The physical processes that shape an area of land, including landforms, living elements of flora and fauna, and human activity and the built environment.

definition.ar: منطقة تكون فيها المناظر الطبيعية محمية نظرا لملامحها الخاصة من أجل صيانة دورها في الإسهام في الاستمتاع بالريف على نطاق واسع.
definition.en: Area where landscape is protected for its particular features in order to maintain its role in contributing to the wider enjoyment of the countryside.

definition.ar: استخدام المناظر الطبيعية أو أجزاء منها للسياحة أو الرياضة أو الزراعة.
definition.en: Using landscape or parts of it for tourism, sports, or agriculture.

definition.ar: تضاريس وعمليات تحرك ضخمة تنطوي على انتقال التربة والمادة الصخرية في حركة جماعية لأسفل بتأثير الجاذبية.
definition.en: Mass-movement landforms and processes involving the downslope transport, under gravitationary influence of soil and rock material en masse.
Estimation of the probability of occurrence and likely severity of landslides in a given area.
Downslope movement of rock, soil, or artificial fill under the influences of gravity.
Rare earth (lanthanide series) element with symbol La and atomic number 57

definition.ar: مختصر لعبارة بالإنجليزية تعني تضخيم الضوء بانبعاث الإشعاع المحفز، ويشير إلى جهاز يولد شعاعا ضوئيا قويا متماسكا أحادي اللون ذا اتجاه محدد للغاية. ويتكون الليزر من اسطوانة شفافة بها سطح عاكس في أحد طرفيها وسطح آخر عاكس جزئيا في الطرف الآخر. تنعكس الموجات الضوئية روحة وجيئة، وتظهر بعضها من النهاية المنعكسة جزئيا. وقد يكون مصدر الضوء قطعة من الياقوت يتم استثارة ذراتها المحتوية على الكروم بواسطة مصباح وهاج حتى تبعث نبضات من الضوء شديد التماسك، أو مزيجا من الغازات الخاملة التي تولد شعاعا مستمرا، أو مكعبا من زرنيخيد الجاليوم المعالج الذي يبعث إشعاعا تحت الأحمر عندما يمر خلاله تيار كهربي.
definition.en: Acronym for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation; a device that produces a powerful, highly directional, monochromatic, coherent beam of light. Laser consist of a transparent cylinder with a reflecting surface at one end and a partially reflecting surface at the other. Light waves are reflected back and forth, some of them emerging at the partially reflecting end. The light source may be a ruby, whose chromium atoms are excited by a flash lamp so that they emit pulses of highly coherent light, or a mixture of inert gases that produce a continuos beam, or a cube of treated gallium arsenide which emits infrared radiation when an electric current passes through it.
Last frost was based on the last occurrence of 36°F or lower temperature, last freeze was based on the flast occurrence of 32°F temperature.

The freeze/frost probability levels represent the risk with regard to meeting or falling below a certain temperature threshold by a specific date, or within a specified number of days. For example, suppose a 90 percent probability level for the spring season is computed to be March 1 at the 32 degree threshold. This means that nine years out of ten a temperature as cold or colder than 32 degrees is expected to occur later than March 1 during the spring season. For the fall season, the probability level represents the chance of having a temperature as cold or colder earlier than the computed date. The freeze-free probability level indicates the chance of having a longer freeze-free period than the computed number of days. The methods used to compute the freeze probabilities come from two data distributions: a discrete freeze or no-freeze distribution, where a no-freeze annual season is one in which only one or no freeze occurs; and a continuous one of freeze dates for the years of freeze occurrence, where

Latent heat refers to energy lost (acquired) by a thermodynamic system during evaporative (condensation) processes. Most commonly in Earth systems, latent heating and cooling is experienced by any body containing water. Roughly 20% of the cooling of the surface of the Earth is due to evaporative processes. This energy, carried by water vapor, is released into the atmosphere during condensation processes, mainly during formation of clouds and precipitation.

Parallel ridges of debris deposited along the sides of a glacier. The unconsolidated debris can be deposited on top of the glacier by frost shattering of the valley walls and from tributary streams flowing into the valley.
The composition and texture of molten rock outside of the Earth's crust.

Roughly circular mound-shaped protrusion resulting from the slow extrusion of viscous lava from a volcano. The geochemistry of lava domes can vary from basalt to rhyolite although most preserved domes tend to have high silica content.

Also called a lava field or lava bed, is a large expanse of nearly flat-lying lava flows. Such features are generally composed of highly-fluid basalt lava, and can extend for tens or even hundreds of miles across the underlying terrain.
Rare earth (actinide series) element with symbol Lr and atomic number 103
Legal statements of the government regarding actions people or corporations might undertake.
The layered water vapor is a profile in broad layers based on pressure.

definition.ar: عملية فصل سائل من مادة صلبة (كما في المخلفات السائلة بارتشاح السائل خلال التربة المحيطة. 2) استخراج مكونات قابلة للذوبان من مزيج صلب عن طريق ارتشاح مذيب خلاله. 3) فقد أو التسبب في فقد مواد قابلة للذوبان بفعل سائل ترشيح.
definition.en: 1) The process of separating a liquid from a solid (as in waste liquid by percolation into the surrounding soil. 2) Extraction of soluble components of a solid mixture by percolating a solvent through it. 3) To lose or cause to lose soluble substances by the action of a percolating liquid.

definition.ar: عنصر فلزي ثقيل سام أبيض اللون ضارب إلى الزرقة يتسم بقابليته العالية للتشكيل، يظهر أساسا في صورة خام يسمى الجالينا ويستخدم في صنع السبائك والمراكمات وأغطية الكابلات والدهانات وفي التدريع ضد الإشعاع.
definition.en: A heavy toxic bluish-white metallic element that is highly malleable; occurs principally as galena and is used in alloys, accumulators, cable sheaths, paints, and as a radiation shield.

definition.ar: توجد مركبات الرصاص في صورة إضافات الجاوزلين أو في الدهانات أو المنتجات الخزفية أو مواد بناء الأسقف أو اللحامات أو التطبيقات الكهربية أو الأنابيب أو الحاويات. وقد يحدث التعرض للرصاص عن طريق الهواء أو الماء أو الغذاء أو التربة. ويرجع وجود الرصاص في الهواء أساسا إلى أنواع الوقود ذات القاعدة الرصاصية وإلى حرق المخلفات الصلبة والفحم والزيوت والانبعاثات الآتية من عمليات تصنيع الرصاص الألكاني، والغبار البركاني الذي تذروه الرياح، واحتراق الأسطح المطلية بالرصاص، ودخان السجائر. أما الرصاص الموجود في مياه الشرب فيأتي من الارتشاح من الأنابيب والوصلات واللحامات المصنوعة من الرصاص في كل من نظم التوزيع ونظم السباكة المنزلية.
definition.en: Lead compounds are present as gasoline additives, in paint, ceramic products, roofing, caulking, electrical applications, tubes, or containers. Lead exposure may be due to air, water, food, or soil. Lead in the air is primarily due to lead-based fuels and the combustion of solid waste, coal, oils, and emissions from alkyl lead manufacturers, wind blown dust volcanoes, the burning of lead-painted surfaces, and cigarette smoke. Lead in drinking water comes from leaching from lead pipes, connectors, and solder in both the distribution system and household plumbing.

definition.ar: وجود الرصاص وإطلاقه في الهواء والماء والتربة، والرصاص معدن سام يستخدم في السباكة وصنع الجازولين والبطاريات الحمضية الرصاصية.
definition.en: The presence and release into the air, water and soil, of lead, a toxic metal used in plumbing, gasoline and lead-acid batteries.

Any fracture or passage-way through ice which is navigable by surface vessels. Leads and other open water areas within the sea ice pack are also important in studies of the energy budget in the polar regions and in local and regional climatology.

definition.ar: العضو الأساسي في عملية التمثيل الضوئي والنتح في النباتات العليا، تتألف عادة من نصل أخضر مفلطح يتصل بالساق مباشرة أو عن طريق عنق الورقة.
definition.en: The main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants, usually consisting of a flat green blade attached to the stem directly or by a stalk.
The one sided green leaf area per unit ground area in broadleaf canopies, or as the projected needleleaf area per unit ground area in needle canopies.
Pertain to the general characteristics of leaves including leaf structure, arrangement, leaf shape, and leaf margin.

definition.ar: طرد عارض غير خاضع للتحكم أو تسرب لسوائل أو غازات وغيرها من المواد إلى أماكن غير مقصودة وغير مطلوبة، وكثيرا ما ينجم عنه خطر إتلاف أو إيذاء الأشخاص أو الممتلكات أو البيئة
definition.en: The accidental, uncontrolled discharge or seepage of liquids, gases and other substances to unintended and unwanted locations, frequently causing risks of damage or harm to persons, property or the environment.
Calculated as the difference between mean/median dates of last Spring and first Autumn freezes.

A growing season is the period of the year when crops and other plants grow successfully. The length of the growing season in any given region refers to the number of days when plant growth takes place. The growing season often determines which crops can be grown in an area, as some crops require long growing seasons, while others mature rapidly. Growing season length is limited by many different factors. Depending on the region and the climate, the growing season is influenced by air temperatures, frost days, rainfall, or daylight hours.

The solar cycle is a nearly periodic change in the Sun's activity between the time where we can observe the most and least number of sunspots, and generally lasts around 11 years. Sometimes the surface of the Sun is very active with lots of sunspots, while other times it is quieter with only a few or even none.

definition.ar: رتبة كبيرة من الحشرات ذات الأجنحة الحرشفية تتضمن الفراش والفراش النطاط والعث. تتميز الحشرة البالغة في هذه الرتبة بوجود زوجين من الأجنحة الغشائية والأعضاء الفمية الماصة، ولها خرطوم ماص طويل وملتو.
definition.en: A large order of scaly-winged insects, including the butterflies, skippers, and moths; adults are characterized by two pairs of membranous wings and sucking mouthparts, featuring a prominent, coiled proboscis.

definition.ar: كائنات مركبة تتكون بالتعايش المتبادل بين أنواع من الفطريات والطحالب. وتظهر على هيئة بقع قشرية أو نمو كثيف على سيقان الأشجار والجدران الحجرية وسطوح المباني وممرات الحدائق. ونظرا لأنها ليس لها جذور حقيقية فإنها تعتمد في غذائها على الغلاف الجوي وماء المطر. وتلعب الأشنات دورا مهما في كشف ورصد التلوث خصوصا بثاني أكسيد الكبريت لأنها شديدة الحساسية للتلوث، وتختفي أنواع مختلفة منها إذا وصل التلوث إلى مستويات معينة.
definition.en: Composite organisms formed by the symbiosis between species of fungi and an algae. They are either crusty patches or bushy growths on tree trunks, stone walls, roofs or garden paths. Because they have no actual roots they get their sustenance from the atmosphere and rainwater. Lichens play an important role in the detection and monitoring of pollution, especially sulphur dioxide, as they are highly sensitive to pollution and different species disappear if pollution reaches specific levels.
Plants that are composed of a fungus and an alga growing together symbiotically and often found growing on rocks or tree trunks.
Light detection and ranging, an airborne, spaceborne or ground-based laser-ranging technique commonly used for acquiring high-resolution topographic data.

The scattering of radiation in a direction opposite to that of the incident radiation due to reflection of the transmitted lidar signal back towards the instrument (from the Radar Backscatter definition).
The ratio of cross polarized to co-polarized lidar signal return reflected backin a direction opposite to that of the incident radiation from a lidar transmission.

LIDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) is an optical remote sensing technology that measures properties of scattered light to find range and/or other information of a distant target. A Full Waveform LiDAR System records the entire emitted and backscattered signal of each laser pulse. Full waveform LiDAR data are more complex to process however they can often capture more information compared to discrete return LiDAR systems.
The phases, changes, or stages through which an organism passes throughout its lifetime.
definition.ar: الأطوار أو المراحل أو التغيرات التي يمر خلاها الكائن طوال فترة حياته.

definition.en: Branches of science that study living and fossil organisms.
Lifted Index = in units of degrees Celsius (°C) provides estimationsof the atmospheric stability in cloud-free areas.

definition.ar: إشعاع إلكترومغناطيسي قادر على إحداث إحساس بصري.
definition.en: Electromagnetic radiation that is capable of causing a visual sensation.
Analytical technique using mass spectrometry to measure the different isotopic forms of low mass (light) elements such as oxygen, hydrogen, carbon, nitrogen and sulfur that occur in samples.
Measurement of the percentage of light received at a photo cell placed at fixed distances from a light source.
Generally, any and all of the various forms of visibleelectrical discharge produced by thunderstorms.

The most abundant natural aromatic organic polymer found in all vascular plants. Lignin together with cellulose and hemicellulose are the major cell wall components of the fibers of all wood and grass species. Lignin is composed of coniferyl, p-coumaryl, and sinapyl alcohols in varying ratios in different plant species.

definition.ar: استخراج فحم بني اللون من الترسيبات الطبيعية. والليجنيت وقود صلب أسود اللون مائل إلى البني يمثل المرحلة الثانية من مراحل تطور الفحم. ويتميز بما يزيد قليلا عن نصف قيمة التسخين التي يتسم بها فحم البيتومين أو الأنثراسيت.
definition.en: Extraction of brown coal from natural deposits; lignite is a brownish-black solid fuel in the second stage in the development of coal. It has a little over half the heating value of bituminous or anthracite coal.

definition.ar: صخور رسوبية تتكون أساسا من كربونات الكالسيوم وتوجد أساسا على هيئة ملح الكالسيت الذي قد يحتوي أو لا يحتوي على كربونات المغنيسيوم. وتكون الحجر الجيري عن طريق العمليات العضوية أو غير العضوية، وقد يكون في صورة مفتتة أو كيميائية أو على هيئة أوليت أو في صورة ترابية أو بللورية أو بللورات متحولة، وكثير من هذه الصخور تحتوي على أحافير وتمثل بوضوح ضفافا كانت مكسوة بالصخور أو شعابا مرجانية في العصور القديمة.
definition.en: A sedimentary rock consisting chiefly of calcium carbonate, primarily in the form of the mineral calcite and with or without magnesium carbonate. Limestones are formed by either organic or inorganic processes, and may be detrital, chemical, oolitic, earthy, crystalline, or recrystallized; many are highly fossiliferous and clearly represent ancient shell banks or coral reefs.
Scientific study of the physical and biological characteristics of inland bodies of water such as lakes and ponds.
Wind velocity in the viewing area of the instrument.
LOS winds measures the vector projection of the true 3-D wind into the direction of the pulsed laser beam, determined by the frequency change of the returned light due to the Doppler shift.

definition.ar: المصدر الخطي معناه مصدر ذو بعد واحد. ومثال للمصدر الخطي هو صدور انبعاثات معينة من طريق غير معبد
definition.en: Line source means a one-dimensional source. An example of a line source is the particular emissions from a dirt road.

definition.ar: مصادر نقطية للضوضاء موضوعة واحدا وراء الآخر كما في صف للسيارات التي تسير على الطريق مثلا.
definition.en: Point noise sources placed one after the other one as, for instance, in a row of cars moving on a road.
Linear topographic feature on the earth's surface or in rocks.

definition.ar: طبقة من مواد طبيعية أو صناعية على جوانب أو أسفل مقلب للطكر أو خلية طمر أو خزان ماء سطحي، للحد من هروب السوائل لأسفل أو نحو الجوانب حاملة معها حلحلة المطمورات إلى التربة المحيطة بها.
definition.en: A layer of synthetic or natural materials, on the sides of or beneath a landfill, landfill cell or surface impoundment, that restricts the downward or lateral escape of liquids carrying leachate into the surrounding environment.

definition.ar: نوع من أنواع المركبات التي تحتوي على هيدروكربونات دهنية طويلة السلسلة ومشتقاتها، مثل الأحماض الدهنية والكحوليات والأمينات والكحوليات الأمينية والألدهيدات. وتتضمن الشمع والدهون والمركبات المشتقة.
definition.en: One of a class of compounds which contain long-chain aliphatic hydrocarbons and their derivatives, such as fatty acids, alcohols, amines, amino alcohols, and aldehydes; includes waxes, fats, and derived compounds.
Substances having an affinity for lipids.
Physical process which can occur during an earthquake. Clay-free soil deposits (primarily sands and silts)temporarily lose strength and behave as viscuous fluids, resulting in ground failure.
Chromatographic technique to separate or partition the components of a mixture in which samples are liquid and passed through a column.
Liquid precipitation that reaches the Earth's surface in the form of drops.

definition.ar: حالة المادة الوسيطة بين المواد المتبلرة والغازات، وفيها تتميز المادة بقدرتها على التدفق تحت أي ضغط مهما كان صغيرا للغاية، وتأخذ شكل الوعاء الموجودة فيه، لكنها غير قابلة للانضغاط نسبيا، وليس لها القدرة على التمدد بلا حدود، وقد يكون لها سطح حر.
definition.en: A state of matter intermediate between that of crystalline substances and gases in which a substance has the capacity to flow under extremely small shear stresses and conforms to the shape of a confining vessel, but is relatively incompressible, lacks the capacity to expand without limit, and can posses a free surface.

definition.ar: مخلفات سائلة تتكون من مياه الصرف الصحي والمخلفات المائية المنزلية، أو المياه المعالجة أو غيرها من السوائل مما ينجم عن الأنشطة الصناعية، وخاصة صناعات معينة مثل لب الورق وإنتاج الورق ومعالجة الأغذية وتصنيع الكيماويات.
definition.en: Fluid wastes, consisting of sewage and domestic wastewater, or processed water, or other liquids, produced by industrial activity, particularly by such industries as pulp and paper production, food processing, and the manufacture of chemicals.
This keyword refers to the wetness of the snow pack and may be an indicator of snow melt or stability.

The liquid content of solid precipitation that has accumulated on the ground (snow depth). The accumulation may consist of snow, ice formed by freezing precipitation, freezing liquid precipitation, or ice formed by the refreezing of melted snow.
A unit of measurement of how thick a uniform layer of water at the surface of the Earth would need to be to account for an equivalent mass at the surface of the Earth.
Alkali metal element with symbol Li and atomic number 3

definition.ar: الجزء الصلب من الأرض بالمقارنة بالغلاف الجوي والغلاف المائي.
definition.en: The solid portion of the Earth, as compared with the atmosphere and the hydrosphere.
The rate and direction of movement between two torsionally rigid thin segments of the Earth's lithosphere (lithospheric plates).

Branch of stratigraphy dealing with the study of units of rock. Each unit is composed of a body of rock which is dominated by a certain lithology or similar color, mineralogic composition, and grain size.

definition.ar: قش أو تبن أو مواد مشابهة تستخدمها الحيوانات للرقاد عليها.
definition.en: Straw, hay or similar material used as bedding by animals.

Litter characteristics refer to Global Change Master Directorydetailed variable under the variable, Litter Characteristics: litterchemistry, litter decomposition, litter dry weight, litterfall, andlitterfall flux.
Simple green land plants of the phyla Bryophyta with leaves and a stem and always without roots.

definition.ar: البقر والجياد وما إليها من الحيوانات التي تربى للاستخدام المنزلي خاصة في المزارع.
definition.en: Cattle, horses, and similar animals kept for domestic use especially on a farm.

definition.ar: تربية الماشية بتهجين الأنواع المختلفة للحصول على أنواع جديدة ذات سمات معينة مرغبة.
definition.en: The raising of livestock by crossing different varieties to obtain new varieties with desired characteristics.

definition.ar: تربية البقر والجياد وما شابهها من حيوانات.
definition.en: Breeding of cattle, horses and similar animals.

definition.ar: أي زاحف من الرتبة الفرعية للسحالي خاصة ما ينتمي لفصيلة العظاءات، وتتميز عادة بجسم مستطيل ولها أربعة أطراف وذيل قصير. وتتضمن البرص والإيجوانا والحرباء والورل والديدان بطيئة الحركة.
definition.en: Any reptile of the suborder Lacertilia, especially those of the family Lacertidae, typically having an elongated body, four limbs, and a small tail: includes the gechos, iguanas, chameleons, monitors, and slow worms.

definition.ar: زرع الأشجار في منطقة ما، أو إدارة منطقة ما للسماح بتجدد الاشجار أو استعمارها للمنطقة بضورة طبيعية من أجل تكوين غابة.
definition.en: The planting of trees in an area, or the management of an area to allow trees to regenerate or colonize naturally, in order to produce a forest.

definition.ar: استخدام مصدر للإمداد في منطقة بلدية أو إقليمية، يمكن السحب منه بسهولة عند الحاجة.
definition.en: The use of a source of supply from a municipal or regional area, which can be readily drawn upon when needed.
Sinking of the land due to tectonic or isostatic processes.
Winds that, over a small area, differ from those that would be appropriate to the general large-scale pressure distribution, or that possess some other peculiarity.

An aeolian sediment formed by the accumulation of wind-blown silt and lesser and variable amounts of sand and clay that are loosely cemented by calcium carbonate. It is usually homogeneous and highly porous and is traversed by vertical capillaries that permit the sediment to fracture and form vertical bluffs.
Data collection over a period of years or decades to assess changes in selected biological communities and habitats.

definition.ar: آثار يمكن أن تدوم طويلا بعد انتهاء مسبباتها.
definition.en: Effects which will last long after the cause has ceased.
Crevasses that form semi-parallel to flow where a glacier expands laterally.

Elongate parallel to the prevailing wind, possibly caused by a larger dune having its smaller sides blown away. Seif dunes are sharp-crested and are common in the Sahara. They range up to 300 m (980 ft) in height and 300 km (190 mi) in length.
Movement of water parallel to the coast due to waves striking the shoreline at an angle
Longwave radiation is radiation with wavelengths longer than 4 micros. Also referred to as infrared radiation or terrestrial radiation.
Hyperbolic radio navigation system used for near-shore waters.

definition.ar: تدمير الموطن الحيوي بسبب التدهور البيئي الذي ينجم بدوره عن التلوث المحمول جوا أو مائيا.
definition.en: Destruction of biotopes produced by environmental degradation which in turn is caused by air- or water-borne pollution.

definition.ar: المرحلة التي يكون فيها مستوى الماء في مصدر من مصادر المياه عند أدنى مستوى له.
definition.en: Phase of lowest level of a water course.
The emission of “cold light” from minerals. There are several varieties of luminescence, each named according to the source of energy, or the trigger for the luminescence.
Dating methods that involve the analysis of the optical properties of minerals exposed to environmental radiation. Typically used to determine the age of subaerial exposure of surficial sediments.

definition.ar: العلاقة الوظيفية بين السعة النجمية وعدد النجوم وتوزيعها لكل مرحلة من مراحل السعة. وتعرف أيضا بعامل السطوع النسبي.
definition.en: The functional relationship between stellar magnitude and the number and distribution of stars of each magnitude interval. Also known as relative luminosity factor.
Rock luster is the way light reflects off the surface of a mineral.
Rare earth (lanthanide series) element with symbol Lu and atomic number 71

definition.ar: جهاز من الأوعية والعقد يحمل الليمف (السائل الليمفاوي) في أجسام الحيانات الفقارية. يبدأ من الشعيرات الموجودة في فراغات الأنسجة وينتهي إلى تكوين القنوات الصدرية التي تفرغ محتواها في الشرايين تحت الترقوة.
definition.en: A system of vessels and nodes conveying lymph in the vertebrate body, beginning with capillaries in tissue spaces and eventually forming the thoracic ducts which empty in the subclavian veins.

Broad, low-relief volcanic crater that is caused by a phreatomagmatic eruption, an explosion caused by groundwater coming into contact with hot lava or magma. A maar characteristically fills with water to form a relatively shallow crater lake.

Light re-emitted by seaweeds after absorbing energy from sunlight or another light source. This faint glow can be measured to provide information on the pigments, photosynthetic activity, and overall health of the algae, and how the algae respond to environmental change.
The general large-scale climate of a large area or country, as distinguished from the mesoclimate and microclimate.
'Macrobiota' is a general term for the larger soil organisms. Macrofauna, inparticular, refers to burrowing vertebrate animals, but may include largerinsects and earhworms.
Macrofossils are fossils large enough to be studied without the aid of a microscope. Macrofossils can indicate the range of plant or animal species in the past.
Invertebrate animals large enough to be studied without a microscope.

definition.ar: نبات كبير يرى بالعين المجردة، يتكون خاصة من الأشكال المائية مثل اللاميناريات (نوع من الأعشاب البحرية البنية الكبيرة التي تعد مصدرا لليود والبوتاس).
definition.en: A large macroscopic plant, used especially of aquatic forms such as kelp (variety of large brown seaweed which is a source of iodine and potash).
Refers to the concentration of macroplastics (>5 mm) in the ocean.

In 1971 Roland Madden and Paul Julian stumbled upon a 40-50 day oscillation when analyzing zonal wind anomalies in the tropical Pacific. They used ten years of pressure records at Canton (at 2.8B0 S in the Pacific) and upper level winds at Singapore. The oscillation of surface and upper-level winds was remarkably clear in Singapore. Until the early 1980's little attention was paid to this oscillation, which became known as the Madden and Julian Oscillation(MJO), and some scientists questioned its global significance. Since the 1982-83 El Nino event, low-frequency variations in the tropics, both on intra-annual (less than a year) and inter-annual (more than a year) timescales, have received much more attention, and the number of MJO-related publications grew rapidly.
The composition and texture of molten rock in the earth's crust.
Alkaline earth element with symbol Mg and atomic number 12

Local variation in the Earth's magnetic field resulting from variations in the chemistry or magnetism of the rocks. Mapping of variation over an area is valuable in detecting structures obscured by overlying material. The magnetic variation in successive bands of ocean floor parallel with mid-ocean ridges is important evidence supporting the theory of seafloor spreading, central to plate tectonics.
Pertaining to the angle, expressed in degrees east or west, to indicate the direction of magnetic north from true north.
Pertaining to the magnetic field generated by the Earth, consisting of both the dipole and non-dipole components.

The magnetic region surrounding earth. It is generated by the dipolar characteristic of earth's core whereby earth itself acts as a great spherical magnet with poles near, but not exactly at, the North and South poles.

An Electromagnetic field (EM field) is the region of space near electriccurrents, magnets, broadcasting antennas etc., regions in which electric andmagnetic forces may act, for example on charged particles.

Nondestructive evaluation of ferromagnetic materials. The evaluation is based on measurement of the variation of intensity of magnetization within an applied magnetic field due to changes in the magnetic domain structure of the materials under study.
The dip, angle of dip, magnetic dip, magnetic inclination, inclination (physics) the angle that a magnetic needle makes with the plane of the horizon.
Pertaining to measurements of the strength of the Earth's magnetic field.

A period of time during which the earth's magnetic field varies rapidly. During magnetic storms, satellite electronics can be damaged through the build up and subsequent discharge of static electric charges and astronauts and high-altitude pilots can be subjected to increased levels of radiation.
Degree to which a rock type or other earth material can acquire and retain the orientation and intensity of an applied magnetic field.

Nondestructive evaluation and location of magnetic materials in rock based on measuring the intensity of attraction of the materials to an induced magnetic field. Applications include geological and soil surveys, paleomagnetic studies, sedimentology, archaeological prospecting and core logging.

definition.ar: طائفة من الظواهر الفيزيائية المرتبطة بالكهرباء المتحركة، وتتضمن القوى الميكانيكية المتبادلة بين المغناطيسات والتيارات الكهربية.
definition.en: A class of physical phenomena associated with moving electricity, including the mutual mechanical forces among magnets and electric currents.
Use of specialized instruments designed to measure the earth's magnetic field at a given location.
Passive geophysical technique that uses the earth's natural electromagnetic field to investigate the spatial variation of electrical resistivity in the subsurface.

definition.ar: حدث أو خلل أو فقد غير متوقع يتجاوز المستويات العادية أو المحددة ويمكن أن يتسبب في الإضرار بحياة الإنسان أو الممتلكات أو البيئة.
definition.en: An unexpected occurrence, failure or loss beyond normal or specified levels with the potential for harming human life, property or the environment.
Elements that constitute > 1 wt. % of a rock as determined in a chemical analysis.

definition.ar: احتمال كبير لأن يؤدي خطر أو وضع معين إلى إزهاق الأرواح أو إصابة الأشخاص أو دمار المنشآت أو اختلال النشاط الاقتصادي أو الإضرار بالبيئة إلى حد كبير. أو أي ناتج لاحتمال وقوع دمار يتجاوز أقصى حد مقبول، وشدة هذا الدمار المتوقع.
definition.en: The high probability that a given hazard or situation will yield a significant amount of lives lost, persons injured, damage to property , disruption of economic activity or harm to the environment; or any product of the probability of occurrence and the expected magnitude of damage beyond a maximum acceptable level.

definition.ar: أي حيوان من الثدييات، وهي طائفة ضخمة من الفقاريات ذات الدم الحار، تتميز بوجود غدد لبنية عن الإناث، وحجاب صدري حاجز، وقلب ذي أربع غرف. وتتضمن هذه الطائفة الحيتان وآكلات اللحوم والقوارض والخفافيش والرئيسات إلخ.
definition.en: Any animal of the Mammalia, a large class of warm-blooded vertebrates having mammary glands in the female, a thoracic diaphragm, and a four-chambered heart. The class includes the whales, carnivores, rodents, bats, primates, etc.
Branch of zoology concerned with the study of mammals.
Vertebrate animals, generally large, with skin covered by hair and large brain cavities. Females have mammary glands for feeding the young, who are usually born quite mature.

name.fr: Changement climatique induit par l'action humaine

definition.ar: التغيرات المناخية بفعل الإنسان قد تكون راجعة إلى تأثير الاحتباس الحراري وأنشطة إنسانية أخرى. فالتغير في درجة بياض الأرض بسبب التصحر وإزالة الغابات يؤثر على كمية الطاقة الشمسية التي يتم امتصاصها عند سطح الأرض. والإيروسولات التي يتسبب فيها الإنسان والتي تنجم عن إطلاق الكبريت من محطات الطاقة يمكن أن تعدل في السحب. كما يمكن أن تغير مستويات الأوزون في طبقة الاستراتسفير بسبب الكلوروفليوروكربونات يمكن أن يؤثر على المناخ.
definition.en: Man-made climate changes may be due to the greenhouse effect and other human activities. A change in albedo of the land brought about by desertification and deforestation affects the amount of solar energy absorbed at the earth's surface. Man-made aerosols produced from the sulphur released from power stations can modify clouds. Changes in ozone levels in the stratosphere due to CFCs may influence climate.
Techniques of judiciously controlling or directing resources for a predetermined goal.
Metal element with symbol Mn and atomic number 25

definition.ar: مجتمعات نباتية وأشجار تستوطن مستنقعات المد والغرين الطيني والضفاف الرملية عند مصاب الأنهار وغيرها من المناطق الخفيضة التي تغمرها مياه البحر بصفة منتظمة، لكنها محمية من الأمواج والتيارات. وأشجار المنجروف هي النوع الوحيد من النباتات الخشبية التي تنمو حيث تتعرض الأرض للغمر بماء البحر بصفة دورية. وقد تكيفت الأنواع الفردية منها مع مستويات المد المختلفة ومختلف درجات الملوحة وطبيعة الطمي أو التربة. وتدعم مستنقعات وأجام المنجروف المئات من أنواع الكائنات البرية والبحرية والبرمائية. ولها دور خاص في دعم المصايد السمكية في المصاب، كما أنها توفر الحماية والملاذ والغذاء للكثير من أشكال الحياة البرية.
definition.en: Plant communities and trees that inhabit tidal swamps, muddy silt, and sand banks at the mouths of rivers and other low-lying areas which are regularly inundated by the sea, but which are protected from strong waves and currents. Mangroves are the only woody species that will grow where the land is periodically flooded with sea water; individual species have adapted themselves to different tidal levels, to various degrees of salinity, and to the nature of the mud or soil. Mangrove swamps and thickets support hundreds of terrestrial, marine, and amphibian species; have a special role in supporting estuarine fisheries; provide shelter, refuge and food for many forms of wildlife.

definition.ar: مساحة رطبة مسامية من الأرض التي تقع في الأجواء المدارية وعلى امتداد المناطق الساحلية تسودها أشجار وشجيرات المنجروف، وخصوص المنجروف الأحمر (رازوفورا) والمنجروف الأسود (أفيسينيا) والمنجروف الأبيض (لاجونكيولاريا)
definition.en: A wet, spongy area of land in tropical climates and along coastal regions that is dominated by mangrove trees and shrubs, particularly red mangroves (Rhizophora), black mangroves (Avicennia) and white mangroves (Laguncularia).
Pertaining to the environment of large flowering shrubs or trees growingin dense thickets or forests along muddy or silty tropical coasts.

Zone of earth's interior between the crust and the core. It is 2,900 kilometers (1,740 miles) thick and consists of a dense upper layer (upper mantle) and a partially molten lower layer (lower mantle), separated by a transition zone.
Systems using sets of numbers combined with geometric nets or grids to specific positions on a map or globe.

definition.ar: تكوين من الشجيرات القصيرة دائمة الخضرة يوجد عادة في التربة الرملية في أراضي منطقة البحر الأبيض المتوسط التي يتميز مناخها بشتاء مطير وصيف جاف. تضم مجموعة كبيرة من الأنواع العطرية مثل الخزام والآس والدفلى وإكليل الجبل وكثيرا ما تشتمل على العديد من الشجيرات الشوكية. ويرى البعض أن الأجمة نوع من الغطاء النباتي الثانوي وأنها تحتل الأراضي التي أزيلت منها غاباط البلوط الطبيعية دائمة الخضرة بسبب نشاط الإنسان.
definition.en: A low evergreen shrub formation, usually found on siliceous soils in the Mediterranean lands where winter rainfall and summer drought are the characteristic climate features. It consists of a profusion of aromatic species, such as lavender, myrtle, oleander and rosemary and often includes abundant spiny shrubs. It has been suggested that the maquis is a secondary vegetation, occupying the lands cleared of their natural evergreen oak forests by human activity.

definition.ar: صخور متحولة تتكون من كالسيت أو دولوميت متبلر متحول.
definition.en: Metamorphic rock composed of recrystallized calcite or dolomite.
Crevasses that form from the edge of the glacier, due to the reduction in speed caused by friction of the valley walls.

definition.ar: أرض قليلة الجودة وقيمة إنتاجها لا تكاد يغطي تكاليف استزراعها.
definition.en: Low quality land the value of whose production barely covers its cultivation costs.

definition.ar: استزراع الأحياء البحرية في مواطنها الطبيعية، عادة للأغرضا التجارية.
definition.en: Cultivation of marine organisms in their natural habitats, usually for commercial purposes.
Marine Wetlands are areas that are sometimes covered with water andsometimes dry, being influenced by marine water level and tidalfluctuations.
number of species types in a particular ecosystem in the world's oceans and seas
Branch of biology concerned with the organisms and habitats of the seas and oceans.
organisms living in either the pelagic environment (plankton and nekton) or the benthic environment (benthos)
Branch of chemistry that deals with the properties, composition, structure, and interaction of substances in the seas and oceans.

definition.ar: أي جزء من البحر أو المحيط موضوع تحت حماية خاصة، وغالبا ما يكون ذلك لمنع أو تقليص الضرر الواقع على الحياة البرية والنظم الإيكولوجية فيه.
definition.en: Any section of a sea or ocean designated for special protection, often to prevent or reduce harm to its wildlife and ecosystems.

definition.ar: أي بيئة بحرية - من البركة إلى المحيط - تتفاعل فيها النياتات والحيوانات مع الملامح الكيميائية والفيزيائية للبيئة.
definition.en: Any marine environment, from pond to ocean, in which plants and animals interact with the chemical and physical features of the environment.
Biological communities composed of plants and animals living primarily in or on seawater.

definition.ar: تتضمن البيئات البحرية مصاب الأنهار والمناطق الساحلية البحرية والمجاورة للساحل ومناطق المحيط المفتوح وأعماق البحار.
definition.en: Marine environments include estuaries, coastal marine and nearshore zones, and open-ocean-deep-sea regions.
The act of watching,keeping track of or checking the ocean(pelagic orbottom conditions) for a special purpose.

definition.ar: محصول الحيوانات والنباتات الذي يأتي من المحيط لتوفير الغذاء والترفيه للإنسان، والغذاء للحيوان، ومجموعة من المواد العضوية المختلفة للصناعات.
definition.en: The harvest of animals and plants from the ocean to provide food and recreation for people, food for animals, and a variety of organic materials for industry.
The stock of fisheries located in seas and oceans.
Processes that control chemical distributions in the ocean.
The related chemical and geological properties of the ocean.
Branch of geology concerned with the composition, geologic history, and earth processes of the ocean floor and the continental margin.
Branch of earth sciences concerned with the physical processes of the oceans and continental margins. We include here studies of large bodies of brackish and fresh water, such as lakes and rivers.
Pertaining to the changes in the Earth's gravitational field due tovariances in the oceanic crust.
Pertaining to the measurement of the Earth's magnetic field through theworld's oceans to detect variances in the oceanic crust.

definition.ar: ثدييات تكيفت مع العيش في البحر مثل الحيتان والدلافين وخنازير البحر.
definition.en: Mammals which have adapted to live in the sea, such as whales, dolphins, porpoises, etc.
The act of watching,keeping track of or checking the ocean(pelagic orbottom conditions) for a special purpose.

definition.ar: محمية دائمة على قاع البحر للحفاظ على انواع الكائنات.
definition.en: A permanent reservation on the seabed for the conservation of species.

definition.ar: أي تغير مدمر للبيئة البحرية ينجم عن إطلاق متعمد أو غير مقصود لمواد خطرة أو سامة، مثل مياه المخلفات المائية الصناعية أو التجارية أو العمرانية.
definition.en: Any detrimental alteration of the marine environment caused by the intentional or accidental release of dangerous or toxic substances, such as industrial, commercial and urban waste water.

definition.ar: منطقة في البحر تفرض فيها الحماية على الحياة البرية البحرية.
definition.en: Sea area where marine wildlife is protected.

definition.ar: مادة صلبة مفتتة تنشأ من تآكل الصخور ثم تستقر بعد أن كانت في حالة معلقة في الماء.
definition.en: Solid fragmental material, originated from weathering of rocks, that has settled down from a state of suspension in the water.

Loose particles of inorganic or organic origin, suspended in the watercolumn, found on the seafloor, or found in the coastal zone. Variablesinclude types of sediment, processes affecting sediment and sedimentdistribution, and characteristics of sediment.

As the Earth spins on its axis, the movement pushes ocean surface waters west away from the western edge of continents. In a process called upwelling, cool water from deep in the ocean rises to replace the surface water. Upwelling creates a layer of cool water at the surface, which cools the air immediately above the water. As the moist, marine air cools, water vapor condenses into water droplets, and low clouds form. These lumpy, sheet-like clouds are marine stratocumulus clouds, and they are a common occurrence along the western coasts of the continents, where upwelling is common. Probably no higher than a kilometer (about 3,000 feet) above the Earth’s surface, the clouds in the image hug the coastline in echo of the cool ocean currents beneath them. In contrast, warm, dry air dominates over land, keeping skies cloud free.
Debris not visible on the surface, including sunken vessels, trees, and other objects, typically generated by large-scale disasters such as tsunamis and tropical cyclones.
Marine debris detectable on the surface of the ocean.
Objects on the marine surface, including ships, boats, barges, piers, debris, and so on.
The set of geological processes within the ocean that result in thevolcanic expulsions of carbon dioxide and sulfur dioxide at the Earth's surfacethrough vents.
Observed intrinsic characteristics of marine waters affecting their ability to support life or facilitate biological processes such as waste decomposition.

definition.ar: نشاط استزراع الفواكه والخضراوات على نطاق تجاري.
definition.en: The business of growing fruit and vegetables on a commercial scale.

Design of the structure and format of digital queries and responses concerning scientific data resources. Refers to exchanges in which the structure and content of the queries is interpreted by software both when generated and when received.

definition.ar: منطقة من الأراضي المنخفضة التي تتعرض للغمر بصورة دورية، بها شجيرات وأشجار، وقد يكون أو لا يكون بها تكوينات من الخث.
definition.en: An periodically inundated area of low ground having shrubs and trees, with or without the formation of peat.
Type of wetland, featuring grasses, rushes, reeds, typhas, sedges, and other herbaceous plants (possibly with low-growing woody plants) in a context of shallow water.

definition.ar: أي حيوان ثديي أسترالي له كيس يحمل فيه صغاره. وتلد الكيسيات صغارها وهي مرحلة مبكرة للغاية من النمو بالمقارنة بغيرها من الثدييات ومن ثم تحتاج الصغار إلى أن تظل محمية في كيس الأم بضعة أشهر حتى تصبح قادرة على الاعتماد علي نفسها.
definition.en: Type of Australian mammal with a pouch in which the young are carried. Marsupials give birth to young at a much earlier stage of development than other mammals so that the young need to be protected in the mother's pouch for some months until they become able to look after themselves.

The definition of how the mass of an area changes over time; i.e. how balanced the mass is (e.g., whether processes that cause an increase mass, such as precipitation, are balanced with processes that cause mass loss, such as runoff and evaporation).

mass extinction is a sharp decrease in the diversity and abundance of macroscopic life. They occur when the rate of extinction increases with respect to the rate of speciation. Because the majority of diversity and biomass on Earth is microbial, and thus difficult to measure, recorded extinction events affect the easily observed, biologically complex component of the biosphere rather than the total diversity and abundance of life.[1]

Instrumental technique to separate and identify molecules. Gaseous ions are formed, with or without fragmentation. Their mass/charge ratios and relative electrical abundance are then measured or the spectra are recorded.
The change in mass from one specified period of time to another specified period of time.
Industrial and commercial processes by which material resources are extracted, used or consumed, and disposed or recycled.

Operational representation of a system in which the characteristics and behaviors of the component processes, phenomena, or objects, understood using mathematical relationships, are represented by numerical values (measured or hypothetical), so that calculations carried out using them return numerical estimates of system parameters that were not measured directly.
A computer algorithm or model, which was created to represent a simplified version of a real world situation.

The standard measure of a tropical cyclone's intensity. When the term is applied to a particular weather system, it refers to the highest one-minute average wind (at an elevation of 10 meters with an unobstructed exposure) associated with that weather system at a particular point in time.
Highest/Lowest air temperature attained during a specific time interval; usually 24 hours.
Maximum wind recorded from a tropical cyclone at the Earth's surface.
