definition.en: Any of a class of high-molecular weight polymer compounds composed of a variety of alfa-amino acids joined by peptide linkages.

Proteomics is the study of the interactions, function, composition, and structures of proteins and their cellular activities. Proteomics provides a better understanding of the structure and function of an organism.

Unicellular eukaryotes (organisms possessing nucleated cells) with affinities to both plants and animals. Classed in the Protista or Potoctista kingdom, they include protozoans, foraminifera, radiolarians, fungi and some algae.
The rate of flow of protons through a reference surface, measured in particlesper unit area.

definition.ar: شعبة متنوعة من الكائنات متناهية الصغر حقيقية النوى. يتراوح تركيبها من الجبلات البسيطة أحادية النواة إلى الأشكال التى تعيش في مستعمرات. جسمها عار أو مغطى بصدفة، وتتحرك بواسطة أقدام كاذبة أو أهداب أو سياط. وتميل جميع الأنواع الطافية منها إلى تماثل الأبعاد، بينما تأخذ الأنواع الثابتة شكلا إشعاعيا. تتغذى بطريقة ذاتية أو بالابتلاع أو بالترمم.
definition.en: A diverse phylum of eukaryotic microorganisms; the structure varies from a simple uninucleate protoplast to colonial forms, the body is either naked or covered by a test, locomotion is by means of pseudopodia or cilia or flagella, there is a tendency toward universal symmetry in floating species and radial symmetry in sessile types, and nutrition may be phagotrophic or autotrophic or saprozoic.

definition.ar: قطع أو إزالة الأجزاء أو الاغصان الميتة أو الحية من النبات لتحسين مظهره أو نموه.
definition.en: The cutting off or removal of dead or living parts or branches of a plant to improve shape or growth.
Provision of water by local governments or private companies for residential, commercial, and light industrial use.
The removal of unwanted constituents from a substance.

definition.ar: فعل أو عملية تخليص جزء من التربة من التلوث أيا كان نوعه عىل طريق العمليات الطبيعية غالبا.
definition.en: The act or process in which a section of the ground is freed from pollution or any type of contamination, often through natural processes.

definition.ar: أي قاعدة من مجموعة من القواعد النيتروجينية مثل الجوانين والأدينين، التي تشتق من البورين وتعد من مكونات الأحماض النووية وأنواع معينة من الإنزيمات المرافقة.
definition.en: Any of a number of nitrogenous bases, such as guanine and adenine, that are derivatives of purine and constituents of nucleic acids and certain coenzymes.
Use of a small, hand-held tube pressed into unconsolidated material for sampling.
The zone of the ocean in which density increases rapidly withdepth. Temperature falls and salinity rises in this zone.

definition.ar: مركب كيميائي ينتمي لعائلة ثنائي الفينيل متعدد الكلورة، يستخدم في إنتاج المعدات الكهربية التي تتطلب مائعا عازلا مثل محولات ومكثفات الطاقة إلى جانب الماكينات الهيدروليكية ومضخات التفريغ وأجهزة ضغط الهواء وموائع طفايات الحريق.
definition.en: Chemical compound belonging to the polychlorinated biphenyls family, used in the production of electrical equipment which requires dielectric fluid such as power transformers and capacitors, as well as in hydraulic machinery, vacuum pumps, compressors and heat-exchanger fluids.

Refers to the distribution and size of the pyroclastic elements when they are erupted from a volcano. In moving pyroclastic systems, particles are sorted as a function of their sizes, densities and shapes. The analysis of the distribution of these characteristics in particle populations of pyroclastic deposits is a major tool in evaluating properties and regimes of parent transport systems.
The composition and texture of pyroclastic particles.

Pyrocumulonimbus is the fire-breathing dragon of clouds. A cumulonimbus without the ''pyre'' part is imposing enough -- a massive, anvil-shaped tower of power reaching five miles (8 km) high, hurling thunderbolts, wind and rain.Add smoke and fire to the mix and you have pyrocumulonimbus, an explosive storm cloud actually created by the smoke and heat from fire, and which can ravage tens of thousands of acres. And in the process, ''pyroCb'' storms funnel their smoke like a chimney into Earth's stratosphere, with lingering ill effects.
A cumulus cloud formed by a rising thermal from a fire, or enhanced by buoyant plume emissions from an industrial combustion process.

Also known as real-time PCR, is a method of DNA amplification that allows determination of the absolute quantity of target DNA in the sample according to a calibration curve constructed of serially diluted standard samples with known concentrations or copy numbers. It allows for the real-time quantification of amplicons, as opposed to post-amplification as in PCR.

definition.ar: الاستغلال السطحي والإزالة السطحية للصخور أو الترسيبات المعدنية من القشرة الأرضية.
definition.en: The surface exploitation and removal of stone or mineral deposits from the earth's crust.

A stratospheric (16 to 35 km altitude) oscillation of equatorial east-west winds which vary with a period of about 26 to 30 months or roughly 2 years; typically blowing for 12-16 months from the east, then reverse and blowing 12-16 months from the west, then back to easterly again.
The quasi-biennial oscillation (QBO) is a quasi-periodic oscillation of the equatorial zonal wind between easterlies and westerlies in the tropical stratosphere with a mean period of 28 to 29 months.
area with a pleasant soundscape and in which noise, i.e. unwanted sound, is absent or at least not dominant
definition.fr: espace présentant un environnement sonore agréable et dans lequel le bruit, c'est-à-dire le son indésirable, est absent ou ne prédomine pas

definition.en: Restriction-site Associated DNA Sequencing, a method that samples at reduced complexity across target genomes. Mainly used to deliver high resolution population genomic data without whole-genome sequencing.
An acronym for radio detection and ranging, radar uses radio waves (microwave portion of the spectrum) to detect the presence of objects and determine their range (position).

The (microwave) signal reflected by elements of an illuminated scene back in the direction of the radar. It is so named to make clear the difference between energy scattered in arbitrary directions, and that which returns to the radar and thus may be received and recorded by the sensor.

Measure of radar reflectivity, expressed in terms of the physical size of a hypothetical, uniformly scattering sphere that would give rise to the same level of reflection as that observed from the sample target.
A mapping of the observed radar reflectivity of a scene, consisting of a file of digital numbers assigned to spatial positions on a grid of pixels.
A remote sensing technique which uses the reflection of pulsed high frequency radio waves to determine the speed, direction, and distance of faraway objects.
The property of illuminated objects to reradiate a portion of the incident microwave energy.
The flux density or radiant energy per unit area of a radiating surface.

definition.ar: انبعاث أي أشعة من مصدر طبيعي أو من صنع الإنسان، مثل موجات الراديو وأشعة الشمس والأشعة السينية الطبية والنفايات النووية والترسب النووي الناجم عن الأسلحة النووية وإنتاج الطاقة النووية. وينقسم الإشعاع عادة إلى الإشعاع المؤين مثل الإشعاع الحراري (الحرارة) والضوء، والإشعاع النووي. ويتضمن الإشعاع غير المؤين الأشعة فوق البنفسجية الآتية من الشمس والتي على الرغم من أنها تدمر الخلايا والأنسجة فإنها لا تؤدي إلى أحداث التأين الذي يميز الإشعاع النووي.
definition.en: Emission of any rays from either natural or man-made origins, such as radio waves, the sun's rays, medical X-rays and the fall-out and nuclear wastes produced by nuclear weapons and nuclear energy production. Radiation is usually divided between non-ionizing radiation, such as thermal radiation (heat) and light, and nuclear radiation. Non-ionizing radiation includes ultraviolet radiation from the sun which, although it can damage cells and tissues, does not involve the ionization events of nuclear radiation.

definition.ar: التعرض لإشعاع مؤين لمدة طويلة من مصادر متعددة يمكن أن يكون ضارا. فالإشعاع النووي الآتي من الترسب الناجم عن الأسلحة النووية أو من محطات الطاقة، والمستوى الطبيعي من الإشعاع الآتي من المواد الموجودة طبيعيا في التربة، والتعرض للأشعة السينية يمكن أن يؤدي للمرض بسبب الإشعاع. أما التعرض الشديد للإشعاع فيمكن أن يقتل سريعا، وأي إنسان يتعرض للإشعاع يحتمل أن تظهر لديه أنواع معينة من السرطانات أكثر من غيره من أفراد المجتمع.
definition.en: Prolonged exposure to ionizing radiation from various sources can be harmful. Nuclear radiation from fallout from nuclear weapons or from power stations, background radiation from substances naturally present in the soil, exposure to X-rays can cause radiation sickness. Massive exposure to radiation can kill quickly and any person exposed to radiation is more likely to develop certain types of cancer than other members of the population.

definition.ar: فعل أو حالة التعرض للطاقة الإلكترومغناطيسية بقوة كافية لتأين الذرات مما يمثل خطرا على صحة الإنسان والبيئة.
definition.en: The act or state of being subjected to electromagnetic energy strong enough to ionize atoms thereby posing a threat to human health or the environment.

A common type of fog, produced over a land area when radiational cooling reduces the air temperature to or below its dewpoint.Thus, a strict radiation fog is a nighttime occurrence, although it may begin to form by evening twilight and often does not dissipate until after sunrise. Factors favoring the formation of radiation fog are 1) a shallow surface layer of relatively moist air beneath a dry layer and clear skies, and 2) light surface winds. It can be most confusing near sea coasts with cold coastal water. It can be difficult at times to differentiate between this and other types of fog, especially since nighttime cooling intensifies all fogs. Radiation fog is frequently and logically called ground fog, but in U.S. weather observing practice, the latter term is defined only with respect to the amount of sky that is obscured by the fog.

definition.ar: إجراءات أو تدابير أو معدات وقائية تستخدم لحماية الإنسان والممتلكات والموارد الطبيعية أو الدفاع عنها ضد الآثار الضارة للطاقة المؤينة.
definition.en: Precautionary actions, measures or equipment implemented to guard or defend people, property and natural resources from the harmful effects of ionizing energy.

In meteorology, the result of radiative cooling of the earth's surface and adjacent air.Radiational cooling occurs, as is typical on calm, clear nights, whenever the longwave emission from the surface is not balanced by significant amounts of absorbed shortwave radiation or downwelling longwave from the atmosphere above the surface, and there are no nonradiative sources of sufficient energy to make up the difference.
The expansion or spreading out of radiation in clouds.
The amount of radiation incident on a given surface per unit time.

A change imposed upon the climate system which modifies the radiativebalance of that system. The causes of such a change may include changes inthe sun, clouds, ice, greenhouse gases, volcanic activity, and otheragents. Radiative forcing is often specified as the net change in energyflux at the troposphere (watts per square meter). Radiative forcing maysometimes be referred to as external forcing or perturbations of theclimate.
Radio occultation (RO) is a remote sensing technique used for measuring the physical properties of a planetary atmosphere or ring system.
Radio waves are that portion of the electromagnetic spectrum having wavelengths longer than about 10 cm.
An electrical impusle sent through the atmosphere at radio frequency(usually between 10 kHz and 300,000 MHz).

definition.ar: تلوث مادة أو كائن حي أو موقع بسبب مادة مشعة.
definition.en: Contamination of a substance, living organism or site caused by radioactive material.

definition.ar: مخلفات ناجمة عن انبعاث جسيمات أو إشعاع إلكترومغناطيسي بسبب تحلل أنوية العناصر غير المستقرة.
definition.en: Waste generated by the emission of particulate or electromagnetic radiation resulting from the decay of the nuclei of unstable elements.
An element with an unstable nucleus, which radiates alpha, beta or gamma radiation and gets converted to a stable element.

definition.ar: إطلاق المواد المشعة في البيئة، وهي المواد المشتقة من الإنشاءات النووية ومن التعدين وعمليات التنقية والمعالجة للعناصر المشعة.
definition.en: The release of radioactive substances into the environment deriving from nuclear installations and from mining, purification and enrichment operations of radioactive elements.

definition.ar: المادة التي تهبط على الأرض أو الماء بعيدا عن موقع انفجار نووي سطحي أو باطني.
definition.en: The material that descends to the earth or water well beyond the site of a surface or subsurface nuclear explosion.

definition.ar: مادة تتعرض لتحلل تلقائي أوتفكك نويات الذرة الذي يعطي حرارة إشعاعية في صورة جسيمات أو موجات، ويرتبط عادة بانفجار سلاح نووي أو إطلاق عارض من محطة للطاقة النووية، أو من منشأة حفظ أو حاوية نقل نووية.
definition.en: A substance undergoing spontaneous decay or disintegration of atomic nuclei and giving off radiant energy in the form of particles or waves, often associated with an explosion of a nuclear weapon or an accidental release from a nuclear power plant, holding facility or transporting container.

definition.ar: أي مادة تحتوي على نويدة مشعة أو أكثر ولا يمكن تجاهل نشاطها أو تركيزها فيما يتعلق بالحماية من الإشعاع.
definition.en: Any substance that contains one or more radionuclides of which the activity or the concentration cannot be disregarded as far as radiation protection is concerned.

definition.ar: أي نفايات تبعث إشعاعا أعلى من المستوى الطبيعي المعتاد، بما في ذلك المنتجات الثانوية السامة لصناعة الطاقة النووية.
definition.en: Any waste that emit radiation in excess of normal background level, including the toxic by-products of the nuclear energy industry.

definition.ar: خاصية في بعض أنوية الذرات تجعلها تتحلل تلقائيا مع فقد للطاقة من خلال انبعاث إشعاع من الجسيمات المشحونة /أو اشعة جاما.
definition.en: The property possessed by some atomic nuclei of disintegrating spontaneously, with loss of energy through emission of a charged particle and/or gamma radiation.

Radiocarbon refers to radioactive carbon especially carbon-14, but alsocarbon-10 and carbon-12. Carbon-14 is a heavy radioactive isotope of Carbonhaving a mass of 14 and a half-life of 5730 +/-40 years. Carbon-14 is useful indating organic materials during the last 50,000 years.
An element that is naturally radioactive.

Any radioactive form of a chemical element, having the same atomic weight as that element (i.e. same number of protons), but a different number of neutrons. Used in a variety of oceanic applications such as dating andmovement of water masses.
Methods for age determination of rocks and fossils by measuring the proportions of naturally occurring radioactive isotopes to their decay products.
Nuclides which are unstable and that decay or disintegratespontaneously, emitting radiation. A synonym for radioactive nuclide.
Alkaline earth element with symbol Ra and atomic number 88

definition.ar: عنصر غازي مشع ينبعث بصورة طبيعية من الصخور والمعادن التي بها عناصر مشعة. وينطلق في المناجم عدا مناجم الفحم، كما في مناجم القصدير والحديد والفلوسبار واليورانيوم. والرادون يطلق جسيمات ألفا، مثلما تفعل منتجاته المتحللة أيضا. ويعد أحد مسببات الظهور المفرط لسرطان الرئة بين العاملين بتعدين اليورانيوم. كما تثار المخاوف بشأن مستويات ظهور الرادون في بعض المساكن القريبة عادة من مناطق الصخور الجرانيتية أو مناطق تعدين القصدير القديمة.
definition.en: A radioactive gaseous element emitted naturally from rocks and minerals where radioactive elements are present. It is released in non-coal mines, e.g. tin, iron, fluorspar, uranium. Radon is an alpha particle emitter as are its decay products and has been indicted as a cause of excessive occurrence of lung cancer in uranium miners. Concern has been expressed at radon levels in some housing usually adjacent to granite rocks or old tin mining regions.

A vertical representation of the measurement of Radon (chemical symbol Rn, an odorless, colorless, radioactive gas). Radon comes from the natural decay of uranium and radium found in nearly all rocks and soils.

The measurement of Radon (chemical symbol Rn, an odorless, colorless, radioactive gas) at the surface of the earth. Radon comes from the natural decay of uranium and radium found in nearly all rocks and soils.

definition.ar: قطعة من مخلفات نسجية مهملة، إما من مخلفات ما بعد الاستهلاك أو ما قبله كما في قصاصات عمليات التصنيع.
definition.en: Discarded textile waste, either post-consumer waste or pre-consumer waste, such as manufacturing process scraps.

definition.ar: هطول على هيئة قطرات مائية سائلة قطرها يزيد عن 0.5 ملليمتر.
definition.en: Precipitation in the form of liquid water drops with diameters greater than 0.5 millimeter.

definition.ar: غابة من الأشجار عريضة الأوراق دائمة الخضرة غالبا توجد في المناخ الرطب على نحو مستمر في المناطق المدارية ودون المدارية وبعض أجزاء المناطق المعتدلة.
definition.en: A forest of broad-leaved, mainly evergreen, trees found in continually moist climates in the tropics, subtropics, and some parts of the temperate zones.
Rain Type describes the physical processes creating the precipitation profile. The most important distinction being between convective and stratiform.
Total rain water in the atmospheric column

name.ar: مطر من تكثف الماء حول جزيئات الجو
name.fr: Piégeage de particules par des gouttes

definition.ar: عملية تجعل الجسيمات الموجودة في الغلاف الجوي تتصرف كما لو كانت مركزا تتكون حولة قطرات الماء الذي يسقط بعد ذلك على هيئة مطر.
definition.en: Process by which particles in the atmosphere act as centres round which water can form drops which then falls as rain.
Range Changes with respect to Migration include forays outside the home range, usually in search of suitable habitat or mating opportunities.

Pertaining to land on which the climax or potential plant cover is composed principally of native grasses, grasslike plants, forbs or shrubs suitable for gazing and browsing, and introduced forage species that are managed like rangelands.

definition.ar: نبات صليبي الأوراق أوراسي الموطن، اسمه العلمي براسيكا نيبوس، يزرع من أجل بذوره التي تعطي زيتا مفيدا ويستعمل أيضا كعلف نباتي.
definition.en: A Eurasian cruciferous plant, Brassica napus, that is cultivated for its seeds, which yield a useful oil, and as a fodder plant.
one of a set of seventeen chemical elements in the periodic table, specifically the fifteen lanthanides plus scandium and yttrium
A group of elements including the lanthanoids, or lanthanides, of interest because they are used in modern technological industries. Yttrium and scandium are often included in this group.

definition.ar: تعتمد الدول المتقدمة على إمداد ثابت من المواد الخام لصناعاتها. وقد أصبح إجمالي المتطلبات من الموارد يرتفع سريعا حول العالم أجمع. وعلى الرغم من أن تعداد السكان يتزايد ببطء في الدول المتقدمة فإن نصيب الفرد من الاستخدام فيها يرتفع سريعا، بينما يحدث العكس في الدول النامية. وتصنف المواد الخام تقليديا على أنها موارد غير متجددة، ولكن من المهم التمييز بين الموارد القابلة للفقد والموارد غير القابلة للفقد مثل المعادن التي يمكن استخدامها مرات عديدة عن طريق عمليات إعادة التدوير.
definition.en: The developed countries depend on a stable supply of raw materials for their industries. Total resource requirements are increasing rapidly over the entire world. In developed countries, although population is increasing slowly, per capita use is increasing rapidly, while the opposite is happening in developing countries. Traditionally raw materials have been classified as non-renewable resources, but a distinction may be important between "loosable" resources, such as oil and coal, and "non-loosable" resources, such as metals, which can be used several times over by recycling processes.

definition.ar: تدابير تستخدم لضمان إمكانية النفاذ إلى المواد الخام أو غير المعالجة أو المعالجة جزئيا والتي تستخدم كأساس لتغذية عمليات المعالجة أو التصنيع.
definition.en: Measures used to ensure the provision of or the access to crude, unprocessed or partially processed materials used as feedstock for processing or manufacturing.

A dominant form of light scattering in the upper atmosphere, which produces the blue color of the sky. It is caused by atmospheric particulates that have very small diameters relative to the wavelength of the light, such as dust particles or atmospheric gases like nitrogen and oxygen.

definition.ar: فرع من فروع الكيمياء الطبيعية يعنى بآليات ومعدلات التفاعلات الكيميائية.
definition.en: That branch of physical chemistry concerned with the mechanisms and rates of chemical reactions.
Chemical reactions occurring during ground-water flow.

definition.ar: الدراسات والأنشطة التي تسعى لتقليل خطر حوادث المفاعلات النووية إلى أدنى حد ممكن.
definition.en: Those studies and activities that seek to minimise the risk of a nuclear reactor accident.

Gathering information through periodic or continuous measurement in the field to provide a view of current conditions. In some instances, observations may not be subject to rigorous review before release; this will be noted in the documentation accompanying the data.
The speed over time at which land mass rises.

Are often observed as a series of transverse ridges running across a valley behind a terminal moraine. They form perpendicular to the lateral moraines that they reside between and are composed of unconsolidated debris deposited by the glacier. They are created during temporary halts in a glacier's retreat.
Amount of water needed to replenish ground water.
Number of times water goes through a cycle to be replenished.

Reclamation, as used here refers, to putting a natural resource to a newor altered use. Restoration is the return of an ecosystem to aclose approximation of its condition prior to disturbance. Revegetation isthe planting of vegetation in an area where vegetation has been removed.
Pursuit of leisure-time activities, typically out of doors.
The stock of fish and other seafood resources in areas used for recreational fishing.

definition.ar: طريقة لاسترجاع الموارد تقوم على جمع ومعالجة مخلفات المنتجات لاستخدامها كمادة خام في تصنيع نفس المنتج مرة أخرى أو منتج آخر مشابه.
definition.en: A resource recovery method involving the collection and treatment of a waste product for use as raw material in the manufacture of the same or a similar product.

definition.ar: مياه البحر المغطاة بنمو طحلبي مفاجئ أو تغير لونها بسببه، أو بسبب ارتفاع شديد في كمية الكائنات وحيدة الخلية المسماة السوطيات الدوارة. والمد الأحمر عادة ما يكون قاتلا للكثير من أشكال الحياة البحرية، وفي بعض الحالات يمكن أن يؤدي إلى وفاة الإنسان لأن السوطيات الدوارة يأكلها المحار وبلح البحر ثم يقوم بتركيز الذيفانات التي تولدها والتي تؤدي لشل الأعضاء.
definition.en: Sea water which is covered or discoloured by the sudden growth of algal bloom or by a great increase in single-celled organisms, dinoflagellates. Red tides are often fatal to many forms of marine life and, in some cases, can result in human deaths because the dinoflagellates are eaten by clams and mussels which concentrate the paralysing toxins which they produce.

definition.ar: أي نوع من الأنواع العديدة من النباتات الصلبة الطويلة التي تشبه الحشائش والتي تنمو متقاربة في جماعات قرب الماء.
definition.en: Any of various types of tall stiff grass-like plants growing together in groups near water.

definition.ar: صف من الصخور في منطقة المد بأحد السواحل، يكون مغمورا عند ارتفاع الماء لكنه ينكشف عند انحساره.
definition.en: A line of rocks in the tidal zone of a coast, submerged at high water but partly uncovered at low water.
Biological communities formed by the skeletons of calcareous seawater organisms, usually corals.
Pertaining to the baseline state of the Earth's magnetic field used to base all other measurements from.
A general term referring to the radiation reflected from, or scattered back through, a given surface in response to radiation incident on the surface with the same wavelength or wavelength range.

Reflected infrared In remote sensing, infrared which is solar-generated electromagnetic radiation that has been reflected from an object. Characteristically, reflected infrared radiation has a wavelength between 0.7 μm and 3 μm and is therefore near-infrared.

definition.ar: ارتداد الموجات أو الجسيمات من على السطوح التي تسقط عليها.
definition.en: The return of waves or particles from surfaces on which they are incident.

definition.ar: زراعة الأشجار في مناطق غابات سبق إزالتها. وقد اكتسبت إعادة التشجير أهمية مطردة لمنع أو عكس التدهور البيئي والمساعدة على تعظيم العوائد الاقتصادية للأراضي المشجرة تجاريا.
definition.en: The planting of trees in forest areas which have been cleared. Reforestation has become increasingly important for preventing or reversing environmental degradation and for helping to maximize economic returns on commercially forested lands.

Refractivity 𝑁 is the index of refraction 𝑛 less unity in parts per million, or 𝑁 = (𝑛 − 1) × 10^6. In GNSS radio occultation, it is retrieved using the Abel transform as applied to profiles of bending angle vs. impact parameter. Its dimension is unitless but typically designated as “N-units”, and its associated independent coordinate is altitude above the mean sea-level geoid.

definition.ar: منطقة معزولة يمنع الوصول إليها صمدت فيها النباتات والحيوانات خلال فترة من التغير المناخي القاري الذي جعل المساحات المحيطة بها غير قابلة للعيش، وخصوصا المناطق الخالية من الجليد والأنهار الجليدية أو القريبة من طبقات الجليد القاري أو الطواقي الجليدية المرتفعة حيث ناضلت الكائنات شديدة المراس للبقاء على قيد الحياة خلال المرحلة الجليدية، وفي أزمنة لاحقة أصبحت مركز انتشار لإعادة إمداد المناطق المحيطة بالكائنات بعد اعتدال المناخ.
definition.en: A restricted and isolated area in which plants and animals persisted during a period of continental climatic change that made surrounding areas uninhabitable; especially an ice-free or unglaciated area within or close to a continental ice sheet or upland ice cap, where hardy biotas eked out an existence during a glacial phase. It later served as a center of dispersal for the repopulation of surrounding areas after climatic readjustment.

definition.ar: ماكينة تستخدم لتكسير مواد المخلفات إلى قطع أصغر حجما بالقطع و/أو الضغط.
definition.en: A machine used to break up refuse material into smaller pieces by tearing and/or impact.
Refers to several levels of regional climates that are used to describe the immutable characteristics of an area.

definition.ar: حديقة تتولى منطقة معينة تشغيلها وإدارتها.
definition.en: A park operated and managed by a region.
Statistical analysis based on the functional relationships of two or more related variables. Predicts the value of one variable when the other two are given.
Return of a species to an area through the intervention of man.
Determination of the percentage of individuals of one group in comparison to the total of all individuals in a given area.
The ratio of the vapor pressure to the saturation vapor pressure with respect to water.

The Relative permittivity (or dielectric constant, ε) is a measure of the ease with which a material is polarized by an electric field relative to vacuum. It is defined by the magnitude of the dielectric polarization (dipole moment per unit volume) induced by a unit field. Dielectric constants have no units - they are coefficients that multiply the capacitance with free space (or vacuum) as dielectric.

The counter-clockwise (CCW) or clockwise (CW) circulation of weather systems. CCW (cyclonic) rotation is considered '+' ... same as Earth; CW (anticyclonic) rotation is considered to be '-'; consists of two parts: relative vorticity due to curved flow and that due to wind shear.

definition.ar: إطلاق أي كائنات عضوية في البيئة يعد خطرا لأنها فور إطلاقها قد تظهر عليها قدرة ممرضة لم تكن معروفة عنها من قبل، أو قد تهيمن على أنواع من البكتيريا التي تظهر بصورة طبيعية، أو تنقل سمات غير مرغوبة إلى هذه البكتيريا الأصيلة.
definition.en: The release of organisms in the environment creates the risk that once released they may exhibit some previously unknown pathogenicity, might take over from some naturally occurring bacteria or pass on some unwanted trait to such indigenous bacteria.

definition.ar: الشكل أو التكوين أو عدم الاستواء الفيزيائي عموما في جزء ما من سطح الأرض، مع الإشارة إلى التفاوت في الارتفاع والانحدار أو عدم الانتظام في سطح الأرض. وكذلك ارتفاع سطح ما عن الأرض أو الاختلاف في الارتفاع إجمالا.
definition.en: The physical shape, configuration or general unevenness of a part of the Earth's surface, considered with reference to variation of height and slope or to irregularities of the land surface; the elevation or difference in elevation, considered collectively, of a land surface.
Magnetic characteristic of rocks and deposits reflective of the earth's magnetic field at the time of the deposit's formation.
Methods for decontaminating, reclaiming, and restoring natural resources or reducing the effects of hazards.

Acquiring information about a natural feature or phenomenon, such as the Earth's surface, without actually being in contact with it. USGS remote sensing is usually carried out with airborne or spaceborne sensors or cameras.

definition.ar: مصطلح عام يشير إلى إزالة مواد من وسط أو من بيئة ما.
definition.en: General term indicating the elimination of substances from a medium or from the environment.

Energy derived from natural processes (e.g. sunlight and wind) that are replenished at a faster rate than they are consumed. Solar, wind, geothermal, hydro, and some forms of biomass are common sources of renewable energy.

definition.ar: مصادر للطاقة لا تعتمد على أنواع الوقود الموجود منها مخزون محدد فقط. وأكثر المصادر المتجددة استخداما على نطاق واسع هو الطاقة الهيدروليكية، ومن المصادر المتجددة الأخرى طاقة الكتلة الحيوية والطاقة الشمسية وطاقة المد وطاقة الأمواج وطاقة الرياح. ويلاحظ أن طاقة الكتلة الحيوية لا تتفادى خطر تأثير الاحتباس الحراري.
definition.en: Energy sources that do not rely on fuels of which there are only finite stocks. The most widely used renewable source is hydroelectric power; other renewable sources are biomass energy, solar energy, tidal energy, wave energy, and wind energy; biomass energy does not avoid the danger of the greenhouse effect.

definition.ar: مصادر قابلة للتجدد أو الإحلال بصورة منتظمة مثل عمليات التكاثر والاستزراع العضوي مثلما يحدث في الزراعة وتربية الحيوان وزرع الغابات والمصايد السمكية.
definition.en: Resources capable of being continuously renewed or replaced through such processes as organic reproduction and cultivation such as those practiced in agriculture, animal husbandry, forestry and fisheries.
Substitution of an atom or atomic group with a different one.
definition.ar: استبدال ذرة أو مجموعة ذرية بأخرى مختلفة.
أي عملية من مجموعة متنوعة من العمليات الجنسية أو اللاجنسية التي تنتج بها الحيوانات أو النباتات كائنات جديدة تشبهها.
definition.en: Any of various processes, either sexual or asexual, by which an animal or plant produces one or more individuals similar to itself.

definition.ar: طائفة من الفقاريات الأرضية تتميز بعدم وجود شعر أو ريش أو غدد لبنية. جلدها مغطى بحراشف، ولها قلب مقسم إلى ثلاثة أقسام، وتجويفها الصدري والبطني متصلان.
definition.en: A class of terrestrial vertebrates, characterized by the lack of hair, feathers, and mammary glands; the skin is covered with scales, they have a three chambered heart and the pleural and peritoneal cavities are continuous.

Cold-blooded vertebrates of the class Reptilia. Characterized by skin covered with scales or horny plates and reproduced by eggs. Includes snakes, lizards, crocodiles, alligators, turtles, and extinct species such as dinosaurs.

definition.ar: أي سلسلة من الإجراءات والأجهزة المسختدمة من قبل المدربين عليها لتوفير المساعدة الفورية لمن هم في خطر أو للمصابين.
definition.en: Any series of procedures and devices used by trained personnel to provide immediate assistance to persons who are in danger or injured.

definition.ar: مساحة من الأرض أو المياه مخصصة لغرض معين، وهو في الغالب منع أو تقليص الضرر على الحياة البرية والنظم الإيكولوجية فيها.
definition.en: Any area of land or water that has been set aside for a special purpose, often to prevent or reduce harm to its wildlife and ecosystems.

NOAA’s Residential Energy Demand Temperature Index (REDTI) correlates heating and cooling degree-day datawith population. A hot summer in sparsely populated Wyoming will not have the same impact on energy use as ahot summer in the Mid-Atlantic. June 2010 had the second highest REDTI on record due to especially hottemperatures in the heavily populated South and Southeast regions. The REDTI is measured on a scale of zero to 100, with 100 being the highest population weighted degree day average and zero being the lowest.

definition.ar: كمية من الماء تترك في مجرى مائي بعد أن يغذي محطة للطاقة المائية للحفاظ على تدفق معقول في أوقات الجفاف مما يسمح ببقاء المجتمعات الحيوية الموجودة.
definition.en: Amount of water left in a water course after it has fed a hydropower plant in order to maintain a satisfactory dry-weather-flow for allowing the survival of biotic communities.

definition.ar: مبيد حشري باق في البيئة لفترة غير قصيرة من الزمن ويظل أثره باقيالأيام وأسابيع وشهور.
definition.en: A pesticide remaining in the environment for a fairly long time, continuing to be effective for days, weeks, and months.

definition.ar: بقاء احتمال تعرض الإنسان أو الممتلكات أو البيئة للخطر بعد بذل كافة الجهود الممكنة لتقليل الأخطار المرتقبة.
definition.en: Remaining potential for harm to persons, property or the environment following all possible efforts to reduce predictable hazards.

definition.ar: مادة تتخلف عن أي عملية لمعالجة المخلفات، وتشمل المعالجات الصناعية أو الحضرية أو الزراعية أو التعدينية أو ما شابه ذلك.
definition.en: Material left after any waste treatment process, including industrial, urban, agricultural, mining or other similar treatments.

definition.ar: فائض المواد شبه الصلبة أو الترسيبات غير الصالحة للاستخدام الناجمة عن معالجة المخلفات المائية أو العمليات الصناعية.
definition.en: The excess, unusable semi-solids or sediment resulting from a wastewater treatment or industrial process.

definition.ar: غبار أو بقايا متخلفة عن تحويل لمادة إلى جسيمات دقيقة جدا.
definition.en: Dust or other residue left after reducing a material to very small particles.

definition.ar: إعادة تدوير المواد أو الطاقة المتبقية أو المفقودة في العمليات الصناعية وغيرها من الأنشطة البشرية. من أمثلتها الحرارة المفقودة والملوثات الغازية من عملية توليد الكهرباء والخبث الناجم عن تنقية خامات المعادن والقمامة. وتتحول البقايا إلى مخرج أو مدخل عندما يؤدي التطور التكنولوجي إلى خلق فرص اقتصادية لاستخدام المخلفات.
definition.en: Recycling of material or energy which is left over or wasted in industrial processes and other human activities. Examples include waste heat and gaseous pollutants from electricity generation, slag from metal-ore refining, and garbage. A residual becomes an output or input when a technological advance creates economic opportunities for the waste.

The ability of a system, community or society exposed to hazards to resist, absorb, accommodate to and recover from the effects of a hazard in a timely and efficient manner, including through the preservation and restoration of its essential basic structures and functions.

definition.ar: ـ 1) قدرة النبات على التغلب على الإصابة أو الاستعمار من جانب ممرض أو طفيل أو عامل لاحيوي ضار أو تعطيل هذه الإصابة أو كبحها أو منعها. ـ 2) قدرة الحشرات أو الفطريات أو الأعشاب الضارة على البقاء على الرغم من استخدام جرعات قاتلة عادة من المبيدات الحشرية أو مبيدات الفطريات أو مبيدات الأعشاب أو غيرها من مبيدات الآفات.
definition.en: 1) The ability of a plant to overcome, retard, suppress, or prevent infection or colonization by a pathogen, parasite, or adverse abiotic factor. 2) The ability of insects, fungi, weeds, or other pests to survive normally lethal doses of an insecticide, fungicide, herbicide, or other pesticide.
Electrical resistance of materials, often measured in boreholes.

definition.ar: امتصاص مادة، أو بدرجة أقل شيوعا امتزاز، مادة بواسطة الجسم أو نظام أطلقت منه هذه المادة في وقت سابق.
definition.en: Absorption or, less commonly, adsorption of material by a body or system from which the material was previously released.

definition.ar: أي مكون من مكونات البيئة يمكن استخدامه من جانب كائن من الكائنات.
definition.en: Any component of the environment that can be utilized by an organism.
Pertaining to sites of human private industry.
Statistics indicating the commercial interests in material resources, typically mineral commodities, energy, or forest or fishery resources.

definition.ar: عملية تتم في الكائنات الحية عن طريقها يأخذ الكائن الأكسجين من البيئة المحيطة به ويخرج ثاني أكسيد الكربون.
definition.en: The process in living organisms of taking in oxygen from the surroundings and giving out carbon dioxide.
The chemical process that occurs in all living cells wherein organiccompounds are broken down to release energy required for lifeprocesses.

definition.ar: أحجام الهواء التي تدخل إلى الرئتين مع الشهيق وتخرج مع الزفير.
definition.en: Air volumes inspired and expired through the lungs.

definition.ar: الهياكل والممرات المتعلقة بأخذ وطرد وتبادل الأكسجين وثاني أكسيد الكربون في جسم الحيوان الفقري.
definition.en: The structures and passages involved with the intake, expulsion and exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the vertebrate body.

definition.ar: الهياكل والممرات المتعلقة بأخذ وطرد وتبادل الأكسجين وثاني أكسيد الكربون في جسم الحيوان الفقري.
definition.en: The structures and passages involved with intake, expulsion, and exchange of oxygen and carbon dioxide in the vertebrate body.

definition.ar: بنية مقاومة تسمح للكائن بالبقاء على الرغم من وجوده في ظروف بيئية غير مواتية.
definition.en: Resistant structure that allows the organism to survive adverse environmental conditions.

definition.ar: أسلوب للحصول على الماء النقي من ماء يحتوي على ملح، كما في عملية التحلية. عندما يتم الفصل بين الماء النقي والماء المالح عن طريق غشاء شبه منفذ ويتم رفع ضغط الماء المالح فوق الضغط الأسموزي، مما يجعل الماء الأجاج يمر عبر الغشاء إلى الماء النقي. وتتطلب هذه العملية ضغطا قدره نحو 25 ضغط جوي، مما يجعل من الصعب تطبيقه على نطاق واسع.
definition.en: A method of obtaining pure water from water containing a salt, as in desalination. Pure water and the salt water are separated by a semipermeable membrane and the pressure of the salt water is raised above the osmotic pressure, causing water from the brine to pass through the membrane into the pure water. This process requires a pressure of some 25 atmospheres, which makes it difficult to apply on a large scale.
Metal element with symbol Re and atomic number 75
Metal element with symbol Rh and atomic number 45

A landform, often referred to as a drowned river valley. Rias are almost always estuaries. Rias form where sea levels rise relative to the land either as a result of eustatic sea level change (where the global sea levels rise), or isostatic sea level change (where the local land sinks).

Type of basal moraines that forms a series of ribs perpendicular to the ice flow in an ice sheet. The depressions between the ribs are sometimes filled with water making the Rogen moraines look like tigerstripes on aerial photographs.
A long, narrow, somewhat winding reef, usually associated with an atoll lagoon.

definition.ar: أي عشب منتصب، اسمه العلمي أوريزا ساتيا، ينمو في شرق آسيا في الأراضي الرطبة وله نورة زهرية متدلية وحبوب صفراء مستطيلة قابلة للأكل تتحول إلى اللون الأبيض عند تبييضها.
definition.en: An erect grass, Oryza sativa, that grows in East Asia on wet ground and has drooping flower spikes and yellow oblong edible grains that become white when polished.
A geological feature that features a chain of mountains or hills that are of a continuous elevated crest for some distance. Ridges are usually termed hills or mountains as well, depending on size.
A shallow stretch of a river or stream, where the current is above the average stream velocity and where the water forms small rippled waves as a result.

A linear-shaped lowland between highlands or mountain ranges created by the action of a geologic rift or fault. This action is manifest as crustal extension, a spreading apart of the surface which is subsequently further deepened by the forces of erosion.
Pertaining to the valley that forms down the center of a mid-ocean ridgewhere the formation of oceanic crust occurs.

The process in which continental crust is extended and thinned, forming extensional sedimentary basins and/or mafic dyke-swarms. Rifts commence as intracratonic, down-thrown blocks dominated by normal or oblique-extensional (transtensional) faults.
The process where ice forms when the water droplets in fog freeze to the outer surfaces of objects

definition.ar: إزالة الطبقات الرقيقة من المواد السطحية على نحو متساو تقريبا من مساحة واسعة من أرض مائلة قليلا، باستخدام طبقات رقيقة عريضة من الماء الجار، بدلا من التيارات المتدفقة في قنوات محددة المعالم، مثل التآكل الذي يحدث عندما تجرف مياه الأمطار طبقة رقيقة من التربة السطحية؟
definition.en: The removal of thin layers of surface material more or less evenly from an extensive area of gently sloping land, by broad continuous sheets of running water rather than by streams flowing in well-defined channels; e.g. erosion that occurs when rain washes away a thin layer of topsoil.
Riparian wetlands are the strip of woods that grow along natural wetlands.

definition.ar: ـ 1) مساحات أرضية فيها مجموع الغطاء النباتي والنظام المناخي المحلي هو نتاج لاجتماع ضغط وتأثير المياه المتدفقة طوال العام أو المياه المتدفقة على نحو متقطع... والتربة التي بها بعض سمات الرطوبة. ـ 2) منطقة واقعة على ضفة مجرى مائي كالنهر أو الجدول.
definition.en: 1) Terrestrial areas where the vegetation complex and microclimate are products of the combined pressure and influence of perennial and/or intermittent water... and soils that exhibit some wetness characteristics. 2) Zone situated on the bank of a water course such as a river or stream.
Sedimentary structures (i.e. bedforms of the lower flow regime) and indicate agitation by water (current or waves) or wind.

definition.ar: عدم الاستقرار الرأسي البطيء للقشرة الأرضية الذي يشتمل على حركات لأعلى ولأسفل كما في المنطقة البركانية الواقعة غرب نابولي في إيطاليا.
definition.en: The slow vertical instability of the earth crust involving up-and-down movements as in the volcanic district west of Naples, Italy.

name.fr: Élévation du niveau de la mer

definition.ar: ارتفاع مستوى سطح البحر هو نتيجة محتملة من نتائج الاحترار العالمي. كما أنه عندما تزداد كمية الماء الحار في المحيطات ويصبح الماء أدفأ، يرتفع الاحترار العالمي. وبالإضافة إلى ذلك، فمن الناحية النظرية قد يؤدي ارتفاع الحرارة عند القطبين إلى تقليص كمية المياه المحتبسة في الأنهار والطواقي الجليدية. وبحلول عام 3000 يمكن أن تكون البحار قد ارتفع مستواها بمعدل يتراوح بين المتر والمترين. هذا الحدث يعني بوضوح تهديد الأراضي الخفيضة، خاصة في آسيا، حيث يعيش الملايين من الناس ويمارسون الزراعة في دلتاوات الأنهار وسهول الفيضانات.
definition.en: Sea level rises are a possible consequence of global warming. As the amount of free water in the ocean increases, and as the water becomes warmer, global warming will increase. In addition, according to theory, the heating at the poles may reduce the amount of water trapped in glaciers and ice caps. By the year 3000, the seas could rise between one and two metres. Such an event would clearly threaten low-lying areas, particularly in Asia, where million of people live and farm on river deltas and flood plains.

definition.ar: العدد المتوقع من الأنفس التي يمكن أن تزهق والأشخاص الذين يمكن أن يصابوا والضرر الذي يمكن أن يلحق بالممتلكات وتعطل الأنشطة الاقتصادية بسبب ظاهرة طبيعية معينة، ومن ثم محصلة احتمال وقوع الحدث والمدى المتوقع للضرر.
definition.en: The expected number of lives lost, persons injured, damage to property and disruption of economic activity due to a particular natural phenomenon, and consequently the product of the probability of occurrence and the expected magnitude of damage.

definition.ar: أسلوب يستخدم لتحديد احتمالية أو فرصة وقوع أحداث خطرة (مثل إطلاق كمية معينة من غاز سام) والعواقب المحتملة. وضع هذا الأسلوب أصلا للاستخدام في الصناعات الكيميائية والنووية حيث توجد إمكانية وقوع أحداث معينة، بدرجة قليلة من الاحتمال، قد تكون لها نتائج خطيرة للغاية. وتبذل محاولات للاستعانة بمفاهيم مستمدة من تحليل المخاطر الاحتمالي لتحديد الآثار البيئية التي لا يسهل التنبؤ بأي درجة من الدقة بوقوعها وبطبيعتها.
definition.en: Technique used to determine the likelihood or chance of hazardous events occurring (such as release of a certain quantity of a toxic gas) and the likely consequences. Originally developed for use in nuclear and chemical industry where certain possible events, of low probability, could have extremely serious results. Attempts are being made to use concepts from probabilistic risk analysis to characterise environmental impacts, whose occurrence and nature are not easy to predict with any degree of accuracy.

definition.ar: التقييم الكيفي والكمي الذي يجرى في محاولة لتحديد الخطر الواقع على صحة الإنسان أو البيئة بسبب إجراء ما أو وجود أو استخدام مادة معينة أو ملوث معين.
definition.en: The qualitative and quantitative evaluation performed in an effort to define the risk posed to human health and/or the environment by an action or by the presence or use of a specific substance or pollutant.

change based on the identification, evaluation and prioritisation of the risks involved, followed by the application of resources to minimise, monitor and control the probability/impact of events or to maximise the realisation of opportunities
definition.fr: changement fondé sur l’identification, l’évaluation et la hiérarchisation des risques encourus, suivie de l’application de ressources pour limiter, surveiller et contrôler la probabilité/l’incidence des événements ou pour maximiser la réalisation des opportunités

definition.ar: تبادل المعلومات عن المخاطر الصحية أو البيئية بين القائمين على تقييم المخاطر والمديرين وعامة الناس والإعلام الإخباري وجماعات المصالح، إلخ.
definition.en: The exchange of information about health or environmental risks among risk assessors and managers, the general public, news media, interest groups, etc.

definition.ar: وضع أو مجموعة من الظروف يرتفع فيها احتمال وقوع الضرر على منطقة أو تعدادها إلى ما فوق المعدل المعتاد.
definition.en: The situation or set of circumstances where the probability of harm to an area or its population increases beyond a normal level.

definition.ar: خطة أو نهج للعمل يتم تفعيله إذا تجاوز احتمال وقوع الضرر على منطقة ما أو سكانها المستوى العادي.
definition.en: A scheme or method of acting that takes effect if the probability of harm to an area or its population increases beyond a normal level.

definition.ar: عملية تقييم واختيار استجابات بديلة تنظيمية وغير تنظيمية استعدادا لاحتمال وقوع حدث عارض وشدة ضرره المتوقع، بما في ذلك دراسة العوامل القانونية والاقتصادية والسلوكية.
definition.en: The process of evaluating and selecting alternative regulatory and non-regulatory responses to prepare for the probability of an accidental occurrence and its expected magnitude of damage, including the consideration of legal, economic and behavioral factors.

definition.ar: تقييم ذاتي من جانب الأفراد، في الأغلب لا يتفق إلا قليلا مع الاحتمالية الإحصائية للضرر أو الإصابة.
definition.en: A subjective appreciation by individuals which will more often than not bear little relation to the statistical probability of damage or injury.

definition.ar: أي فعل أو واقعة أو عملية تقلل من احتمال وقوع الضرر على منطقة ما أو سكانها نتيجة لخطر ما.
definition.en: Any act, instance or process lowering the probability that harm will come to an area or its population as the result of some hazard.

definition.ar: تيار من الماء يتدفق في قناة من أرض مرتفعة نحو أرض منخفضة وينتهي في آخر المطاف إلى بحيرة أو إلى البحر، عدا في المناطق الصحراوية التي قد يتضاءل فيها حتى يتلاشى. ويطلق على النهر وجميع روافده الواقعة في حوض واحد نظام التصريف.
definition.en: A stream of water which flows in a channel from high ground to low ground and ultimately to a lake or the sea, except in a desert area where it may dwindle away to nothing. A river and all its tributaries within a single basin is termed a drainage system.
area of land from which all surface run‑off flows through a sequence of streams, rivers or lakes into the sea at a single river mouth, estuary or delta
definition.fr: zone dans laquelle toutes les eaux de ruissellement convergent à travers un réseau de rivières, fleuves et éventuellement de lacs vers la mer, dans laquelle elles se déversent par une seule embouchure, estuaire ou delta

definition.ar: أي نمو أو بلوغ أو تغير في منطقة من الأرض يرويها نهر ما وروافده.
definition.en: Any growth, maturation or change in an area of land drained by a river and its tributaries.

management of the sustainable use of water resources in a river basin, comprising the main river, all its tributaries and ground water, so as to provide for the social, cultural and economic development by taking into account the basics of ecology

definition.ar: القناة التي تحوي أو كانت تحوي فيما سبق مياه النهر.
definition.en: The channel containing or formerly containing the water of a river.
Pertaining to a low-lying plain that is composed of stream-borne sediments deposited by a river at its mouth.

definition.ar: طرد النفايات الصلبة أو السائلة أو الغازية في الأنهار.
definition.en: Discharge of solid, liquid or gaseous waste into a river.
Pertaining to the extent, thickness, longevity, etc. of ice formationsthat occur on river systems.
Pertaining to the extent, thickness, longevity, etc. of ice formations that occur on river systems.

The process by which ice melts and breaks apart in lakes and rivers. Ice breakup in lakes and rivers has been watched carefully by people living in cold climates, allowing us to observe progressive earlier breakup associated with climate warming. Ice breakup is important to people because it indicates that waterways blocked by ice will soon be navigable, allowing transport of goods, hunting, recreation, and other activities of economic and social importance.

Refers to freshwater ice or floating freshwater ice, is ice that forms on the surface of freshwater bodies when the surface water temperature falls just below 0˚C. Lake and river ice play a key role in the physical, biological, and chemical processes of cold region freshwater. The presence of freshwater ice also has economic implications ranging from transportation (ice-road duration, open-water shipping season) to the occurrence and severity of ice-jam flooding that often causes serious damage to infrastructure and property.

definition.ar: تغيير بيد الإنسان بطريقة مباشرة أو غير مباشرة للسلامة الحيوية أو الفيزيائية أو الكيميائية أو الإشعاعية لمياه النهر أو النظام الإيكولوجي النهري.
definition.en: The direct or indirect human alteration of the biological, physical, chemical or radiological integrity of river water, or a river ecosystem.
Continuous parts of streams between two specified points.
Long water courses including main streams and tributaries.

definition.ar: الماء الذي يتدفق في قناة من ارض مرتفعة إلى أرض منخفضة وينتهي به المطاف إلى بحيرة أو إلى البحر، عدا في المناطق الصحراوية حيث يتضاءل حتى يتلاشى.
definition.en: Water which flows in a channel from high ground to low ground and ultimately to a lake or the sea, except in a desert area where it may dwindle away to nothing.
Pertaining to the area of a natural stream of water, where organisms live.

definition.ar: نباتات تنمو في مناطق مجاورة للأنهار والجداول.
definition.en: Plants growing in areas adjacent to rivers and streams.

Ribonucleic acid (abbreviated RNA) is a molecule present in all living cells that is transcribed from and has structural similarities to DNA. The “transcript” is the RNA produced when a gene is transcribed. Unlike DNA, RNA is most often single-stranded. Includes mRNA (messenger), tRNA (transfer), and rRNA (ribosomal).
RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq) uses the capabilities of high-throughput sequencing methods to provide insight into the transcriptome of a cell.

definition.ar: أي تدبير أو أسلوب أو تصميم لتقليل خطر وقوع الضرر من جانب المركبات المتحركة على امتداد طريق بري مبني.
definition.en: Any measure, technique or design intended to reduce the risk of harm posed by moving vehicles along a constructed land route.
environmental noise generated from vehicles using roads and highways caused by rolling and propulsion
definition.fr: bruit dans l'environnement généré par des véhicules utilisant des routes et autoroutes, causé par le roulage et la propulsion

definition.en: A rock formation created by the passing of a glacier. When a glacier erodes down to bedrock, it can form tear-drop shaped hills that taper in the up-ice direction.
A rock formation created by the passing of a glacier. When a glacier erodes down to bedrock, it can form tear-drop shaped hills that taper in the up-ice direction.

definition.ar: أي مجموعة من المعادن التي تكون جزءا من القشرة الأرضية. قد تكون مفككة كالرمل و الطمي أو الطين أو متماسكة كالجرانيت أو الحجر الجيري أو الفحم.
definition.en: Any aggregate of minerals that makes up part of the earth's crust. It may be unconsolidated, such as sand, clay, or mud, or consolidated, such as granite, limestone, or coal.

Rock-Eval Pyrolysis is used to identify the type and maturity of organic matter and to detect petroleum potential in sediments. Rock Eval pyrolysis is done using the Delsi-Nermag Rock Eval II Plus TOC module. Samples chosen to be measured on the Rock Eval are usually subsampled from the freeze-dried material previously crushed for analyses on the coulometer and CNS. The Rock Eval (RE) pyrolysis method consists of a programmed temperature heating (in a pyrolysis oven) in an inert atmosphere (helium) of a small sample (~100 mg) to quantitatively and selectively determine (1) the free hydrocarbons contained in the sample and (2) the hydrocarbon- and oxygen-containing compounds (CO2) that are volatilized during the cracking of the unextractable organic matter in the sample (kerogen).
The areal extent of rock or soil-covered ground, expressed as the mathematical fraction of a region covered with rock or soil.

Distinctive geomorphological landforms of angular rock debris frozen in interstitial ice which may extend outward and downslope from talus cones, glaciers or terminal moraines of glaciers. There are two types of rock glaciers: periglacial glaciers, or talus-derived glaciers, and glacial rock glaciers.

definition.ar: العلم النظري والتطبيقي الذي يهتم بالسلوك الفيزيائي للصخور ويعتبر أحد فروع الميكانيكا حيث يعنى باستجابة الصخور لحقول القوى الموجودة في بيئتها الفيزيائية.
definition.en: The theoretical and applied science of the physical behavior of rocks, representing a "branch of mechanics concerned with the response of rock to the force fields of its physical environment".

name.fr: Exploitation minière de potasse et de sel gemme

definition.ar: عملية تعدين جوفية لاستخراج الملح الصخري فيزيائيا من الأرض في سلسة تشتمل على حفر الصخور وتفجيرها وتكسيرها. وتستخدم النسبة الكبرى من هذا المُخرج في صيانة الطرق شتاء.
definition.en: Rock salt mining is an underground mining process in which the salt is physically dug out of the ground in an operation involving drilling, blasting and crushing the rock. The major percentage of this output is used for winter road maintenance.
Solid masses that make up the earth's crust as well as accumulations of materials. Use for major rock types and unconsolidated deposits. For deposits of economic value, see related terms.
A naturally occurring solid aggregate of one or more minerals that make up the solid earth.
Pertaining to the environment of rock-dominated shorelines,often characterized by high-energy wave action, and often common alongisostatically rebounding coastlines.
Pertaining to coastline consisting of rocky outcrops that are exposed to daily tides.

definition.ar: أي حيوان من الثدييات المشيمية الصغيرة نسبيا التي تكون رتبة القوارض، وتتميز بأسنان قاطعة دائمة النمو متخصصة في القرض.
definition.en: Any of the relatively small placental mammals that constitute the order Rodentia, having constantly growing incisor teeth specialized for gnawing.

definition.ar: ضوضاء صاخبة عميقة الصوت نتجم عن الاحتكاك بين إطارات السيارات واسطح الطرق.
definition.en: Deeply resounding, reverberating noise caused by the friction between car tyres and road surfaces.

definition.ar: عضو الامتصاص والتثبيت في النباتات الوعائية. لا يحمل أوراقا أو أزهارا وعادة ما يكون تحت الأرض.
definition.en: The absorbing and anchoring organ of a vascular plant; it bears neither leaves nor flowers and is usually subterranean.
'root zone soil moisture' describes moisture content in the top 1 meter of the soil column
A wave on a uniform current in a two-dimensional nondivergent fluid system, rotating with varying angle speed about the local vertical (beta plane).
Use of machinery to drive a rotating bit through earth materials in order to sample below the surface.
Pertaining to the measurement, and effects of variations in the Earth's rotation about its axis, and variations in the Earth's orbit around the sun.
The rate and speed at which the Earth rotates around its own axis. The Earth rotates towards the east. As viewed from the North Star Polaris, the Earth turns counter-clockwise.
Worms of the phylum Nematoda, often parasitic, such as hookworms and pinworms, having soft cylindrical bodies without segments.

definition.ar: أي نفايات أو مواد غير مرغوب فيها مصنوعة من المطاط الطبيعي أو الصناعي، وكثيرا ما تكون منتجات ثانوية لتصنيع المطاط.
definition.en: Any refuse or unwanted material made of synthetic or natural rubber, often the byproduct of rubber processing.
Alkali metal element with symbol Rb and atomic number 37

Technique for dating ancient rocks based on measuring the ratio of the isotopes strontium-87 to ribidium-87 in samples. Uses the known half-life of radioactive isotopes of rubidium-87 that decay to isotopes of strontium-87 to determine rock ages.

definition.ar: الحالة الطبيعية أو صفة أو حالة عدم الاستئناس أو عدم الترويض أو عدم التمدين.
definition.en: A state of nature or a quality or state of being undomesticated, untamed or uncultivated.

definition.ar: معدل إزالة الماء بانسيابه على سطح التربة. ويتحدد هذا المعدل بملمس التربة ودرجة الانحدار والمناخ وغطاء استخدام الأرض (سطح ممهد، حشائش، تربة عارية).
definition.en: Rate at which water is removed by flowing over the soil surface. This rate is determined by the texture of the soil, slope, climate, and land use cover (e.g. paved surface, grass, forest, bare soil).
Rate at which water is discharged in surface streams.
Metal element with symbol Ru and atomic number 44
Metal element with symbol Rf and atomic number 104

definition.ar: حالة الأمن من الضرر أو الإصابة أو الخطر أو المخاطرة، عادة ما تكون نتيجة تدابير أو ترتيبات مخططة
definition.en: The state of being secure from harm, injury, danger or risk, often as a result of planned measures or preparations.

definition.ar: عملية دراسة الحاجة إلى تحركات أو إجراءات أو أجهزة، أو مدى فعاليتها، بغرض تقليل معدل وقوع أو احتمال الإصابة أو الفقد أو الخطر على الأشخاص أو الممتلكات أو البيئة.
definition.en: The process of studying the need for or efficacy of actions, procedures or devices intended to lower the occurrence or risk of injury, loss and danger to persons, property or the environment.

definition.ar: تحرك أو إجراء أو تجهيز معد بغرض تقليل معدل وقوع أو احتمال الإصابة أو الفقد أو الخطر على الأشخاص أو الممتلكات أو البيئة.
definition.en: An action, procedure or contrivance designed to lower the occurrence or risk of injury, loss and danger to persons, property or the environment.

definition.ar: مبدأ أو تنظيم يحكم التحركات أو الإجراءات أو الأجهزة التي يراد بها تقليل معدل وقوع أو احتمال الإصابة أو الفقد أو الخطر على الأشخاص أو الممتلكات أو البيئة.
definition.en: A principle or regulation governing actions, procedures or devices intended to lower the occurrence or risk of injury, loss and danger to persons, property or the environment.

definition.ar: البحث والفحص التفصيلي المصحوب عادة بتقرير مكتوب عن الحاجة إلى تحركات أو إجراءات أو أجهزة يراد بها تقليل معدل وقوع أو احتمال الإصابة أو الفقد أو الخطر على الأشخاص أو الممتلكات أو البيئة، أو عن مدى فعاليتها.
definition.en: Research, detailed examination and usually a written report on the need for or efficacy of actions, procedures or devices intended to lower the occurrence or risk of injury, loss and danger to persons, property or the environment.

definition.ar: تجميع أو خطة موحدة منسقة للإجراءات والأجهزة التي يراد بها تقليص خطر الإصابة أو الخسارة أو الخطر على الأشخاص والممتلكات أو البيئة.
definition.en: A unified, coordinated assemblage or plan of procedures and devices intended to lower the occurrence or risk of injury, loss and danger to persons, property or the environment.
Category 1 on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale. Sustained Winds 74-95 mph, 64-82 kt, 119-153 km/h
Category 2 on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale. Sustained Winds 96-110 mph,83-95 kt, 154-177 km/h

Category 4 on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale. Sustained Winds 130-156 mph,113-136 kt, 209-251 km/h
Category 5 on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale. Sustained Winds 157 mph or higher, 137 kt or higher, 252 km/h or higher.

From Mitchell: The averaging region is based on the rotated principal component analysis of average June through September African rainfall presented in Janowiak (1988, J. Climate, 1, 240-255). Stations within 20-8N, 20W-10E are obtained from the National Center for Atmospheric Research World Monthly Surface Station Climatology (WMSSC), and 14 retained which had complete or almost complete records for 1950-93. See link for stations. http://jisao.washington.edu/data_sets/sahel/

definition.ar: أي برمائي من البرمائيات العديدة ذات الذيل مثل سمندل وسط وجنوب أوروبا. يتميز بأنه حيوان بري له جسم مستطيل، ولا يعود إلى الماء إلا للتكاثر
definition.en: Any of various urodele amphibians, such as Salamandra salamandra of central and S Europe. They are typically terrestrial, have an elongated body, and only return to water to breed.

definition.ar: مكان تتكون فيه ترسيبات ملحية بللورية أو يعثر عليها فيه، مثل مسطحات الملح أو البحيرات الملحة أو البقع الملحية.
definition.en: A place where crystalline salt deposits are formed or found, such as a salt flat or pan, a salada, or a salt lick.

definition.ar: تراكم الأملاح القابلة للذوبان عن طريق تبخر المياه التي كانت تحملها إلى منطقة التربة وذلك في تربة منطقة قاحلة رديئة التصريف.
definition.en: The accumulation of soluble salts by evaporation of the waters that bore them to the soil zone, in a soil of an arid, poorly drained region.

The concentration of dissolved salts in water, usually expressed in parts per thousand (permille, %) or parts per million (ppm). The United States Geological Survey classifies saline water in three salinity categories. Salt concentration in slightly saline water is around 1,000 to 3,000 ppm (0.1–0.3%), in moderately saline water 3,000 to 10,000 ppm (0.3–1%) and in highly saline water 10,000 to 35,000 ppm (1–3.5%). Seawater has a salinity of roughly 35,000 ppm, equivalent to 35 grams of salt per one liter (or kilogram) of water.
A considerable body of inland water containing large quantities of salt.
Measure of the concentration of salts dissolved in a solution.
The total amount of dissolved material in water and its effect onwater's mass-to-volume ratio. Scientific measurements related to eithersalinity or density are included under this Term.

definition.ar: اسم عام يطلق على فصيلة من الكائنات متناهية الصغر وهي من أكبر المجموعات البكتيرية، وتتضمن أكثرها ضلوعا في تسمم الأغذية والالتهابات المعدية المعوية. أكثر مصادر عدوى السالمونيلا شيوعا هي التعامل غير الصحي والطهو غير الكافي للدواجن واللحوم، والتخزين غير السليم للحوم الباردة، ومؤخرا تلوث بيض الدجاج الذي تتم تربيته في بطاريات الدواجن.
definition.en: General name for a family of microorganisms, one of the largest groups of bacteria, that includes those most frequently implicated in food poisoning and gastroenteritis. Unhygienic handling and inadequate cooking of poultry and meat, improper storage of cold meats and, more recently, contamination of battery-reared hen eggs, are the most common sources of salmonella infections.

definition.ar: ناتج التفاعل عندما يحل المعدن محل الهيدروجين في أحد الأحماض.
definition.en: The reaction product when a metal displaces the hydrogen of an acid.

Sea salt aerosol, which originally comes from sea spray, is one of the most widely distributed natural aerosols. Sea salt aerosols are characterized as non-light-absorbing, highly hygroscopic, and having coarse particle size. Some sea salt dominated aerosols could have a single scattering albedo as large as ~0.97. Due to the hygroscopy, a sea salt particle can serve as a very efficient cloud condensation nuclei (CCN), altering cloud reflectivity, lifetime, and precipitation process. According to the IPCC report, the total sea salt flux from ocean to atmosphere is ~3300 Tg/yr

definition.ar: مساحة من الماء الضحل المالح توجد عادة في المناطق الساحلية ودلتاوات الأنهار. كما توجد أيضا مستنقعات داخلية في الأراضي القاحلة حيث تتسم المياه بارتفاع مستوى الملح فيها بسبب التبخر. وهي مناطق حساسة بيئيا وشديدة الهشاشة أمام التلوث بالكيماويات الصناعية والزراعية أو التلوث الحراري الذي ينجم دائما عن استخدام مياه النهر كمبرد في محطات الطاقة والمصانع.
definition.en: Areas of brackish, shallow water usually found in coastal areas and in deltas. There are also inland marshes in arid areas where the water has a high salt level because of evaporation. They are environmentally delicate areas, extremely vulnerable to pollution by industrial or agricultural chemicals, or to thermal pollution, which often results when river water has been used as the coolant in power stations and industrial plants.
A meadow subject to overflow by salt water.

definition.ar: كتلة من الملح الذي تم حقنة كمنتئ (قبة أو نتوء تم تحطيم الصخور الواقعة فوقها بدفع مادة قابلة للتشكل إلى قلبها من الداخل) في صخور رسوبية بحيث يخترقها ويشوهها. وهذه الآلية تشبه حركة الصهارة البركانية حيث يتشوه الملح ويتصرف كمادة ذات قابلية للتشكل تحت الضغط. ولها أهمية اقتصادية كبيرة لأنها تساعد على تشكيل تكوينات لحبس التراكمات النفطية والجبسية والكبريتية.
definition.en: A mass of salt which is injected as a diapir (a dome in which the overlying rocks have been ruptured by the squeezing-out of plastic core material) into overlying sedimentary rocks, thereby piercing and deforming them. The mechanism is similar to that of an intrusive magma, with the salt deforming and behaving plastically under pressure. It is of great economic importance because it assists in the formation of a "trap" structure for oil accumulation, in addition to its associated deposits of anhydrite, gypsum and sulphur.
The mass transport of salt in the ocean.
Water of the seas, distinguished by high salinity.

A specific type of particle transport by fluids such as wind, or the denser fluid water. It occurs when loose material is removed from a bed and carried by the fluid, before being transported back to the surface.
Infusion of saline waters in an aquifer or body of surface water.
Rare earth (lanthanide series) element with symbol Sm and atomic number 62

Refers to an environmental vulnerability index for Samoa. Development of a vulnerability index for the environment which could be calculated on the scale of entire states for the purpose of ranking them and providing a single-figure expression of their relative environmental vulnerabilities. This work was done in response to a call made in the Barbados Plan of Action, the Alliance of Small Island States (AOSIS) and an increasing awareness that small island developing states face disadvantages to their development associated with their remoteness, small size, dispersion, economic conditions, and limited natural resources. In the past vulnerability indices have been developed which describe the risks associated with economic and social conditions, climate change, sea-level rise, natural disasters and anthropogenic impacts. Most of these indices describe the vulnerability of human systems; there have been very limited attempts to describe effects on the environment. Human systems and the environment are dependent on one another so that risks to the environment of a state will eventually translate into risks to humans. This is the first attempt to construct an index that focuses on the vulnerability of the environment. An Environmental Vulnerability Index (the EVI) was constructed, based on a theoretical framework that identified three aspects of vulnerability: risks to the environment (natural and anthropogenic), the innate ability of the environment to cope with the risks (resilience) and ecosystem integrity (the health or condition of the environment as a result of past impacts). These three aspects correspond to three sub-indices, the REI, IRI and EDI, which are the Risk Exposure sub-Index, Intrinsic Resilience sub-Index and Environmental Degradation sub- Index respectively. The EVI was calculated as a weighted average of scores allocated in the range of 0-7 derived from a total of 57 indicators. A preliminary EVI was calculated for three countries, Australia, Fiji and Tuvalu. The preliminary EVI value for Tuvalu was the highest of the three countries indicating that its environment is the most vulnerable. The score obtained for Fiji was intermediate in value, and that for Australia was the lowest, though the difference between Fiji and Australia was relatively smaller than that between Fiji and Tuvalu. There were similar levels of risk in each of the countries, the most degradation in Australia and the least intrinsic resilience in Tuvalu. These results, though promising are only preliminary because the EVI requires refinement and there was insufficient time to collect all of the required data from all of the countries and because there were some inconsistencies in the quality of the data. We expect that each of these problems can be overcome. The EVI developed here will require further refinement before it becomes fully operational. The results show that it is possible to obtain a single figure measure of vulnerability and that data which were previously thought to be difficult to obtain can be obtained. The methodology selected in the computation of the index can produce results which could have operational usefulness for ranking countries according to their environmental vulnerabilities. It is envisaged that the EVI would be recalculated every 5 years to provide updates on the vulnerability status of countries. This index highlights the need for governments to upgrade their collection and collation of environmental statistics. In addition, the breakdown of results into meteorological, geological, anthropogenic, and other categories of risk highlights areas of concern for environmental action.
Deposits of loose particles of rock or mineral (sediment) that range in size from 0.0625-2.0 millimeters in diameter.

definition.ar: تراكم الرمل السائب الذي تكومه الرياح، ويشيع وجود الكثبان الرملية على امتداد السواحل البحرية الخفيضة فوق مستوى المد العالي، بينما تندر على حدود البحيرات الكبيرة أو وديان الأنهار، كما توجد في العديد من المناطق الصحراوية حيث يوجد قدر وافر من الرمال السطحية الجافة خلال بعض أجزاء العام.
definition.en: An accumulation of loose sand heaped up by the wind, commonly found along low-lying seashores above high-tide level, more rarely on the border of large lakes or river valleys, as well as in various desert regions, where there is abundant dry surface sand during some part of the year.

definition.ar: استخراج الرمل بالتعدين لأغراض البناء واستخراج المعادن الثقيلة مثل الروتيل والزيركون.
definition.en: The extraction of sand by mining for building purposes and for the extraction of heavy minerals such as rutile and zircon.

definition.ar: مسطح رملي في منطقة المد والجز يخلو من الغطاء النباتي. والمسطح في منطقة المد والجزر هو امتداد واسع شبه أفقي من أراضي المستنقعات أو الأراضي القاحلة يغطيها المد ثم ينحسر عنها في تتابع مستمر، وتتكون من ترسيبات غير متماسكة (معظمها من الطين والرمل). وقد يكون هو السطح العلوي لترسيب من ترسيبات الدلتاوات.
definition.en: A sandy tidal flat barren of vegetation. A tidal flat is an extensive, nearly horizontal, marshy or barren tract of land that is alternately covered and uncovered by the tide, and consisting of unconsolidated sediment (mostly mud and sand). It may form the top surface of a deltaic deposit.

Sanger sequencing, also known as the chain termination method, is a technique for DNA sequencing based upon the selective incorporation of chain-terminating dideoxynucleotides (ddNTPs) by DNA polymerase during in vitro DNA replication.

definition.ar: مصطلح يشير إلى تصنيف للكائنات حسب الطريقة التي تتحمل بها التلوث.
definition.en: Referring to the classification of organisms according to the way in which they tolerate pollution.

definition.ar: جسم يدور حول جسم أكبر منه. وتستخدم الأقمار الصناعية التي تدور حول الأرض للاتصالات وجمع المعلومات العسكرية ورصد الطقس وغيره من الظواهر البيئية، إلخ.
definition.en: An object that orbits around a larger one. Artificial satellites orbiting the Earth are used for communications, the gathering of military intelligence, the monitoring of weather and other environmental phenomena, etc.
Pertaining to the determination of variations in orbital paths of man-made satellites, and to the calculation of the orbits of future satellites.
The Satellite Soil Moisture Index combines AVHRR-measured NDVI with surface temperature to compute an estimate of plant moisture stress, then scales it to produce an index image.
The rate at which the temperature of a parcel of saturated air decreases as the parcel is lifted in the atmosphere.
The specific humidity of water vapor corresponding to the saturation mixing ratio.

The vapor pressure of a system, at a given temperature, for which the vapor of a substance is in equilibrium with a plane surface of that substance's pure liquid or solid phase; that is, the vapor pressure of a system that has attained saturation but not supersaturation.
Pertaining to areas of submerged aquatic vegetation or sea grasses below low-tide mark.

A rolling grassland scattered with shrubs and isolated trees, which can be found between a tropical rainforest and desert biome. Not enough rain falls on a savanna to support forests. Savannas are also known as tropical grasslands
An open, grassy, essentially treeless plain, especially as developed in tropical or subtropical regions.
Metal element with symbol Sc and atomic number 21
Microscope in which a finely focused beam of electrons is scanned across a specimen. The electronic intensity variations observed are used to construct an image of the specimen.
The process by which some of a stream of radiation is dispersed to travel in directions other than that which from it was incident by particles suspended in the medium through which it is travelling.
Scavenging is the manner of feeding where the animal feeds on dead animaland plant matter.
Major educational fields, fields of study, and professional groupings within USGS.
Professions in which people carry out or support scientific research or monitoring.
Application of scientific judgment as to the meaning of observations or models. Use for interpretations that are provided in formats similar to data, such as geospatial data.
Description of the history of individual organisms by studying the variations in thickness of accretionary layers in their skeletons.
Erosion of sediment in a stream bed, often occurring at manmade structures such as bridge supports.
Erosion resulting from glacial action, whereby the surface material is removed and the rock fragments carried by the glacier abrade, scratch, and polish the bedrock.

definition.ar: مواد قابلة لإعادة التدوير مصدرها أي عمليات تصنيع أو منتجات استهلاكية تم التخلص منها.
definition.en: Recyclable material from any manufacturing process or discarded consumer products.

definition.ar: أي مادة معدنية تخلفت عن عمليات تصنيع وتكون عادة ملائمة لإعادة المعالجة.
definition.en: Any metal material discarded from manufacturing operations and usually suitable for reprocessing.

definition.ar: مادة قابلة لإعادة التدوير مصدرها إطارات المركبات المهملة.
definition.en: Recyclable material from discarded motor vehicle tyres.

definition.ar: سيارة من المقرر تفكيكها أو التخلص منها بشكل آخر.
definition.en: Car which is delivered for breaking up or otherwise discarded.

definition.ar: الحد من الحقل الكهربائى حول النواة عن طريق الشحنة الفراغية للإلكترونات المحيطة بها.
definition.en: The reduction of the electric field about a nucleus by the space charge of the surrounding electrons.

definition.ar: ـ 1) بصفة عامة، القسم المائي من الأرض في مقابل اليابسة. ـ 2) اسم يطلق على جسم مائي مالح أصغر من المحيط ويقع عموما بالقرب من إحدى القارات.
definition.en: 1) In general, the marine section of the globe as opposed to that of the land. 2) The name given to a body of salt water smaller than an ocean and generally in proximity to a continent.
Sea arches form by wave erosion of coastal headlands. Sea arches are very temporary landforms, in both geologic and human terms.

definition.ar: قاع المحيط أو البحر. ويعرف قاع المحيط بأنه السطح شبه الأفقي لحوض المحيط.
definition.en: The bottom of the ocean. Also known as sea floor; sea bottom. The ocean floor is defined as the near-horizontal surface of the ocean basin.

definition.ar: تمتد المصادر المعدنية البحرية أمتدادا واسعا يفوق المستغل منها حاليا. وتأتي المعادن من مصدرين منفصلين من المصادر البحرية، هما الترسيبات الرسوبية التي تقع تحت الجروف القارية والترسيبات الشاطئية الموجودة على سطح الجروف القارية. وأهم المصادر المعدنية على الإطلاق المستغلة في البيئات البحرية هي البترول. بينما تعطي الترسيبات البحرية الغرينية على سطح الجروف القارية الذهب والبلاتين والقصدير. أما في قيعان محيطات العالم فيمكن أن نجد المنجنيز نتيجة للترسيب أو الهطول في المناطق المفتوحة من مياه المحيط، وهي كتل صغيرة متحجرة غير منتظمة سوداء أو بنية اللون مكونة من طبقات سهلة التفتت تتألف أساسا من أملاح المنجنيز ومعادن أكاسيد المنجنيز.
definition.en: Marine mineral resources extend far beyond those presently exploited; minerals are derived from two separate types of marine sources: from sedimentary deposits underlying the continental shelves and from inshore deposits on the surface of the continental shelves. By far the most valuable of the mineral resources exploited from marine environments is petroleum. Offshore placer deposits on the surface of the continental shelves yield gold, platinum, and tin. On the floors of the world's oceans manganese nodules are found as a result of pelagic sedimentation or precipitation; they are small, irregular, black to brown, friable, laminated concretionary masses consisting primarily of manganese salts and manganese-oxide minerals.

name.fr: Extraction minière sur le fonds marin

definition.ar: الأنشطة أو العمليات المتعلقة باستخراج الترسيبات المعدنية من سطح قاع المحيط أو من تحت السطح.
definition.en: The activity or processes involving the extraction of mineral deposits from the surface, or below the surface, of the ocean floor.
A coastal local wind that blows from sea to land, caused by the temperature difference when the sea surface is colder than the adjacent land.

A littoral cave, is a type of cave formed primarily by the wave action of the sea. The primary process involved is erosion. Sea caves are found throughout the world, actively forming along present coastlines and as relict sea caves on former coastlines.
